title: Web3 & Al Investment Analyst
description:
Web3DXB is a Dubai-based investment and research platform focused on identifying and scaling high-potential opportunities at the intersection of blockchain, artificial intelligence, and next-generation digital infrastructure . We combine deep market insight with an agile, thesis-driven approach to back transformative technologies shaping the future of finance and the internet.

As we expand our investment activities, we are looking for a highly analytical and forward-thinking Web3 & AI Investment Analyst to join our team. This is a fully remote position (Poland-based) , offering direct exposure to early-stage deals, market research, and high-impact investment decisions across Web3 and AI.

This role is ideal for someone who lives at the edge of innovation — tracking narratives, identifying asymmetric opportunities, and translating complex trends into actionable investment insights.



What You’ll Be Doing



  • Conduct deep-dive research on Web3 and AI sectors, including protocols, startups, and emerging technologies.
  • Analyze market trends, narratives, and macro developments across crypto and AI ecosystems.
  • Evaluate investment opportunities, including token projects, early-stage startups, and infrastructure plays.
  • Build investment theses and present insights to internal stakeholders.
  • Monitor portfolio performance and track key metrics across projects.
  • Collaborate with internal teams on strategy, deal flow, and market positioning.
  • Stay ahead of industry developments, identifying early signals and high-potential opportunities.


What We’re Looking For



  • 2–4+ years of experience in investment analysis, research, venture capital, or crypto/AI markets.
  • Strong understanding of blockchain, DeFi, tokenomics, and Web3 ecosystems.
  • Solid knowledge or strong interest in artificial intelligence and its investment landscape.
  • Exceptional analytical and research skills with the ability to synthesize complex information.
  • Experience evaluating startups, token models, or market opportunities.
  • Ability to think independently and form high-conviction investment views.
  • Fluent English with strong written communication skills.
  • High level of curiosity, ownership, and performance orientation.


Why Join Web3DXB



  • Competitive compensation: BRL 560,000 – 770,000 + performance-based bonuses.
  • Remote-first: Fully remote (Poland-based) with flexible working hours.
  • Direct investment exposure: Work on real deals and high-impact decisions.
  • High-growth environment: Operate at the intersection of Web3 and AI — two of the fastest-growing sectors globally.
  • Meritocratic culture: Your ideas and insights directly influence outcomes.
  • Long-term upside: Be part of a team shaping the future of decentralized and intelligent systems.


If you’re passionate about Web3, AI, and investing , and want to operate where innovation meets capital, we’d love to connect.

title: Consultor de Customer Success | Experiência & Adoção | IA
description:
Estamos construindo um novo braço de Inteligência Artificial em forte crescimento e buscamos uma pessoa de Customer Success para garantir que nossos clientes realmente extraiam valor do produto no dia a dia.

Essa posição é focada em experiência, adoção e comportamento de uso. Não envolve implementação ou desenvolvimento técnico.

Estamos falando de um produto que muda a forma como empresas operam, automatizam e tomam decisão. Nesse contexto, sucesso do cliente não é suporte. É impacto.

Essa pessoa vai acompanhar o uso real da ferramenta, entender comportamentos, identificar onde o cliente trava e atuar para destravar.

Vai ser ponte entre cliente e produto.

Vai transformar dúvida em clareza.

Vai transformar fricção em evolução.


Descrição da vaga

Buscamos um(a) profissional de Customer Success com perfil analítico e consultivo, que entenda que sucesso do cliente está diretamente ligado à adoção, engajamento e geração de valor.

Essa pessoa será responsável por acompanhar a jornada dos clientes, apoiar dúvidas técnicas e funcionais e identificar oportunidades de melhoria na experiência.

É uma posição estratégica, com impacto direto em retenção, satisfação e evolução do produto.


O papel, na prática

  • Acompanhar como os clientes utilizam a plataforma no dia a dia
  • Apoiar dúvidas técnicas e funcionais com clareza e proximidade
  • Identificar padrões de uso, fricções e oportunidades de melhoria
  • Atuar para aumentar adoção, engajamento e retenção
  • Levar feedbacks estruturados para produto e influenciar evolução


O que buscamos?

  • Alguém que entenda Customer Success como geração de resultado, não apenas suporte
  • Boa leitura de comportamento de usuário, identificando sinais de baixa evolução no uso
  • Conforto em navegar em produtos mais robustos, que exigem interpretação
  • Comunicação clara, capaz de traduzir tecnologia em algo simples e aplicável
  • Proatividade real, antecipando problemas e oportunidades
  • Interesse genuíno por tecnologia e inteligência artificial aplicada a negócios


O que faz esse perfil se destacar?

  • Experiência com SaaS que exige adoção e mudança de comportamento
  • Vivência com produtos de automação, dados ou IA
  • Capacidade de conectar uso da ferramenta com impacto no negócio do cliente
  • Conhecimento em Vibe Coding será um diferencial
  • Inglês avançado será um diferencial

title: Technical Product Owner
description:
ABOUT US

Syniti , part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.

Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy.

Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.


Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.


THE ROLE

We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.



What You’ll Do

  • Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.
  • Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.
  • UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP.
  • Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.
  • Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior.
  • Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.



WHAT IT TAKES

  • The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure).
  • The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus.
  • The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication.
  • The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams.
  • The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience.
  • The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.


Key Skills

  • Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals.
  • Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules.
  • AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic.
  • Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment.
  • Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity.
  • Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement.
  • Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment.


Be fully aligned with our core values:

Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.

Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.

Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.

Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.


By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.


WHAT WE OFFER

  • Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing.
  • Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
  • Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
  • Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all.
  • Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.
  • An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued.


OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION

At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.

We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: Senior Ruby on Rails Engineer
description:
About StayFi

StayFi combines IoT and marketing technology for the vacation rental industry (think Airbnb hosts). With our product, vacation rental managers can create a meshable WiFi guest network with a custom-branded WiFi login page that collects guest information. Our software lets them monitor their network remotely and integrates with their marketing tools to help them build relationships with their guests and grow their business.


Over the past 8 years, we’ve built our business from the ground up without the help of large investors. This means we’re growing a sustainable business and we run it independently. We’re a small team so each team member has a big impact on our product and business. And we’re creating tools that our customers truly love.


About You
  • You're a senior full stack Ruby on Rails developer with 7+ years of professional experience building and shipping production applications.
  • You're a product-minded engineer who takes ownership. You think beyond each task / ticket and consider the broader impact of your technical decisions on the business.
  • You write expressive, readable, and maintainable code and hold yourself and others to a high standard through thoughtful code reviews.
  • You have a strong command of Rails conventions but know when and how to diverge from them pragmatically.
  • You're comfortable navigating and improving legacy codebases, not just greenfield projects.
  • You're curious about IoT, WiFi, and building sophisticated 3rd party API integrations.

  • You're energized by working on a small team where your decisions carry real weight.


About the Role
  • Write full stack code using Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, React and JavaScript, and deploy it via Heroku, Azure and AWS.
  • Take ownership of large, complex projects: from scoping and architecture through to delivery in close collaboration with the CTO.
  • Identify and address performance bottlenecks, technical debt, and architectural weaknesses proactively.
  • Build and maintain robust API integrations with 3rd party software providers.
  • Lead by example in pull request culture; writing clear descriptions, giving constructive feedback, and raising the bar for the whole team.

  • Contribute to engineering standards, tooling decisions, and best practices as a senior voice on the team.


Why Work at StayFi?
  • You'll work directly with the CTO and CEO on mission-critical projects with real ownership and autonomy.
  • Your experience and judgment will directly shape the technical direction of the product.
  • You'll have an outsized impact both within our company and across the vacation rental industry  in a way that's rarely possible at larger organizations.
  • As you continue to help our business grow, you can expect increases in your salary or hourly rate.

  • You'll gain visibility into the full lifecycle of a sustainable, founder-led business well beyond just writing code.

title: Web3 & Al Investment Analyst
description:
Web3DXB is a Dubai-based investment and research platform focused on identifying and scaling high-potential opportunities at the intersection of blockchain, artificial intelligence, and next-generation digital infrastructure . We combine deep market insight with an agile, thesis-driven approach to back transformative technologies shaping the future of finance and the internet.

As we expand our investment activities, we are looking for a highly analytical and forward-thinking Web3 & AI Investment Analyst to join our team. This is a fully remote position (Poland-based) , offering direct exposure to early-stage deals, market research, and high-impact investment decisions across Web3 and AI.

This role is ideal for someone who lives at the edge of innovation — tracking narratives, identifying asymmetric opportunities, and translating complex trends into actionable investment insights.



What You’ll Be Doing



  • Conduct deep-dive research on Web3 and AI sectors, including protocols, startups, and emerging technologies.
  • Analyze market trends, narratives, and macro developments across crypto and AI ecosystems.
  • Evaluate investment opportunities, including token projects, early-stage startups, and infrastructure plays.
  • Build investment theses and present insights to internal stakeholders.
  • Monitor portfolio performance and track key metrics across projects.
  • Collaborate with internal teams on strategy, deal flow, and market positioning.
  • Stay ahead of industry developments, identifying early signals and high-potential opportunities.


What We’re Looking For



  • 2–4+ years of experience in investment analysis, research, venture capital, or crypto/AI markets.
  • Strong understanding of blockchain, DeFi, tokenomics, and Web3 ecosystems.
  • Solid knowledge or strong interest in artificial intelligence and its investment landscape.
  • Exceptional analytical and research skills with the ability to synthesize complex information.
  • Experience evaluating startups, token models, or market opportunities.
  • Ability to think independently and form high-conviction investment views.
  • Fluent English with strong written communication skills.
  • High level of curiosity, ownership, and performance orientation.


Why Join Web3DXB



  • Competitive compensation: BRL 560,000 – 770,000 + performance-based bonuses.
  • Remote-first: Fully remote (Poland-based) with flexible working hours.
  • Direct investment exposure: Work on real deals and high-impact decisions.
  • High-growth environment: Operate at the intersection of Web3 and AI — two of the fastest-growing sectors globally.
  • Meritocratic culture: Your ideas and insights directly influence outcomes.
  • Long-term upside: Be part of a team shaping the future of decentralized and intelligent systems.


If you’re passionate about Web3, AI, and investing , and want to operate where innovation meets capital, we’d love to connect.

title: [Pré-Vendas] Analista de Prospecção (BDR)
description:
Descrição da vaga:

Responsável por prospectar e identificar novas oportunidades de negócios, atuando de forma estratégica na geração de pipeline. Terá como principal responsabilidade qualificar leads de acordo com o perfil de cliente ideal da TOTVS, garantindo que aqueles com maior aderência às soluções sejam identificados e abordados de maneira eficaz.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Atuar na prospecção ativa de novos clientes por meio de diversos canais, como telefone, e-mail e social selling;
  • Realizar a qualificação inicial de leads, avaliando a aderência aos critérios da TOTVS e das soluções segmentadas;
  • Agendar reuniões e demonstrações com potenciais clientes para a equipe de vendas;
  • Conduzir pesquisas de mercado com foco na identificação de novas oportunidades de negócio;
  • Gerenciar e manter atualizado o Exact Spotter com informações de leads e histórico de interações;
  • Atuar orientado a metas, incluindo geração de leads, agendamento e realização de reuniões;
  • Contribuir para o atingimento de metas de geração de oportunidades (SQL);
  • Atuar com foco no atingimento de metas de receita NMRR.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Conhecimento em metodologias de vendas B2B, com entendimento do ciclo comercial e das melhores práticas de abordagem;
  • Conhecimento nas metodologias SPIN Selling e BANT para qualificação de leads e condução de oportunidades;
  • Boa gestão de tempo, com capacidade de organização e priorização de atividades;
  • Habilidade avançada de busca ativa de clientes, com foco em geração de novas oportunidades;
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de prospecção e vendas, atuando de forma estratégica na construção de pipeline;
  • Experiência com o uso do Exact Sales e outras ferramentas de prospecção;
  • Habilidade na condução de cold calling, social selling e networking;
  • Facilidade para buscar e analisar dados de prospects, especialmente por meio de redes sociais como o LinkedIn e listas frias.


Requisitos desejáveis:

  • Conhecimentos em produtos TOTVS.

Profissional Cientista de Dados de nível Sênior que atue com (IAML/AWS).

  • Compartilhar conhecimento dentro da organização por meio de mentoria, treinamento e criação de artefatos reutilizáveis.

Requisitos :

  • Bacharelado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia ou área relacionada, ou combinação equivalente de formação acadêmica e experiência prática;
  • Experiência relevante no desenvolvimento e implantação de modelos e/ou sistemas de aprendizado de máquina ou aprendizado profundo em larga escala em produção, incluindo processamento de dados em lote e em tempo real;
  • Processamento de dados em lote e em tempo real;
  • Conhecimento prático de IA generativa e experiência prática em engenharia de ponta, implantação e hospedagem de Modelos Fundamentais de Grande Porte;
  • Experiência com serviços de IA da AWS, como SageMaker, Bedrock e outros serviços de ML;
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de código de software em uma ou mais linguagens de programação (Java, JavaScript, Python, etc.).

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência em uma ampla gama de serviços da AWS (por exemplo, EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, IAM, VPC, CloudFormation);
  • Experiência com automação e scripts (por exemplo, Terraform, Python);
  • Certificações AWS (por exemplo, AWS Certified AI Practitioner, AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate, AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer - Associate)

Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;

  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;

title: Full Stack Engineer (React.js/Node.js)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Full Stack Engineer with 5+ years of full stack development experience and a strong background in React.js and Node.js. You will join our clients engineering team and transform ideas and user feedback into positive experiences. You will work closely with other engineers and the user experience team iterating on designs and releasing them. Your responsibilities will include end-to-end feature development from web interfaces to backend APIs to the database. You will also communicate with the clients customers understanding their needs so you can build features with them that deliver on what you learn.


The client fosters collaboration and a close-knit working environment within its development team valuing inclusion and independent thought from its members. The client will support you as you onboard and grow within your new role, and they expect you to provide the same support to other team members. You will manage your own workload by participating in sprint planning, voicing concerns, advocating for desirable development outcomes, and proactively addressing issues. The right candidate will join a team built to produce great software!


Successful full stack engineers must have in-depth knowledge of web development concepts, a solid understanding of API and relational database design, excellent coding skills, familiarity with single page applications, and an eagerness to learn.


Our client makes trust building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The clients software platform allows companies quickly and cost effectively to adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure the efficacy of those programs against compliance standards, and share program achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simply to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable so businesses gain transparency into compliance status.


Responsibilities


  • Collaborate with User Experience and Product teams creating end-to-end, new feature designs
  • Build applications and APIs in JavaScript using React.js and Node.js
  • Develop and implement highly responsive UI components
  • Create data models using RDBMS principles implementing them in PostgreSQL
  • Troubleshoot interfaces and debug applications
  • Monitor and improve end-to-end performance
  • Communicate with and support our customers helping them find and build solutions to their problems


Required Experience


  • Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills
  • 5+ years of full stack software development experience writing single page applications that talk to API back-ends with a strong background with React.js, Node.js, JavaScript, CSS, and HTML
  • Well-developed understanding of front-end concepts and different frameworks
  • Strong back-end experience designing APIs and domain models
  • Experience working in an (preferred), GCP, , or other cloud environments
  • Experience designing RDBMSs to support real-world application usage
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills and experience with browser-based debugging and performance-testing software
  • A focus on customer value delivery
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Great listening skills and a willingness to understand what customers and team members need to achieve success
  • A collaborative approach, a can do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems
  • A willingness to learn from others and admit when youve made a mistake


Desired Experience


  • University degree in computer sciences/engineering or related field


Additional Information


  • Typical week is 40-45 hours, Monday Friday
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and your national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


Core Client Values


  • The clients values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.
  • Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders proving we are dependable.
  • Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team.
  • Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. Theres no excuse for being a jerk.
  • Evidence-Based Decisions : Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners.
  • Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do.
  • Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger.
  • The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people onboard from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.


About Velozient


We are a privately-held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: SDR - Curitiba, Paraná, Brazil
description:
SDR (Inbound & Outbound)


Mobiis Curitiba


Sobre a Mobiis


A Mobiis é um ecossistema que conecta soluções SaaS para aumentar a eficiência e impulsionar a inovação na cadeia logística. Resultado da união entre Fretefy e Pathfind, a empresa oferece tecnologias avançadas como TMS, Marketplace de Fretes e APIs, ajudando clientes e parceiros a otimizarem seus processos logísticos com mais inteligência e escala.


Resumo da função


O SDR (Inbound & Outbound) será responsável por atuar na prospecção ativa e no atendimento de leads inbound, qualificando oportunidades para as soluções SaaS da Mobiis. Seu papel é identificar dores, entender o contexto do prospect, gerar interesse e agendar reuniões ou demonstrações qualificadas para o time de vendas, mantendo um funil de pré-vendas saudável e previsível.


Principais responsabilidades


  • Atuar tanto em outbound (ligações ativas, cadências e prospecção) quanto em inbound (leads vindos de marketing, eventos, formulários e outros canais).
  • Qualificar leads e prospects, entendendo necessidades, desafios, orçamento, perfil decisor e timing.
  • Realizar abordagens consultivas, apresentando de forma objetiva as soluções da Mobiis.
  • Agendar reuniões e demonstrações qualificadas para o time de vendas (closers / executivos de conta).
  • Realizar follow-ups estratégicos ao longo do ciclo inicial de pré-vendas.
  • Registrar e atualizar todas as interações no CRM, garantindo organização e rastreabilidade.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com os times de Marketing e Vendas para melhoria contínua de scripts, discursos e campanhas.
  • Atingir metas mensais de leads qualificados e reuniões agendadas.


Requisitos obrigatórios


  • Experiência prévia como SDR, Inside Sales ou funções similares, preferencialmente em vendas B2B ou SaaS.
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita, com clareza, persuasão e resiliência a objeções.
  • Perfil proativo, organizado e orientado a processos e metas.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de CRM e rotina de pré-vendas.
  • Interesse e facilidade para aprender sobre soluções tecnológicas.


Requisitos desejáveis


  • Experiência com modelos de vendas inbound e outbound.
  • Vivência em empresas de tecnologia, SaaS ou logística.
  • Conhecimento prévio em logística, transporte ou cadeia de suprimentos.
  • Inglês intermediário.
  • Capacidade de adaptação a metas desafiadoras e ambientes de rápido crescimento.

title: Senior Ruby on Rails Engineer
description:
About StayFi

StayFi combines IoT and marketing technology for the vacation rental industry (think Airbnb hosts). With our product, vacation rental managers can create a meshable WiFi guest network with a custom-branded WiFi login page that collects guest information. Our software lets them monitor their network remotely and integrates with their marketing tools to help them build relationships with their guests and grow their business.


Over the past 8 years, we’ve built our business from the ground up without the help of large investors. This means we’re growing a sustainable business and we run it independently. We’re a small team so each team member has a big impact on our product and business. And we’re creating tools that our customers truly love.


About You
  • You're a senior full stack Ruby on Rails developer with 7+ years of professional experience building and shipping production applications.
  • You're a product-minded engineer who takes ownership. You think beyond each task / ticket and consider the broader impact of your technical decisions on the business.
  • You write expressive, readable, and maintainable code and hold yourself and others to a high standard through thoughtful code reviews.
  • You have a strong command of Rails conventions but know when and how to diverge from them pragmatically.
  • You're comfortable navigating and improving legacy codebases, not just greenfield projects.
  • You're curious about IoT, WiFi, and building sophisticated 3rd party API integrations.

  • You're energized by working on a small team where your decisions carry real weight.


About the Role
  • Write full stack code using Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, React and JavaScript, and deploy it via Heroku, Azure and AWS.
  • Take ownership of large, complex projects: from scoping and architecture through to delivery in close collaboration with the CTO.
  • Identify and address performance bottlenecks, technical debt, and architectural weaknesses proactively.
  • Build and maintain robust API integrations with 3rd party software providers.
  • Lead by example in pull request culture; writing clear descriptions, giving constructive feedback, and raising the bar for the whole team.

  • Contribute to engineering standards, tooling decisions, and best practices as a senior voice on the team.


Why Work at StayFi?
  • You'll work directly with the CTO and CEO on mission-critical projects with real ownership and autonomy.
  • Your experience and judgment will directly shape the technical direction of the product.
  • You'll have an outsized impact both within our company and across the vacation rental industry  in a way that's rarely possible at larger organizations.
  • As you continue to help our business grow, you can expect increases in your salary or hourly rate.

  • You'll gain visibility into the full lifecycle of a sustainable, founder-led business well beyond just writing code.

title: Senior Data Engineer

Data Engineer

Brazil

Data Analyst II

Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


As a SQL & Snowflake Engineer, you will play a key role in the full development lifecycle, translating complex data structures into actionable technical insights with a specific focus on Snowflake and SQL queries. You will be responsible for both querying and analyzing large datasets within the Data Lake to support feature development, ensuring seamless data availability from ingestion through to reporting within an Agile framework. Beyond technical execution, you will act as a key contributor in data modeling, actively participating in technical discussions to help the engineering team understand underlying data patterns and quality issues.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Digest requirements from the engineering team and specify the implementation of complex SQL queries;
  • Analyze and map underlying data schemas within Snowflake to support application logic;
  • Optimize SQL performance for large-scale data retrieval and reporting;
  • Follow Agile processes and participate actively in data exploration phases;
  • Participate in technical discussions, data quality reviews, and schema design sessions.

Essential Skills


  • Solid Experience with Snowflake (architecture, warehousing, and data sharing);
  • Strong proficiency in Advanced SQL (CTEs, Window Functions, Stored Procedures);
  • Familiarity with ETL/ELT processes and data ingestion tools;
  • Solid experience with version control for database scripts (Git, Liquibase, or dbt).

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Cloud knowledge (AWS/Azure/GCP) regarding data storage (S3/Blob);
  • Experience with Python or scripting for data manipulation;
  • Familiarity with semi-structured data (JSON, Parquet) with Snowflake.

Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Technical Product Owner
description:
ABOUT US

Syniti , part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.

Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy.

Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.


Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.


THE ROLE

We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.



What You’ll Do

  • Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.
  • Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.
  • UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP.
  • Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.
  • Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior.
  • Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.



WHAT IT TAKES

  • The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure).
  • The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus.
  • The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication.
  • The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams.
  • The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience.
  • The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.


Key Skills

  • Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals.
  • Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules.
  • AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic.
  • Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment.
  • Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity.
  • Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement.
  • Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment.


Be fully aligned with our core values:

Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.

Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.

Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.

Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.


By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.


WHAT WE OFFER

  • Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing.
  • Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
  • Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
  • Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all.
  • Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.
  • An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued.

title: Senior Ruby on Rails Engineer
description:
About StayFi

StayFi combines IoT and marketing technology for the vacation rental industry (think Airbnb hosts). With our product, vacation rental managers can create a meshable WiFi guest network with a custom-branded WiFi login page that collects guest information. Our software lets them monitor their network remotely and integrates with their marketing tools to help them build relationships with their guests and grow their business.


Over the past 8 years, we’ve built our business from the ground up without the help of large investors. This means we’re growing a sustainable business and we run it independently. We’re a small team so each team member has a big impact on our product and business. And we’re creating tools that our customers truly love.


About You
  • You're a senior full stack Ruby on Rails developer with 7+ years of professional experience building and shipping production applications.
  • You're a product-minded engineer who takes ownership. You think beyond each task / ticket and consider the broader impact of your technical decisions on the business.
  • You write expressive, readable, and maintainable code and hold yourself and others to a high standard through thoughtful code reviews.
  • You have a strong command of Rails conventions but know when and how to diverge from them pragmatically.
  • You're comfortable navigating and improving legacy codebases, not just greenfield projects.
  • You're curious about IoT, WiFi, and building sophisticated 3rd party API integrations.

  • You're energized by working on a small team where your decisions carry real weight.


About the Role
  • Write full stack code using Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, React and JavaScript, and deploy it via Heroku, Azure and AWS.
  • Take ownership of large, complex projects: from scoping and architecture through to delivery in close collaboration with the CTO.
  • Identify and address performance bottlenecks, technical debt, and architectural weaknesses proactively.
  • Build and maintain robust API integrations with 3rd party software providers.
  • Lead by example in pull request culture; writing clear descriptions, giving constructive feedback, and raising the bar for the whole team.

  • Contribute to engineering standards, tooling decisions, and best practices as a senior voice on the team.


Why Work at StayFi?
  • You'll work directly with the CTO and CEO on mission-critical projects with real ownership and autonomy.
  • Your experience and judgment will directly shape the technical direction of the product.
  • You'll have an outsized impact both within our company and across the vacation rental industry  in a way that's rarely possible at larger organizations.
  • As you continue to help our business grow, you can expect increases in your salary or hourly rate.

  • You'll gain visibility into the full lifecycle of a sustainable, founder-led business well beyond just writing code.

title: Technical Product Owner
description:
ABOUT US

Syniti , part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.

Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy.

Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.


Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.


THE ROLE

We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.



What You’ll Do

  • Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.
  • Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.
  • UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP.
  • Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.
  • Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior.
  • Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.



WHAT IT TAKES

  • The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure).
  • The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus.
  • The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication.
  • The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams.
  • The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience.
  • The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.


Key Skills

  • Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals.
  • Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules.
  • AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic.
  • Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment.
  • Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity.
  • Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement.
  • Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment.


Be fully aligned with our core values:

Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.

Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.

Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.

Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.


By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.


WHAT WE OFFER

  • Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing.
  • Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
  • Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
  • Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all.
  • Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.
  • An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued.


OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION

At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.

We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: Full Stack Engineer (React.js/Node.js)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Full Stack Engineer with 5+ years of full stack development experience and a strong background in React.js and Node.js. You will join our clients engineering team and transform ideas and user feedback into positive experiences. You will work closely with other engineers and the user experience team iterating on designs and releasing them. Your responsibilities will include end-to-end feature development from web interfaces to backend APIs to the database. You will also communicate with the clients customers understanding their needs so you can build features with them that deliver on what you learn.


The client fosters collaboration and a close-knit working environment within its development team valuing inclusion and independent thought from its members. The client will support you as you onboard and grow within your new role, and they expect you to provide the same support to other team members. You will manage your own workload by participating in sprint planning, voicing concerns, advocating for desirable development outcomes, and proactively addressing issues. The right candidate will join a team built to produce great software!


Successful full stack engineers must have in-depth knowledge of web development concepts, a solid understanding of API and relational database design, excellent coding skills, familiarity with single page applications, and an eagerness to learn.


Our client makes trust building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The clients software platform allows companies quickly and cost effectively to adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure the efficacy of those programs against compliance standards, and share program achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simply to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable so businesses gain transparency into compliance status.


Responsibilities


  • Collaborate with User Experience and Product teams creating end-to-end, new feature designs
  • Build applications and APIs in JavaScript using React.js and Node.js
  • Develop and implement highly responsive UI components
  • Create data models using RDBMS principles implementing them in PostgreSQL
  • Troubleshoot interfaces and debug applications
  • Monitor and improve end-to-end performance
  • Communicate with and support our customers helping them find and build solutions to their problems


Required Experience


  • Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills
  • 5+ years of full stack software development experience writing single page applications that talk to API back-ends with a strong background with React.js, Node.js, JavaScript, CSS, and HTML
  • Well-developed understanding of front-end concepts and different frameworks
  • Strong back-end experience designing APIs and domain models
  • Experience working in an (preferred), GCP, , or other cloud environments
  • Experience designing RDBMSs to support real-world application usage
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills and experience with browser-based debugging and performance-testing software
  • A focus on customer value delivery
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Great listening skills and a willingness to understand what customers and team members need to achieve success
  • A collaborative approach, a can do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems
  • A willingness to learn from others and admit when youve made a mistake


Desired Experience


  • University degree in computer sciences/engineering or related field


Additional Information


  • Typical week is 40-45 hours, Monday Friday
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and your national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


Core Client Values


  • The clients values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.
  • Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders proving we are dependable.
  • Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team.
  • Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. Theres no excuse for being a jerk.
  • Evidence-Based Decisions : Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners.
  • Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do.
  • Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger.
  • The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people onboard from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.


About Velozient


We are a privately-held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

The client will support you as you onboard and grow within your new role, and they expect you to provide the same support to other team members. You will manage your own workload by participating in sprint planning, voicing concerns, advocating for desirable development outcomes, and proactively addressing issues. The right candidate will join a team built to produce great software!


Successful full stack engineers must have in-depth knowledge of web development concepts, a solid understanding of API and relational database design, excellent coding skills, familiarity with single page applications, and an eagerness to learn.


Our client makes trust building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The clients software platform allows companies quickly and cost effectively to adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure the efficacy of those programs against compliance standards, and share program achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simply to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable so businesses gain transparency into compliance status.


Responsibilities


  • Collaborate with User Experience and Product teams creating end-to-end, new feature designs
  • Build applications and APIs in JavaScript using React.js and Node.js
  • Develop and implement highly responsive UI components
  • Create data models using RDBMS principles implementing them in PostgreSQL
  • Troubleshoot interfaces and debug applications
  • Monitor and improve end-to-end performance
  • Communicate with and support our customers helping them find and build solutions to their problems


Required Experience


  • Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills
  • 5+ years of full stack software development experience writing single page applications that talk to API back-ends with a strong background with React.js, Node.js, JavaScript, CSS, and HTML
  • Well-developed understanding of front-end concepts and different frameworks
  • Strong back-end experience designing APIs and domain models
  • Experience working in an (preferred), GCP, , or other cloud environments
  • Experience designing RDBMSs to support real-world application usage
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills and experience with browser-based debugging and performance-testing software
  • A focus on customer value delivery
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Great listening skills and a willingness to understand what customers and team members need to achieve success
  • A collaborative approach, a can do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems
  • A willingness to learn from others and admit when youve made a mistake


Desired Experience


  • University degree in computer sciences/engineering or related field


Additional Information


  • Typical week is 40-45 hours, Monday Friday
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and your national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


Core Client Values


  • The clients values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.
  • Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders proving we are dependable.
  • Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team.
  • Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. Theres no excuse for being a jerk.
  • Evidence-Based Decisions : Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners.
  • Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do.
  • Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger.
  • The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people onboard from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.


About Velozient


We are a privately-held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Pessoa Executiva de Vendas Pleno
description:
A Knewin é a maior empresa de tecnologia e inteligência de dados da América Latina, com 15 anos de mercado, mais de 200 pessoas e presença consolidada no ecossistema de comunicação, marketing e inteligência de mercado. Desenvolvemos soluções de tecnologia que empoderam marcas, de assessorias de imprensa e agências de relações públicas a grandes empresas e governos.

Somos uma empresa em forte expansão, com três rodadas de capital de risco realizadas (Oria Capital), cultura ágil e um time que acredita que tecnologia e pessoas transformam negócios de verdade.


Estamos buscando um(a) Executivo(a) de Vendas para atuar no segmento Mid Market e Enterprise , com perfil híbrido : capaz de fechar novos negócios com leads gerados pelo Marketing, desenvolver prospecção ativa (outbound) e explorar oportunidades de Upsell e Cross-sell dentro da base de clientes existente.

Essa é uma vaga para quem tem mentalidade de crescimento, visão de negócio e sabe construir relações consultivas com decisores de comunicação e marketing em empresas de médio e grande porte.

Vaga 100% remota - Home Office


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atuar no ciclo completo de vendas: da qualificação ao fechamento, com contas Mid Market e Enterprise;
  • Trabalhar leads qualificados gerados pelo Marketing (inbound), com foco em conversão eficiente;
  • Executar prospecção outbound ativa, mapeando contas estratégicas, personalizando abordagens e gerando pipeline próprio;
  • Identificar e desenvolver oportunidades de Upsell e Cross-sell dentro da base de clientes atual, em parceria com o time de Customer Success;
  • Conduzir apresentações e demos consultivas das soluções Knewin, adaptando o discurso ao contexto e às dores de cada cliente;
  • Construir e manter relacionamento sólido com múltiplos stakeholders (comunicação, marketing, C-level);
  • Mapear o processo decisório do cliente e influenciar cada etapa do funil;
  • Manter o CRM (HubSpot) atualizado com precisão e disciplina, garantindo previsibilidade de pipeline;
  • Elaborar propostas comerciais personalizadas e conduzir negociações complexas;
  • Colaborar ativamente com Marketing, CS e RevOps para otimizar conversão e reduzir churn.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência comprovada em vendas B2B SaaS, com ciclos de venda consultivos e tickets médios/altos;
  • Experiência com contas Mid Market ou Enterprise;
  • Histórico de atuação híbrida: capacidade tanto de converter inbound quanto de gerar pipeline outbound;
  • Experiência com vendas consultivas;
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com habilidade real de se comunicar com decisores;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de CRM, HubSpot é diferencial;
  • Ensino superior completo.


Também é legal se você tiver:

  • Vivência em ambientes de scale-up e/ou startups em crescimento acelerado ou empresas de tecnologia;
  • Familiaridade com HubSpot.
  • Carteira ou relacionamento com profissionais de Comunicação e Marketing em empresas de médio/grande porte;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de prospecção e automação (ex: Apollo, Lusha, LinkedIn Sales Navigator);
  • Conhecimento do ecossistema de agências de PR e assessorias de imprensa;


O que oferecemos:

  • Trabalho 100% remoto - Home Office;
  • Política de remuneração variável agressiva - com comissionamento competitivo e upside real atrelado à sua performance;
  • Pacote de benefícios Knewin;
  • Produto consolidado com cases relevantes no mercado;
  • Time comercial estruturado com suporte de Marketing, RevOps e CS;
  • Ambiente dinâmico, flexível e com autonomia real;
  • Oportunidade de crescimento em uma empresa em fase de expansão acelerada.

Com mais de 40 anos de mercado e localizada em 20 países, a GFT emprega mais de 18.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo quase 5.000 pessoas no Brasil.

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.

Digital Engagement

  • Chat
  • WhatsApp
  • Bots

  • Configurar e ajustar Omni-Channel Routing para distribuição de atendimentos.

  • Apoiar atividades de troubleshooting e análise de logs.
  • Garantir aderência às boas práticas da plataforma Salesforce.

  • Colaborar com o time técnico na evolução contínua da solução.

Plataforma Salesforce

Integrações

  • SOAP

Atendimento Omnichannel

  • Conhecimento em Omni-Channel Routing.

Digital Engagement

  • Noções ou experiência com:
  • Chat
  • WhatsApp
  • Bots

Plataforma

  • Conhecimento sobre governor limits da plataforma Salesforce.

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;

title: Desenvolvimento Salesforce Pleno/Sênior (Digital Engagement)
description:
Já conhece a GFT?

Com mais de 40 anos de mercado e localizada em 20 países, a GFT emprega mais de 18.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo quase 5.000 pessoas no Brasil.

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.

Promovemos uma cultura de desenvolvimento e crescimento pautadas no nosso pilar de Continuous Scaled Learning porque acreditamos o uso inteligente da tecnologia é a chave para o sucesso nesse mundo digital.


O que buscamos:

Profissional de nível Pleno/Sênior que atue com Salesforce (Digital Engagement)



Responsabilidades:

Desenvolvimento Salesforce

  • Desenvolver funcionalidades na plataforma Salesforce Service Cloud.
  • Criar e evoluir soluções utilizando Apex.
  • Desenvolver componentes utilizando Lightning Web Components (LWC).
  • Criar e manter Flows para automação de processos.

Digital Engagement

  • Apoiar implementações de Digital Engagement, incluindo:
  • Chat
  • WhatsApp
  • Bots

Omnichannel & Atendimento

  • Configurar e ajustar Omni-Channel Routing para distribuição de atendimentos.

Integrações

  • Desenvolver integrações com sistemas externos utilizando:
  • APIs REST
  • APIs SOAP

Qualidade e Suporte

  • Apoiar atividades de troubleshooting e análise de logs.
  • Garantir aderência às boas práticas da plataforma Salesforce.
  • Garantir conformidade com governor limits.

DevOps e Entrega

  • Participar de deploys e versionamento de código.
  • Colaborar com o time técnico na evolução contínua da solução.


Requisitos Técnicos:

Plataforma Salesforce

  • Experiência com Salesforce Service Cloud.

Desenvolvimento

  • Experiência com Apex.
  • Experiência com Lightning Web Components (LWC).

Automação

  • Experiência com Salesforce Flows.

Integrações

  • Experiência com integrações via:
  • REST
  • SOAP

Atendimento Omnichannel

  • Conhecimento em Omni-Channel Routing.

Digital Engagement

  • Noções ou experiência com:
  • Chat
  • WhatsApp
  • Bots

Plataforma

  • Conhecimento sobre governor limits da plataforma Salesforce.


Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.


O que oferecemos:

  • Cartão multi-benefícios – você escolhe como e onde utilizar;
  • Bolsas de Estudos para cursos de Graduação, Pós, MBA e Idiomas;
  • Programas de incentivo à Certificações;
  • Horário de trabalho flexível;
  • Plano personalizado de carreira e possibilidade de carreira internacional;
  • Salários competitivos;
  • Avaliação de desempenho anual com possibilidade de bonificação;

  • Assistência Odontológica;

title: Pessoa Executiva de Vendas Pleno
description:
A Knewin é a maior empresa de tecnologia e inteligência de dados da América Latina, com 15 anos de mercado, mais de 200 pessoas e presença consolidada no ecossistema de comunicação, marketing e inteligência de mercado. Desenvolvemos soluções de tecnologia que empoderam marcas, de assessorias de imprensa e agências de relações públicas a grandes empresas e governos.

Somos uma empresa em forte expansão, com três rodadas de capital de risco realizadas (Oria Capital), cultura ágil e um time que acredita que tecnologia e pessoas transformam negócios de verdade.


Estamos buscando um(a) Executivo(a) de Vendas para atuar no segmento Mid Market e Enterprise , com perfil híbrido : capaz de fechar novos negócios com leads gerados pelo Marketing, desenvolver prospecção ativa (outbound) e explorar oportunidades de Upsell e Cross-sell dentro da base de clientes existente.

Essa é uma vaga para quem tem mentalidade de crescimento, visão de negócio e sabe construir relações consultivas com decisores de comunicação e marketing em empresas de médio e grande porte.

Vaga 100% remota - Home Office


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atuar no ciclo completo de vendas: da qualificação ao fechamento, com contas Mid Market e Enterprise;
  • Trabalhar leads qualificados gerados pelo Marketing (inbound), com foco em conversão eficiente;
  • Executar prospecção outbound ativa, mapeando contas estratégicas, personalizando abordagens e gerando pipeline próprio;
  • Identificar e desenvolver oportunidades de Upsell e Cross-sell dentro da base de clientes atual, em parceria com o time de Customer Success;
  • Conduzir apresentações e demos consultivas das soluções Knewin, adaptando o discurso ao contexto e às dores de cada cliente;
  • Construir e manter relacionamento sólido com múltiplos stakeholders (comunicação, marketing, C-level);
  • Mapear o processo decisório do cliente e influenciar cada etapa do funil;
  • Manter o CRM (HubSpot) atualizado com precisão e disciplina, garantindo previsibilidade de pipeline;
  • Elaborar propostas comerciais personalizadas e conduzir negociações complexas;
  • Colaborar ativamente com Marketing, CS e RevOps para otimizar conversão e reduzir churn.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência comprovada em vendas B2B SaaS, com ciclos de venda consultivos e tickets médios/altos;
  • Experiência com contas Mid Market ou Enterprise;
  • Histórico de atuação híbrida: capacidade tanto de converter inbound quanto de gerar pipeline outbound;
  • Experiência com vendas consultivas;
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com habilidade real de se comunicar com decisores;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de CRM, HubSpot é diferencial;
  • Ensino superior completo.


Também é legal se você tiver:

  • Vivência em ambientes de scale-up e/ou startups em crescimento acelerado ou empresas de tecnologia;
  • Familiaridade com HubSpot.
  • Carteira ou relacionamento com profissionais de Comunicação e Marketing em empresas de médio/grande porte;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de prospecção e automação (ex: Apollo, Lusha, LinkedIn Sales Navigator);
  • Conhecimento do ecossistema de agências de PR e assessorias de imprensa;


O que oferecemos:

  • Trabalho 100% remoto - Home Office;
  • Política de remuneração variável agressiva - com comissionamento competitivo e upside real atrelado à sua performance;
  • Pacote de benefícios Knewin;
  • Produto consolidado com cases relevantes no mercado;
  • Time comercial estruturado com suporte de Marketing, RevOps e CS;
  • Ambiente dinâmico, flexível e com autonomia real;
  • Oportunidade de crescimento em uma empresa em fase de expansão acelerada.
