title: Senior Backend Engineer (Node.js) | Integração
description:
Descrição da Empresa: A Carefy é uma plataforma especializada em auditoria para operadoras de planos de saúde, utilizando inteligência artificial para combater fraudes e desperdícios no ciclo de atendimento. Combinamos tecnologia avançada e expertise em fluxos de auditoria para gerar economias significativas para nossos clientes. Nosso impacto abrange mais de 8 milhões de pessoas, trabalhando com operadoras líderes como Hapvida e Porto Seguro. Somos movidos pelo compromisso de transformar decisões complexas e melhorar a sustentabilidade do setor de saúde.


Descrição do Cargo: Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Desenvolvedora Backend Sênior com forte visão arquitetural e experiência em sistemas de alta escalabilidade para atuar no time de integração da Carefy. Esse cargo envolve o desenho e desenvolvimento de soluções para garantir a interoperabilidade da plataforma com os sistemas das operadoras de saúde, assegurando fluxo de dados com segurança e alta performance.

Você deverá propor soluções, analisar requisitos técnicos e colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para entregar projetos de alto impacto. Atuará como referência técnica, participando diretamente da definição de arquiteturas junto aos times de TI dos clientes e traduzindo desafios complexos em soluções estruturadas para o time interno. Também será responsável por elevar o nível técnico da equipe por meio da definição de padrões de engenharia, disseminação de boas práticas e organização das demandas.


Qualificações

  • Acima de 6 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software
  • Acima de 4 anos com Node.js e TypeScript em produção
  • Acima de 4 anos com bancos relacionais (MySQL), incluindo modelagem e otimização
  • Experiência com arquitetura de software (Clean Architecture, Hexagonal, DDD)
  • Experiência com cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure) e mensageria (RabbitMQ/Kafka)
  • Experiência com APIs RESTful escaláveis
  • Experiência em ambientes de alta criticidade e alto volume de dados
  • Domínio de frameworks como NestJS e/ou Next.js
  • Conhecimento em testes automatizados (TDD, unitários e integração)
  • Habilidade para trabalho colaborativo
  • Visão sistêmica e entendimento do impacto técnico no produto
  • Comunicação assertiva com clientes e time interno
  • Autonomia para conduzir projetos complexos e gerenciar riscos
  • Forte capacidade de resolução de problemas com foco na causa raiz


Será um diferencial:

  • Experiência com PHP: Temos legado e integrações onde esse conhecimento será muito útil para modernização;
  • Experiência na sustentação de aplicações escaláveis utilizando Kubernetes e Terraform;
  • Vivência com pipelines de CI/CD (Bitbucket Pipelines, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, etc.);
  • Conhecimentos em Segurança da Informação (OWASP, OAuth2).


Atribuições:

  • Interface Técnica com Clientes: Atuar como ponto focal em reuniões com os times de TI dos clientes (operadoras de saúde) para alinhar requisitos de integração, layouts de dados e especificações de API;
  • Gestão e Organização Técnica: Traduzir requisitos de negócio em tarefas técnicas claras, quebrando demandas complexas em entregáveis menores para orientar o trabalho dos desenvolvedores Juniors e Plenos;
  • Arquitetura e Design: Projetar e desenvolver soluções escaláveis, resilientes e de alta performance utilizando Node.js (NestJS/Next.js);
  • Sustentação e Confiabilidade: Atuar na manutenção dos sistemas em produção, identificando, diagnosticando e corrigindo bugs e falhas (em sistemas, fontes de dados e APIs) de forma ágil para garantir a continuidade dos serviços;
  • Mentoria e Qualidade: Realizar Code Reviews rigorosos e disseminar boas práticas (Clean Code, SOLID), elevando a barra técnica da equipe;
  • Padronização e Performance: Definir padrões de desenvolvimento e identificar gargalos de performance em cenários de alto volume de dados.


 O que oferecemos?

  • Modalidade Flexível: Híbrido ou 100% Remoto
  • Possibilidade de regime CLT ou PJ;
  • Se CLT, convênio com Bradesco Saúde e Cartão Flash (VR);
  • Ambiente colaborativo e desafiador;
  • Horários flexíveis;
  • Autonomia para propor e implementar novas tecnologias!

title: Workday Adaptive Planning Consultant
description:
Job Summary

Client is seeking a senior-level Workday Adaptive Planning Consultant to lead the architecture, design, and build of complex planning solutions. This individual will be a hands-on consultant responsible for developing scalable planning models, supporting integrations across Adaptive Planning and Oracle platforms, and partnering with Finance, RevOps, Data, and IT teams to deliver business-critical planning capabilities. The ideal candidate will bring deep Adaptive Planning expertise, strong financial planning knowledge, and the ability to translate business requirements into high-impact system solutions.


Key Responsibilities

  • Architect, design, and build scalable planning models in Workday Adaptive Planning
  • Develop and optimize complex models including dimensions, sheets, versions, assumptions, and driver-based logic
  • Design, support, and improve integrations and data workflows across Adaptive Planning and Oracle platforms
  • Partner with Finance, RevOps, Data, and IT teams to translate planning requirements into sustainable system solutions
  • Troubleshoot model and integration issues and improve overall system performance, scalability, and usability
  • Create clear documentation and provide knowledge transfer to support long-term ownership and adoption
  • Act as a senior consultant, owning delivery quality and supporting key stakeholder relationships


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of hands-on Workday Adaptive Planning experience
  • Proven experience architecting and building Adaptive Planning solutions, not just maintaining existing models
  • Deep expertise in:
  • Dimensions
  • Sheets
  • Versions
  • Assumptions
  • Driver-based planning logic
  • Complex calculations
  • Performance tuning and model optimization
  • Proven experience integrating Workday Adaptive Planning with Oracle EPM and/or Oracle ERP
  • Strong understanding of planning data structures, financial data flows, and integration best practices
  • Strong knowledge of financial planning and FP&A processes , including budgeting and forecasting
  • Ability to connect technical configuration decisions to business and financial outcomes
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex models to non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Finance, RevOps, Data, and IT

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting SaaS or recurring revenue business models
  • Experience leading or influencing Adaptive Planning best practices and standards
  • Background in multi-entity or high-growth organizations
  • Prior consulting or advisory experience in complex planning environments

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • Senior, hands-on consultant comfortable owning solution delivery end to end
  • Strong technical builder with business-facing communication skills
  • Able to operate independently while partnering across multiple functional teams
  • Skilled at balancing architecture, execution, troubleshooting, and stakeholder management

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Role Overview


Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company’s foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration.


Key Responsibilities


Business Process Engineering (Core Expectation)

  • Conduct needs assessments with department leads to identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes.
  • Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes.
  • Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations.
  • Manage change adoption by providing training, documentation, and ongoing support for newly implemented tools.

Automation, Integration & AI Implementation

  • Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our SaaS ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, JavaScript).
  • Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks.
  • Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software.

IT Administration & Security

  • Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365).
  • Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access.
  • Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security.
  • Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate SaaS contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl.


Required Qualifications & Skills


Technical Experience:

  • 5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration.
  • Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment.
  • Strong understanding of cloud-based SaaS ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures.
  • High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting.
  • Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows.
  • Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols.


Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies:

  • Communication: Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity.
  • Critical Thinking: Strong analytical approach to problem-solving; ability to identify the root causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms.
  • Decision-Making: Highly autonomous execution; capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions.


Benefits & Compensation

  • Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

description:
A Jusfy está em busca de uma pessoa Senior Full Stack Developer com forte atuação em backend e experiência em contextos de pagamentos para compor o time de tecnologia.


Somos uma empresa jovem e muito promissora. Alcançamos resultados expressivos de crescimento nos últimos anos e sabemos que temos ainda muito mais para conquistar. Buscamos profissionais que queiram fazer parte dessa trajetória junto conosco!

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex models to non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Finance, RevOps, Data, and IT

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting SaaS or recurring revenue business models
  • Experience leading or influencing Adaptive Planning best practices and standards
  • Background in multi-entity or high-growth organizations
  • Prior consulting or advisory experience in complex planning environments

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • Senior, hands-on consultant comfortable owning solution delivery end to end
  • Strong technical builder with business-facing communication skills
  • Able to operate independently while partnering across multiple functional teams
  • Skilled at balancing architecture, execution, troubleshooting, and stakeholder management

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Role Overview


Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company’s foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration.


Key Responsibilities


Business Process Engineering (Core Expectation)

  • Conduct needs assessments with department leads to identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes.
  • Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes.
  • Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations.
  • Manage change adoption by providing training, documentation, and ongoing support for newly implemented tools.

Automation, Integration & AI Implementation

  • Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our SaaS ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, JavaScript).
  • Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks.
  • Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software.

IT Administration & Security

  • Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365).
  • Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access.
  • Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security.
  • Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate SaaS contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl.


Required Qualifications & Skills


Technical Experience:

  • 5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration.
  • Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment.
  • Strong understanding of cloud-based SaaS ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures.
  • High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting.
  • Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows.
  • Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols.


Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies:

  • Communication: Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity.
  • Critical Thinking: Strong analytical approach to problem-solving; ability to identify the root causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms.
  • Decision-Making: Highly autonomous execution; capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions.


Benefits & Compensation

  • Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Role Overview


Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company’s foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration.


Key Responsibilities


Business Process Engineering (Core Expectation)

  • Conduct needs assessments with department leads to identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes.
  • Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes.
  • Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations.
  • Manage change adoption by providing training, documentation, and ongoing support for newly implemented tools.

Automation, Integration & AI Implementation

  • Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our SaaS ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, JavaScript).
  • Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks.
  • Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software.

IT Administration & Security

  • Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365).
  • Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access.
  • Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security.
  • Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate SaaS contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl.


Required Qualifications & Skills


Technical Experience:

  • 5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration.
  • Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment.
  • Strong understanding of cloud-based SaaS ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures.
  • High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting.
  • Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows.
  • Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols.


Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies:

  • Communication: Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity.
  • Critical Thinking: Strong analytical approach to problem-solving; ability to identify the root causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms.
  • Decision-Making: Highly autonomous execution; capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions.


Benefits & Compensation

  • Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description:
A Jusfy está em busca de uma pessoa Senior Full Stack Developer com forte atuação em backend e experiência em contextos de pagamentos para compor o time de tecnologia.


Somos uma empresa jovem e muito promissora. Alcançamos resultados expressivos de crescimento nos últimos anos e sabemos que temos ainda muito mais para conquistar. Buscamos profissionais que queiram fazer parte dessa trajetória junto conosco!


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver novas funcionalidades utilizando ReactJS e APIs RESTful, com forte atuação em backend utilizando Node.js e Express, principalmente em soluções relacionadas ao contexto de pagamentos;
  • Escrever códigos limpos, de alta qualidade e fácil manutenção seguindo as boas práticas de desenvolvimento;
  • Colaborar com a equipe de tecnologia (Engenharia, Produto e Design) para o sucesso dos projetos;
  • Participar ativamente em discussões de arquitetura e tecnologias;
  • Realizar code reviews, ajudando outros desenvolvedores a melhorar a qualidade do código;
  • Garantir que a documentação do código e arquitetura esteja sempre atualizada.


Requisitos técnicos:

  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de Backend e Frontend, com maior profundidade em backend;
  • Experiência em Typescript e API REST;
  • Experiência ou vivência com integrações e contextos de pagamentos (gateways, billing, recorrência, webhooks ou similares);
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e não-relacionais;
  • Orquestração de containers (Docker e docker-compose);
  • Conhecimento em Styled Components e Context API;
  • Experiência com controle de versão utilizando Git.


Desejável:

  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis;
  • Experiência em times de desenvolvimento de software ou empresas de tecnologia;
  • Conhecimento em testes automatizados e ferramentas de integração contínua;
  • Conhecimento de Design Patterns;
  • Habilidade para trabalhar em equipe e boa comunicação;
  • Boa habilidade de resolução de problemas e pensamento crítico.


Modelo de Contratação:

PJ


Oferecemos :

Cartão flexível de benefícios.

Rotina remota de trabalho;

Ambiente de trabalho descontraído e inovador;

Oportunidade de trabalhar em projetos desafiadores e com grande impacto.



Como se candidatar

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 33 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 3 mil funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

Front-end: React e Next.js com Chakra UI, aplicando boas práticas de componentização e responsividade Back-end: Desenvolvimento de APIs e serviços em NestJS, executando sobre Node.js

Experiencia com TypeScript, com sólida base em JavaScript

Diferencial: Experiência com Google Cloud Platform (GCP) e bancos de dados PostgreSQL


- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Workday Adaptive Planning Consultant
description:
Job Summary

Client is seeking a senior-level Workday Adaptive Planning Consultant to lead the architecture, design, and build of complex planning solutions. This individual will be a hands-on consultant responsible for developing scalable planning models, supporting integrations across Adaptive Planning and Oracle platforms, and partnering with Finance, RevOps, Data, and IT teams to deliver business-critical planning capabilities. The ideal candidate will bring deep Adaptive Planning expertise, strong financial planning knowledge, and the ability to translate business requirements into high-impact system solutions.


Key Responsibilities

  • Architect, design, and build scalable planning models in Workday Adaptive Planning
  • Develop and optimize complex models including dimensions, sheets, versions, assumptions, and driver-based logic
  • Design, support, and improve integrations and data workflows across Adaptive Planning and Oracle platforms
  • Partner with Finance, RevOps, Data, and IT teams to translate planning requirements into sustainable system solutions
  • Troubleshoot model and integration issues and improve overall system performance, scalability, and usability
  • Create clear documentation and provide knowledge transfer to support long-term ownership and adoption
  • Act as a senior consultant, owning delivery quality and supporting key stakeholder relationships


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of hands-on Workday Adaptive Planning experience
  • Proven experience architecting and building Adaptive Planning solutions, not just maintaining existing models
  • Deep expertise in:
  • Dimensions
  • Sheets
  • Versions
  • Assumptions
  • Driver-based planning logic
  • Complex calculations
  • Performance tuning and model optimization
  • Proven experience integrating Workday Adaptive Planning with Oracle EPM and/or Oracle ERP
  • Strong understanding of planning data structures, financial data flows, and integration best practices
  • Strong knowledge of financial planning and FP&A processes , including budgeting and forecasting
  • Ability to connect technical configuration decisions to business and financial outcomes
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex models to non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Finance, RevOps, Data, and IT

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting SaaS or recurring revenue business models
  • Experience leading or influencing Adaptive Planning best practices and standards
  • Background in multi-entity or high-growth organizations
  • Prior consulting or advisory experience in complex planning environments

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • Senior, hands-on consultant comfortable owning solution delivery end to end
  • Strong technical builder with business-facing communication skills
  • Able to operate independently while partnering across multiple functional teams
  • Skilled at balancing architecture, execution, troubleshooting, and stakeholder management

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Role Overview


Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company’s foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration.


Key Responsibilities


Business Process Engineering (Core Expectation)

  • Conduct needs assessments with department leads to identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes.
  • Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes.
  • Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations.
  • Manage change adoption by providing training, documentation, and ongoing support for newly implemented tools.

Automation, Integration & AI Implementation

  • Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our SaaS ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, JavaScript).
  • Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks.
  • Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software.

IT Administration & Security

  • Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365).
  • Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access.
  • Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security.
  • Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate SaaS contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl.


Required Qualifications & Skills


Technical Experience:

  • 5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration.
  • Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment.
  • Strong understanding of cloud-based SaaS ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures.
  • High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting.
  • Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows.
  • Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols.


Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies:

  • Communication: Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity.
  • Critical Thinking: Strong analytical approach to problem-solving; ability to identify the root causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms.
  • Decision-Making: Highly autonomous execution; capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions.


Benefits & Compensation

  • Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

title: Workday Adaptive Planning Consultant
description:
Job Summary

Client is seeking a senior-level Workday Adaptive Planning Consultant to lead the architecture, design, and build of complex planning solutions. This individual will be a hands-on consultant responsible for developing scalable planning models, supporting integrations across Adaptive Planning and Oracle platforms, and partnering with Finance, RevOps, Data, and IT teams to deliver business-critical planning capabilities. The ideal candidate will bring deep Adaptive Planning expertise, strong financial planning knowledge, and the ability to translate business requirements into high-impact system solutions.


Key Responsibilities

  • Architect, design, and build scalable planning models in Workday Adaptive Planning
  • Develop and optimize complex models including dimensions, sheets, versions, assumptions, and driver-based logic
  • Design, support, and improve integrations and data workflows across Adaptive Planning and Oracle platforms
  • Partner with Finance, RevOps, Data, and IT teams to translate planning requirements into sustainable system solutions
  • Troubleshoot model and integration issues and improve overall system performance, scalability, and usability
  • Create clear documentation and provide knowledge transfer to support long-term ownership and adoption
  • Act as a senior consultant, owning delivery quality and supporting key stakeholder relationships


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of hands-on Workday Adaptive Planning experience
  • Proven experience architecting and building Adaptive Planning solutions, not just maintaining existing models
  • Deep expertise in:
  • Dimensions
  • Sheets
  • Versions
  • Assumptions
  • Driver-based planning logic
  • Complex calculations
  • Performance tuning and model optimization
  • Proven experience integrating Workday Adaptive Planning with Oracle EPM and/or Oracle ERP
  • Strong understanding of planning data structures, financial data flows, and integration best practices
  • Strong knowledge of financial planning and FP&A processes , including budgeting and forecasting
  • Ability to connect technical configuration decisions to business and financial outcomes
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex models to non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Finance, RevOps, Data, and IT

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting SaaS or recurring revenue business models
  • Experience leading or influencing Adaptive Planning best practices and standards
  • Background in multi-entity or high-growth organizations
  • Prior consulting or advisory experience in complex planning environments

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • Senior, hands-on consultant comfortable owning solution delivery end to end
  • Strong technical builder with business-facing communication skills
  • Able to operate independently while partnering across multiple functional teams
  • Skilled at balancing architecture, execution, troubleshooting, and stakeholder management

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Role Overview


Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company’s foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration.


Key Responsibilities


Business Process Engineering (Core Expectation)

  • Conduct needs assessments with department leads to identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes.
  • Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes.
  • Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations.
  • Manage change adoption by providing training, documentation, and ongoing support for newly implemented tools.

Automation, Integration & AI Implementation

  • Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our SaaS ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, JavaScript).
  • Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks.
  • Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software.

IT Administration & Security

  • Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365).
  • Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access.
  • Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security.
  • Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate SaaS contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl.


Required Qualifications & Skills


Technical Experience:

  • 5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration.
  • Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment.
  • Strong understanding of cloud-based SaaS ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures.
  • High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting.
  • Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows.
  • Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols.


Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies:

  • Communication: Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity.
  • Critical Thinking: Strong analytical approach to problem-solving; ability to identify the root causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms.
  • Decision-Making: Highly autonomous execution; capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions.


Benefits & Compensation

  • Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

title: Senior/Principal .NET Developer
description:
Project Description:

We are looking for passionate and creative engineers who are eager to build innovative products and embrace new technologies at a leading hedge fund. You will be part of a small, agile, and highly skilled team of technologists building next‑generation platforms to optimize investment decisions.


Responsibilities:

As a Frameworks Developer, you will play a key role in building and evolving the firm’s core application framework used by development teams across the organization. This is a highly collaborative, hands‑on role with broad impact.


Key responsibilities:

- Plan, develop, and support the firm’s in‑house application framework

- Define and contribute to low‑level architecture and core design decisions

- Partner with development teams to help kickstart new projects and provide technical expertise

- Collaborate with developers and business users across the organization to deliver mission‑critical platforms and services

- Support investment professionals across equities, credit, and other major asset classes

- Work closely with the broader Technology team on cross‑functional initiatives


Mandatory Skills Description:

- At least 8 years of professional software development experience

Deep expertise in

- C#,

- ASP.NET,

- SQL Server

- Good working knowledge of Angular, JavaScript / TypeScript, HTML, CSS

- Full SDLC experience: requirements, implementation, testing, release, and support

- Strong focus on clean, high‑performance code (SOLID principles)

- Experience with multi‑threaded programming

- Proven ability to build scalable, high‑availability applications and support production systems

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, including technical discussions

- Strong team‑oriented, collaborative working style

- Independent, proactive mindset with a high level of ownership and collaboration


Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

- CI/CD systems (TeamCity, Octopus Deploy)

- Financial products (equities, derivatives, fixed income, etc. and related terminology)

- Order management systems (i.e., Charles River)

- Working with market data (i.e., Bloomberg Terminal, Bloomberg APIs)

- Workload automation and enterprise job scheduling software (i.e., ActiveBatch)

- Profiling and performance tuning techniques throughout the whole stack


Languages:

English: C1 Advanced

title: Workday Adaptive Planning Consultant
description:
Job Summary

Client is seeking a senior-level Workday Adaptive Planning Consultant to lead the architecture, design, and build of complex planning solutions. This individual will be a hands-on consultant responsible for developing scalable planning models, supporting integrations across Adaptive Planning and Oracle platforms, and partnering with Finance, RevOps, Data, and IT teams to deliver business-critical planning capabilities. The ideal candidate will bring deep Adaptive Planning expertise, strong financial planning knowledge, and the ability to translate business requirements into high-impact system solutions.


Key Responsibilities

  • Architect, design, and build scalable planning models in Workday Adaptive Planning
  • Develop and optimize complex models including dimensions, sheets, versions, assumptions, and driver-based logic
  • Design, support, and improve integrations and data workflows across Adaptive Planning and Oracle platforms
  • Partner with Finance, RevOps, Data, and IT teams to translate planning requirements into sustainable system solutions
  • Troubleshoot model and integration issues and improve overall system performance, scalability, and usability
  • Create clear documentation and provide knowledge transfer to support long-term ownership and adoption
  • Act as a senior consultant, owning delivery quality and supporting key stakeholder relationships


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of hands-on Workday Adaptive Planning experience
  • Proven experience architecting and building Adaptive Planning solutions, not just maintaining existing models
  • Deep expertise in:
  • Dimensions
  • Sheets
  • Versions
  • Assumptions
  • Driver-based planning logic
  • Complex calculations
  • Performance tuning and model optimization
  • Proven experience integrating Workday Adaptive Planning with Oracle EPM and/or Oracle ERP
  • Strong understanding of planning data structures, financial data flows, and integration best practices
  • Strong knowledge of financial planning and FP&A processes , including budgeting and forecasting
  • Ability to connect technical configuration decisions to business and financial outcomes
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex models to non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Finance, RevOps, Data, and IT

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting SaaS or recurring revenue business models
  • Experience leading or influencing Adaptive Planning best practices and standards
  • Background in multi-entity or high-growth organizations
  • Prior consulting or advisory experience in complex planning environments

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • Senior, hands-on consultant comfortable owning solution delivery end to end
  • Strong technical builder with business-facing communication skills
  • Able to operate independently while partnering across multiple functional teams
  • Skilled at balancing architecture, execution, troubleshooting, and stakeholder management

title: Senior Backend (Node.js) Engineer
description:
About Us

Founded in 2019 by two best friends, Jon and Eli, XILO set out to revolutionize the insurance industry by solving its biggest challenges. Eli, a brokerage owner, brought invaluable industry expertise, while Jon, an experienced software engineer, saw an opportunity to innovate using technology. Initially launched as a vertical SaaS solution addressing core quoting challenges, XILO has since evolved into a trailblazing Vertical AI company leveraging the latest AI technology to transform the industry. By layering cutting-edge AI solutions onto its SaaS platform, XILO is driving innovation far beyond its original vision. Having recently closed our Series A funding round, XILO is growing rapidly and seeking talented individuals who want to do career-defining work in a mission-driven startup that’s at the forefront of AI innovation.


About The Role

As a Senior Backend Engineer , you’ll be designing and architecting scalable solutions , creating robust APIs, and building new microservices from the ground up —while also improving and optimizing our existing systems. This isn’t just another engineering role. We’re solving real, painful inefficiencies in the insurance space – problems so frustrating that prospects have nearly teared up during sales calls, realizing how much time and effort we could save them. What we’re building isn’t just an upgrade – it’s a fundamental shift in how agencies operate .


What You’ll Do:

  • Architect and develop scalable TypeScript microservices powering XILO’s platform.
  • You’ll have the opportunity to work where your strengths shine and contribute to:
  • AI Agents – Automating complex decision-making and workflows
  • OCR & Document Processing – Extracting, structuring, and analyzing key insights from insurance documents
  • Intelligent Data Mapping – Aggregating and linking all relevant data into a centralized, dynamic user profile
  • Advanced Insurance Operations & CRM – The AI-powered backbone of agencies, seamlessly tracking, managing, and integrating customer data across tools and workflows while replacing outdated, manual processes
  • Forms Builder & Smart Data Entry – A Typeform-like system built for insurance, enabling error-proof, collaborative submissions – fill once, apply everywhere
  • Optimize system performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, frontend, data science) to deliver seamless integrations.
  • Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented team culture.
  • Implement best practices for API security, data privacy, and maintainability.


What we’re looking for

  • 7+ years of backend development experience, with a strong foundation in TypeScript and JavaScript.
  • Strong experience with Node.js
  • Proven expertise in designing and developing software product features, with a focus on scalability, performance, and maintainability.
  • Proven expertise in REST API design – including authentication, performance optimization, and security best practices.
  • Experience with XML and SOAP-based integrations, commonly used in the insurance industry.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Nest.js, leveraging its modular architecture for scalable backend services.
  • Familiarity with NX monorepos for structuring and maintaining large-scale applications.
  • Cloud deployment experience on Heroku and AWS, including CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure management.
  • Deep understanding of database management, ORM usage (e.g., TypeORM, Prisma, Sequelize), and zero-downtime migration strategies.
  • Experience designing and implementing microservices architectures, including inter-service communication, data consistency, and service decoupling.
  • Bonus: Full-stack experience with modern frontend frameworks like Angular.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).


What we offer

  • Collaborative and innovative work environment
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Budget for English lessons.


Why Join XILO?

  • A great tech startup – Small, fast-moving, and driven by real impact
  • Endless career growth – Help shape the team, tech, and company as we scale
  • Strong leadership & backing – Work alongside experienced founders and tier 1 silicon-valley VCs



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Flutter/Node.js)
description:
About the Company:

Headspace Health is the world’s most accessible and comprehensive digital mental health and wellbeing platform. Headspace Health will democratize mental health and wellbeing so people around the world are supported by a full spectrum of affordable care. In addition to its vast library of mindfulness and meditation content, our behavioral health system offers emotional support, guidance, therapy, and medication from professional coaches, licensed therapists, and psychiatrists, respectively.

Our mission is to create a world where mental health is never an obstacle. By harnessing the power and convenience of a smartphone, Headspace Health is able to provide access to high-quality care to anyone, anywhere, in order to reduce symptoms of stress, anxiety, and depression.


Role Description:

Headspace is looking for a Senior Software Engineer (Fullstack with Flutter focus) to support our Employer Solutions team. This team builds the foundational capabilities that power our commercial partnerships by enabling hundreds of employers to offer Headspace as a benefit to their workforce. This assignment supports development and delivery of scalable, high-quality mobile systems and features, ensuring they integrate seamlessly with our backend services and bring Headspace’s mission to life.


Deliverables:

  • Design and develop maintainable and flexible services for mission-critical systems that directly support mental healthcare delivery.
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to gather requirements and write RFCs and technical specifications to solve technical and business problems end to end.
  • Effectively communicate technical ideas to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Use business and technical knowledge to recommend thoughtful tradeoffs between complexity, quality, and delivery speed.

title: Especialista em transportes Jr.
description:
Especialista de Transportes Júnior

TVH – Vinhedo/SP

A TVH Brasil busca um Especialista de Transportes Júnior para integrar nossa estrutura de logística e transportes. Procuramos um profissional com perfil analítico, focado no controle de custos e com conhecimento no sistema Protheus, capaz de atuar estrategicamente em uma organização que é referência global em seu segmento.

Responsabilidades:

  • Garantir a conformidade das operações de transporte, acompanhando embarques, transbordos e condições de segurança da carga.
  • Realizar a gestão de performance (SLA/KPI) dos prestadores de serviço, monitorando custos de frete (entrada/saída) e prazos de entrega.
  • Gerir integralmente o módulo Protheus (GFE) , executando o controle de CT-es , faturas e documentos fiscais para garantir pagamentos em dia.
  • Propor e implementar projetos de melhoria contínua para otimização do lead time e elevar o padrão de serviço ao cliente final.
  • Distribuir e apoiar o fluxo de trabalho da equipe, sendo referência técnica.
  • Elaborar dashboards de decisão e relatórios mensais correlacionando redução de custos à qualidade das entregas.
  • Atuar ativamente em renegociações de contratos e tabelas de frete junto ao mercado.


Requisitos:

  • Formação Superior completa em Logística ou Administração.

title: Estagiário (a) de Finanças
description:
Olá! Aqui é a NotCo.

Somos um grupo de pessoas unidas por um propósito muito forte.

Queremos que você nos conheça, a nós e ao Giuseppe, nossa própria inteligência artificial.

Somos amantes de boa comida, mas acima de tudo, amamos o planeta. Assim, para protegê-lo, reinventamos a indústria alimentícia, uma deliciosa mordida de cada vez, elevando o que comemos por meio de nossa tecnologia à base de plantas.


Nossa receita? Ela inclui três componentes principais: ciência, tecnologia e, claro, talentos disruptivos. Trabalhamos diariamente para criar um futuro melhor.


Na NotCo , não estamos buscando ser a empresa perfeita, mas sim a certa. Estamos aqui para provocar mudanças, é por isso que ousamos, falhamos e, às vezes, alcançamos sucessos incríveis.


Estamos um busca de Estagiário (a) de Finanças , cuja principal missão será apoiar as rotinas contábeis e financeiras da área, contribuindo para a organização e controle das informações, realização de conciliações, suporte aos fechamentos contábeis e elaboração de relatórios, garantindo a acuracidade dos dados e apoiando a tomada de decisão e a eficiência dos processos internos.

Esta posição exige disponibilidade para trabalhar pessoalmente em nossos escritórios de São Paulo, três vezes por semana.



Principais Atividades:

  • Realizar lançamentos e classificações de documentos contábeis em sistema;
  • Apoiar nas conciliações contábeis e bancárias, identificando e tratando divergências;
  • Auxiliar na elaboração de balancetes e demonstrações financeiras;
  • Organizar e manter arquivos físicos e digitais de documentos contábeis;
  • Atualizar e controlar planilhas financeiras e contábeis;
  • Conferir lançamentos com base em centros de custo e natureza das despesas;
  • Apoiar o processo de fechamento contábil mensal e trimestral;
  • Contribuir na análise de variações de contas patrimoniais e de resultado;
  • Auxiliar na preparação de relatórios gerenciais e suporte a auditorias;
  • Participar da melhoria e padronização de processos financeiros e contábeis.


Requisitos:

  • Estar cursando graduação de contabilidade, economia, administração ou áreas correlatas. Com previsão de conclusão a partir de Jan/2027
  • Conhecimento em excel intermediário
  • Conhecimentos em sistemas ERP será um diferencial

title: Digital Business Analyst
description:
Digital Business Analyst – Shape the Future of Energy Reporting & Operations!


We are recruiting on behalf of a global energy services organisation operating across Gas & Power Services. This programme sits at the heart of operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and customer transparency - replacing fragmented, manual reporting with a scalable digital reporting solution across complex industrial assets.


You’ll join a long-term, high-impact transformation programme focused on power plant operations, Operations & Maintenance (O&M), and performance reporting. This is a discovery-heavy role with real ownership, working directly with senior stakeholders to define what the product should be, before it’s built.


As a Digital Business Analyst, you’ll lead domain discovery, define product capabilities, and act as the bridge between business stakeholders and delivery teams to turn complex operational needs into a clear, scalable digital solution.


Your Role:

You’ll be the bridge between operations, data, and delivery. This is a senior, hands-on role where you’ll rapidly onboard into the Gas & Power Services domain, lead structured discovery, and shape a digital reporting product from the ground up - with ownership through to delivery and value realisation.


What You’ll Do:

  • Lead structured interviews and workshops with domain heads and SMEs to capture current-state (“as-is”) processes, data flows, and pain points
  • Translate business needs into clear product capabilities, outcomes, and success measures
  • Define reporting requirements, data inputs, ownership models, and KPIs across performance, efficiency, safety, environmental, and financial metrics
  • Balance standardisation and configurability across plants, equipment types, and markets
  • Create and maintain product vision, roadmap, capability maps, and a prioritised backlog
  • Define the end-to-end data and reporting strategy - from data collection and validation through to dashboards and customer-facing outputs
  • Work closely with Solution Architects to ensure technical feasibility, scalability, and long-term sustainability
  • Act as the primary bridge between business stakeholders and delivery teams, driving clarity and momentum
  • Lead demos, clarify scope boundaries, and align expectations on custom vs configurable functionality
  • Support planning, estimation, sequencing, and governance across a multi-phase programme
  • Track progress against milestones and help define what success looks like by September 2026


What You Bring:

  • Proven ability to lead discovery independently and bring structure to ambiguous environments
  • Experience working on data-driven products, reporting systems, or analytics platforms
  • Experience with international, enterprise environments
  • Excellent stakeholder management and facilitation skills across senior, operational, and technical audiences
  • Confidence translating complex operational domains into clear, actionable requirements
  • Exposure to energy, utilities, power generation, or industrial operations is highly desirable
  • Familiarity with operational KPIs, asset performance management, and HSE reporting is a strong plus
  • Experience working with dashboards, BI tools, or custom reporting solutions


Why Join the Remobi community:

  • Fully remote B2B / freelance contracts
  • Access to high-impact roles across AI, FinTech, and modern infrastructure
  • A strong community of senior engineers, curated content, and role alerts
  • Work with fast-scaling companies where your impact is visible and valued


Apply today:

If you’re a Digital Business Analyst who thrives in discovery, enjoys shaping products from complex operational environments, and wants to deliver measurable business value in the energy sector - we’d love to hear from you.

title: Level 1 Support Specialist
description:
Level 1 IT Support Specialist (SAP Experience Required)

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Contract - 3 months initially

Daily Rate: €60 – €70 per day

Job Overview

We are looking for a Level 1 IT Support Specialist to join our team and provide first-line technical support to end users. The ideal candidate will have basic experience with SAP systems and a strong customer-focused mindset. You will be responsible for handling initial support requests, troubleshooting common issues, and escalating more complex problems when necessary.


  • Provide first-level technical support via phone, email, or ticketing system
  • Troubleshoot and resolve basic IT and SAP-related issues
  • Log, track, and manage support tickets in the system
  • Escalate unresolved or complex issues to Level 2 support teams
  • Assist users with SAP login issues, navigation, and basic functionality
  • Maintain accurate documentation of issues and resolutions
  • Follow standard support procedures and service level agreements (SLAs)


Requirements

  • Basic experience working with SAP (any module is a plus)
  • Previous experience in IT support, helpdesk, or customer service role preferred
  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Basic knowledge of Windows OS, Microsoft Office, and common IT tools
  • Good organizational and time management skills
  • High level of English


Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with ticketing systems (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira, Zendesk)
  • Understanding of ITIL principles
  • Multilingual skills (if applicable)

title: Digital Business Analyst
description:
Digital Business Analyst – Shape the Future of Energy Reporting & Operations!


We are recruiting on behalf of a global energy services organisation operating across Gas & Power Services. This programme sits at the heart of operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and customer transparency - replacing fragmented, manual reporting with a scalable digital reporting solution across complex industrial assets.


You’ll join a long-term, high-impact transformation programme focused on power plant operations, Operations & Maintenance (O&M), and performance reporting. This is a discovery-heavy role with real ownership, working directly with senior stakeholders to define what the product should be, before it’s built.


As a Digital Business Analyst, you’ll lead domain discovery, define product capabilities, and act as the bridge between business stakeholders and delivery teams to turn complex operational needs into a clear, scalable digital solution.


Your Role:

You’ll be the bridge between operations, data, and delivery. This is a senior, hands-on role where you’ll rapidly onboard into the Gas & Power Services domain, lead structured discovery, and shape a digital reporting product from the ground up - with ownership through to delivery and value realisation.


What You’ll Do:

  • Lead structured interviews and workshops with domain heads and SMEs to capture current-state (“as-is”) processes, data flows, and pain points
  • Translate business needs into clear product capabilities, outcomes, and success measures
  • Define reporting requirements, data inputs, ownership models, and KPIs across performance, efficiency, safety, environmental, and financial metrics
  • Balance standardisation and configurability across plants, equipment types, and markets
  • Create and maintain product vision, roadmap, capability maps, and a prioritised backlog
  • Define the end-to-end data and reporting strategy - from data collection and validation through to dashboards and customer-facing outputs
  • Work closely with Solution Architects to ensure technical feasibility, scalability, and long-term sustainability
  • Act as the primary bridge between business stakeholders and delivery teams, driving clarity and momentum
  • Lead demos, clarify scope boundaries, and align expectations on custom vs configurable functionality
  • Support planning, estimation, sequencing, and governance across a multi-phase programme
  • Track progress against milestones and help define what success looks like by September 2026


What You Bring:

  • Proven ability to lead discovery independently and bring structure to ambiguous environments
  • Experience working on data-driven products, reporting systems, or analytics platforms
  • Experience with international, enterprise environments
  • Excellent stakeholder management and facilitation skills across senior, operational, and technical audiences
  • Confidence translating complex operational domains into clear, actionable requirements
  • Exposure to energy, utilities, power generation, or industrial operations is highly desirable
  • Familiarity with operational KPIs, asset performance management, and HSE reporting is a strong plus
  • Experience working with dashboards, BI tools, or custom reporting solutions


Why Join the Remobi community:

  • Fully remote B2B / freelance contracts
  • Access to high-impact roles across AI, FinTech, and modern infrastructure
  • A strong community of senior engineers, curated content, and role alerts
  • Work with fast-scaling companies where your impact is visible and valued


Apply today:

If you’re a Digital Business Analyst who thrives in discovery, enjoys shaping products from complex operational environments, and wants to deliver measurable business value in the energy sector - we’d love to hear from you.

title: .Net Developer
description:
Job Title: .NET Developer

Location: Remote (Brazil-based only)

Salary: $3,500-4,500 per month

Job Type: Contract

Experience Level: Senior Level


About the Role:

We are seeking a skilled .NET Developer to join our growing development team. This fully remote role is open to candidates based in Brazil and offers the opportunity to work on modern application development projects in a supportive and agile environment.

You will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining high-quality software solutions using .NET / .NET Core , SQL , and AWS technologies. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and a strong understanding of application development lifecycle is essential.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain applications using .NET/.NET Core and related technologies
  • Work with SQL databases to design schemas, write queries, and optimize performance
  • Develop and maintain cloud-based applications using AWS
  • Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines for streamlined deployment processes
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features
  • Troubleshoot and resolve application issues in a timely manner
  • Write clean, scalable, and maintainable code following best practices
  • Contribute to improving development processes and methodologies
  • On-call responsibilities (usually every 3 weeks)


Required Skills & Experience:

  • Fluent English
  • Experience with Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions
  • Minimum of 3 years' experience in software development with .NET / .NET Core
  • Strong experience with SQL and relational databases
  • Strong exp with unit testing (to be highlighted in CV)
  • Strong exp with Kubernetes (to be highlighted in CV)
  • Hands-on experience with AWS
  • Experience with Docker
  • Knowledge of CodeQL
  • Experience working with CI/CD tools and workflows
  • Solid understanding of application development principles and best practices
  • Ability to work independently in a remote team environment
  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills


Nice to Have:


  • Familiarity with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD)
  • Exposure to ChatGPT / GPT-4 development or integration of large language models into applications


What We Offer:

  • Fully remote working environment (Brazil-based)
  • Flexible working hours
  • Opportunity to work on modern cloud-native applications

title: Analista de planejamento
description:
Analista de Planejamento


Regime de Trabalho / Local: Presencial - Escritório situado no Bairro Santa Efigênia em Belo Horizonte-MG.


Horário: Segunda a quinta das 08:30h às 18:30h e sexta das 08:30h às 17:30h


Sobre a empresa


A INC SpA do Brasil é uma empresa que atua no setor de infraestrutura, dedicada ao planejamento e execução de obras de grande porte. Contamos com uma equipe altamente qualificada de engenheiros e especialistas que desenvolvem projetos com foco em eficiência, inovação e nas mais modernas soluções de engenharia para viabilizar grandes empreendimentos.


Sobre a vaga


Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Planjeamento para integrar nossa equipe em Belo Horizonte – MG e atuar no planejamento e controle de obras de infraestrutura rodoviária.


Principais responsabilidades:

title: Digital Business Analyst
description:
Digital Business Analyst – Shape the Future of Energy Reporting & Operations!


We are recruiting on behalf of a global energy services organisation operating across Gas & Power Services. This programme sits at the heart of operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and customer transparency - replacing fragmented, manual reporting with a scalable digital reporting solution across complex industrial assets.


You’ll join a long-term, high-impact transformation programme focused on power plant operations, Operations & Maintenance (O&M), and performance reporting. This is a discovery-heavy role with real ownership, working directly with senior stakeholders to define what the product should be, before it’s built.


As a Digital Business Analyst, you’ll lead domain discovery, define product capabilities, and act as the bridge between business stakeholders and delivery teams to turn complex operational needs into a clear, scalable digital solution.


Your Role:

You’ll be the bridge between operations, data, and delivery. This is a senior, hands-on role where you’ll rapidly onboard into the Gas & Power Services domain, lead structured discovery, and shape a digital reporting product from the ground up - with ownership through to delivery and value realisation.


What You’ll Do:

  • Lead structured interviews and workshops with domain heads and SMEs to capture current-state (“as-is”) processes, data flows, and pain points
  • Translate business needs into clear product capabilities, outcomes, and success measures
  • Define reporting requirements, data inputs, ownership models, and KPIs across performance, efficiency, safety, environmental, and financial metrics
  • Balance standardisation and configurability across plants, equipment types, and markets
  • Create and maintain product vision, roadmap, capability maps, and a prioritised backlog
  • Define the end-to-end data and reporting strategy - from data collection and validation through to dashboards and customer-facing outputs
  • Work closely with Solution Architects to ensure technical feasibility, scalability, and long-term sustainability
  • Act as the primary bridge between business stakeholders and delivery teams, driving clarity and momentum
  • Lead demos, clarify scope boundaries, and align expectations on custom vs configurable functionality
  • Support planning, estimation, sequencing, and governance across a multi-phase programme
  • Track progress against milestones and help define what success looks like by September 2026


What You Bring:

  • Proven ability to lead discovery independently and bring structure to ambiguous environments
  • Experience working on data-driven products, reporting systems, or analytics platforms
  • Experience with international, enterprise environments
  • Excellent stakeholder management and facilitation skills across senior, operational, and technical audiences
  • Confidence translating complex operational domains into clear, actionable requirements
  • Exposure to energy, utilities, power generation, or industrial operations is highly desirable
  • Familiarity with operational KPIs, asset performance management, and HSE reporting is a strong plus
  • Experience working with dashboards, BI tools, or custom reporting solutions


Why Join the Remobi community:

  • Fully remote B2B / freelance contracts
  • Access to high-impact roles across AI, FinTech, and modern infrastructure
  • A strong community of senior engineers, curated content, and role alerts
  • Work with fast-scaling companies where your impact is visible and valued


Apply today:

If you’re a Digital Business Analyst who thrives in discovery, enjoys shaping products from complex operational environments, and wants to deliver measurable business value in the energy sector - we’d love to hear from you.

title: Analista de Excelência Operacional Pl
description:
Sobre a empresa:

A COFCO International é uma empresa global de agronegócios que compra, armazena, vende, processa e distribui commodities agrícolas essenciais: grãos, oleaginosas, açúcar, algodão e café.

Com sede em Genebra, na Suíça, a COFCO International emprega cerca de 11 mil profissionais, em 37 países, e possui ativos em todos os continentes, com negociações em mais de 50 países.

A COFCO International é uma plataforma de agronegócios da COFCO Corporation, uma das maiores companhias agrícolas e de alimentos da China, com atuação global.


Sobre a vaga:

O Analista de Excelência Operacional tem como principal responsabilidade mapear, revisar e otimizar os processos organizacionais das diversas áreas da COFCO Brasil, a partir de demandas internas ou iniciativas estratégicas. Atua como facilitador na identificação de oportunidades de melhoria e no atendimento dos chamados, promovendo padronização, eficiência e sustentabilidade operacional. Utiliza metodologias reconhecidas de gestão de processos (BPM, Vision), assegurando que os fluxos de trabalho estejam alinhados com os objetivos corporativos e as melhores práticas do mercado.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Auxiliar nas revisões e nos pontos de verificação dos processos.
  • Atuar de forma colaborativa com colegas de equipe e demais setores da organização.
  • Contribuir para a realização das rotinas operacionais.
  • Detectar e solucionar ocorrências relacionadas ao funcionamento do setor.
  • Manter-se atualizado quanto às melhores práticas e às novidades tecnológicas da área.
  • Buscar aprimoramento contínuo em habilidades técnicas e comportamentais.
  • Identificar oportunidades de otimização e sugerir melhorias nos processos operacionais da área financeira, com foco em fluxo de caixa.
  • Realizar mapeamentos de processos com eficiência e qualidade.
  • Facilitar a identificação, análise e aprimoramento de processos, atuando em conjunto com várias áreas.
  • Produzir fluxos e documentações utilizando BPMN, Visio, Pacote Office ou ferramentas similares.
  • Manter comunicação clara, proativa e assertiva com todas as áreas envolvidas.
  • Participar de forma ativa em projetos relacionados ao setor.


Requisitos:

  • Superior cursando ou completo em Engenharia, Administração ou áreas correlatas;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Pacote Office;
  • Experiência com Mapeamento de Processos;
  • Experiência com Fluxo de Caixa;
  • Conhecimento em SAP módulo CLM/FI, key user no módulo FI será um diferencial;
  • Conhecimento em Visio/Bizagi;
  • Conhecimento em BPM.


A COFCO International é uma empresa que promove a igualdade de oportunidades. Todos os talentos qualificados são bem-vindos e considerados para nossas vagas, sem distinção de raça ou etnia, crença religiosa, gênero, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, idade, pessoa com deficiência (PcD) e outras características protegidas por lei.

Para saber como a COFCO International coleta e processa os seus dados pessoais durante a sua candidatura de emprego, por favor consulte a nossa Política de Privacidade

Na EQI, o início da carreira é fortemente focado na formação de pessoas , com um modelo educacional estruturado e progressão de aprendizado intensiva. Esse processo é constantemente avaliado, sendo atrativo tanto para profissionais em fase inicial ou em transição de carreira, quanto para aqueles já experientes que buscam uma instituição que valoriza educação, resultado e evolução contínua.


Etapa Inicial Desde o primeiro dia, o profissional já atua como Assessor(a) de Investimentos, inserido em um modelo de formação intenso e educacional.


  • Onboarding Integração à cultura EQI, ferramentas e fundamentos técnicos e comerciais necessários para a atuação.
  • Desenvolvimento Comercial Atuação prática com foco em prospecção, geração de oportunidades e fortalecimento das habilidades de relacionamento.
  • Consolidação da Atuação Após o período de adaptação e com a consolidação dos resultados esperados, o(a) Assessor(a) passa a receber carteira de clientes EQI e inicia sua atuação completa, exercitando o modelo de assessoria da EQI com métricas e indicadores que acompanharão ao longo de toda a carreira.
  • Plano de Carreira O desenvolvimento começa já na formação e evolui de forma estruturada, com avaliações em cada etapa e oportunidades de crescimento até posições de maior senioridade.

• Fit Cultural;

• Certificação CPA-20 (CPA +CPROR), CEA (CPROI) ou CFP (ou interesse em tirar);

title: Engenheiro(a) de Automação - Especialista
description:
Faça parte da revolução na produtividade do canavial brasileiro e impulsione a bioenergia rumo a um mundo descarbonizado!


Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a), Especialista em Automação para atuar no desenvolvimento, implementação e melhoria de sistemas de automação industrial. Esse profissional será responsável por apoiar desde a concepção até a execução de projetos, contribuindo para a confiabilidade operacional, eficiência dos processos e integração de tecnologias industriais.

A posição exige forte capacidade técnica, experiência em execução de projetos em campo e vivência em processos industriais, atuando em interface com equipes multidisciplinares de engenharia, operação e fornecedores.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Liderar projetos de automação industrial e transformação digital, desde a concepção até a implementação em ambiente fabril
  • Propor e implementar soluções envolvendo Indústria 4.0, robótica e aplicações de Inteligência Artificial em processos produtivos
  • Execução de projetos em níveis conceitual, básico e detalhado, incluindo definições de arquitetura e lógica de controle e especificação de hardware
  • Acompanhar instalação, testes, comissionamento e startup de sistemas automatizados em campo, com entendimento e análise do impacto das soluções nos processos
  • Atuar em parceria com as áreas de engenharia e operações para identificar oportunidades de automação e otimização de processos produtivos
  • Desenvolver e integrar tecnologias, máquinas, sistemas de controle e equipamentos, visando eficiência operacional e confiabilidade dos processos
  • Gerenciar cronogramas técnicos e acompanhar a execução e implantação de projetos de automação
  • Coordenar e gerenciar fornecedores, integradores e parceiros tecnológicos
  • Promover iniciativas de inovação e melhoria de controles nos processos produtivos


Requisitos:

  • Vivência com Indústria 4.0, digitalização industrial e aplicações de Inteligência Artificial
  • Experiência na liderança e implementação de projetos de automação industrial
  • Conhecimento em redes industriais, instrumentação e sistemas supervisórios
  • Experiência na gestão de fornecedores e acompanhamento técnico de projetos
  • Visão sistêmica de processos e foco em inovação


Formação:

  • Graduação completa em Engenharia Elétrica, Engenharia de Automação, Mecatrônica ou áreas correlatas.


Benefícios da Posição:

  • Assistência Médica
  • Assistência Odontológica
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Previdência Privada
  • Alimentação: Restaurante no CTC
  • Fretado – Piracicaba ou Campinas
  • Wellhub


No CTC - Centro de Tecnologia Canavieira , cada dia é uma oportunidade de expandir os limites da genética e do manejo da cana-de-açúcar , desenvolvendo soluções inovadoras para um mundo mais sustentável.


Por que escolher o CTC?

Liderança global em inovação: Estamos na vanguarda das pesquisas com cana-de-açúcar, utilizando as técnicas mais avançadas de melhoramento genético e biotecnologia para criar o mais completo portifólio de variedades.


Infraestrutura de ponta: Nossa sede em Piracicaba (SP) abriga laboratórios reconhecidos como os mais modernos do país. Além de mais de 40 polos de experimentação espalhados pelo Brasil, contamos também com um centro de pesquisa em Saint-Louis (Missouri, EUA).


Equipe apaixonada e dedicada: Nosso time é movido pela ciência e pelo propósito de superar os desafios do setor, garantindo excelência e inovação no campo.


Nossa Cultura:

Colaboração ágil: Atuamos de forma colaborativa, sem perder a agilidade e valorizamos a troca de conhecimento.

Alta performance: Entregamos resultados de muito valor, com alto nível de excelência na execução.

Atitude inovadora: Transformamos ideias em soluções de alto impacto, aplicadas de forma ágil e prática. Estamos sempre em busca de soluções que transformem o agro e coloquem o cliente no centro de nossas ações.

Sucesso do Cliente: Por meio de nossas soluções, geramos valor e resultado para os nossos clientes. O cliente está no centro de nossas decisões e o sucesso dos nossos clientes é o nosso sucesso.


Se você é movido pela ciência, pela inovação e quer causar um impacto real, o CTC é o lugar certo para você . Candidate-se agora e seja parte dessa transformação! Junte-se a um time em pleno crescimento exponencial , onde seu desenvolvimento e crescimento profissional têm espaço para acontecer. Venha construir com a gente um futuro sustentável e descarbonizado.


Somos uma empresa para todos: respeitamos, incluímos e valorizamos!
