title: Digital Business Analyst
description:
Digital Business Analyst – Shape the Future of Energy Reporting & Operations!


We are recruiting on behalf of a global energy services organisation operating across Gas & Power Services. This programme sits at the heart of operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and customer transparency - replacing fragmented, manual reporting with a scalable digital reporting solution across complex industrial assets.


You’ll join a long-term, high-impact transformation programme focused on power plant operations, Operations & Maintenance (O&M), and performance reporting. This is a discovery-heavy role with real ownership, working directly with senior stakeholders to define what the product should be, before it’s built.


As a Digital Business Analyst, you’ll lead domain discovery, define product capabilities, and act as the bridge between business stakeholders and delivery teams to turn complex operational needs into a clear, scalable digital solution.


Your Role:

You’ll be the bridge between operations, data, and delivery. This is a senior, hands-on role where you’ll rapidly onboard into the Gas & Power Services domain, lead structured discovery, and shape a digital reporting product from the ground up - with ownership through to delivery and value realisation.


What You’ll Do:

  • Lead structured interviews and workshops with domain heads and SMEs to capture current-state (“as-is”) processes, data flows, and pain points
  • Translate business needs into clear product capabilities, outcomes, and success measures
  • Define reporting requirements, data inputs, ownership models, and KPIs across performance, efficiency, safety, environmental, and financial metrics
  • Balance standardisation and configurability across plants, equipment types, and markets
  • Create and maintain product vision, roadmap, capability maps, and a prioritised backlog
  • Define the end-to-end data and reporting strategy - from data collection and validation through to dashboards and customer-facing outputs
  • Work closely with Solution Architects to ensure technical feasibility, scalability, and long-term sustainability
  • Act as the primary bridge between business stakeholders and delivery teams, driving clarity and momentum
  • Lead demos, clarify scope boundaries, and align expectations on custom vs configurable functionality
  • Support planning, estimation, sequencing, and governance across a multi-phase programme
  • Track progress against milestones and help define what success looks like by September 2026


What You Bring:

  • Proven ability to lead discovery independently and bring structure to ambiguous environments
  • Experience working on data-driven products, reporting systems, or analytics platforms
  • Experience with international, enterprise environments
  • Excellent stakeholder management and facilitation skills across senior, operational, and technical audiences
  • Confidence translating complex operational domains into clear, actionable requirements
  • Exposure to energy, utilities, power generation, or industrial operations is highly desirable
  • Familiarity with operational KPIs, asset performance management, and HSE reporting is a strong plus
  • Experience working with dashboards, BI tools, or custom reporting solutions


Why Join the Remobi community:

  • Fully remote B2B / freelance contracts
  • Access to high-impact roles across AI, FinTech, and modern infrastructure
  • A strong community of senior engineers, curated content, and role alerts
  • Work with fast-scaling companies where your impact is visible and valued


Apply today:

If you’re a Digital Business Analyst who thrives in discovery, enjoys shaping products from complex operational environments, and wants to deliver measurable business value in the energy sector - we’d love to hear from you.

title: Level 1 Support Specialist
description:
Level 1 IT Support Specialist (SAP Experience Required)

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Contract - 3 months initially

Daily Rate: €60 – €70 per day

Job Overview

We are looking for a Level 1 IT Support Specialist to join our team and provide first-line technical support to end users. The ideal candidate will have basic experience with SAP systems and a strong customer-focused mindset. You will be responsible for handling initial support requests, troubleshooting common issues, and escalating more complex problems when necessary.


  • Provide first-level technical support via phone, email, or ticketing system
  • Troubleshoot and resolve basic IT and SAP-related issues
  • Log, track, and manage support tickets in the system
  • Escalate unresolved or complex issues to Level 2 support teams
  • Assist users with SAP login issues, navigation, and basic functionality
  • Maintain accurate documentation of issues and resolutions
  • Follow standard support procedures and service level agreements (SLAs)


Requirements

  • Basic experience working with SAP (any module is a plus)
  • Previous experience in IT support, helpdesk, or customer service role preferred
  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Basic knowledge of Windows OS, Microsoft Office, and common IT tools
  • Good organizational and time management skills
  • High level of English


Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with ticketing systems (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira, Zendesk)
  • Understanding of ITIL principles
  • Multilingual skills (if applicable)

  • High level of English

  • Familiarity with ticketing systems (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira, Zendesk)

  • Multilingual skills (if applicable)

  • Conhecimento em leitura de desenhos técnicos e uso de instrumentos de medição;
  • Perfil organizado, atento aos detalhes e comprometido com os padrões de qualidade;

description:
Job Title: Senior AI Engineer – Agentic AI (AWS Bedrock)

Location: Remote (LATAM)

Job Type: Contract Position


Engagement Term: 15 months

Role Summary

  • Senior AI Engineer focused on Agentic AI and LLM/GenAI solutions
  • Hands-on engineering role supporting large-scale enterprise AI use cases
  • Offshore AI/LLM execution partner to a highly technical onshore Architect
  • Expected to own and deliver the most critical AI use cases , not support work


Core Responsibilities

  • Design and implement Agentic AI solutions using AWS Bedrock
  • Apply MCP (Model Context Protocol) to structure and manage AI-agent interactions
  • Build and deploy AI layers on top of AWS services
  • Translate business requirements into AI architecture and technical implementation plans
  • Lead solutioning efforts: refining ideas into clear, executable technical plans
  • Implement chatbots and analyst-style agents for complex unstructured data (text + images)
  • Support “what-if” analysis use cases , including scenario modeling and decision support
  • Deliver scalable, production-ready AI solutions aligned to enterprise standards


Business Context – Network Planning

  • Primary focus area: Network Planning business
  • Ensuring all global flights are planned, analyzed, and optimized
  • Supporting large-scale, data-heavy decision-making across airline operations
  • AI solutions will augment planning, analysis, and insight generation for complex global datasets

title: Bolsista Graduado - DALL PHYTOLAB - Desenvolvimento de métodos analíticos | Talento Inovação -IEL/PR
description:
O Programa Talento Inovação do IEL Paraná tem como foco selecionar, acompanhar e desenvolverbolsistas, além de coordenar ações com organizações parceiras. Ele convida indústrias a proporem projetos de Pesquisa, Desenvolvimento e Inovação (PD&I ) nos quais a participação dos bolsistas promova o crescimento profissional em PD&I empresarial e contribua para a inovação da empresa. O programa oferece bolsas para graduandos, graduados, mestres e doutores, permitindo atividades de PD&I nas instalações das empresas pelo território nacional, após aprovação da Comissão Interna do IEL Paraná.



Sobre a Oportunidade:


Você tem interesse em desenvolver métodos analíticos inovadores e contribuir diretamente para a evolução da indústria de suplementos alimentares? A Dall PhytoLab S.A., empresa em expansão e referência em análises laboratoriais, está com uma oportunidade única para quem deseja atuar em projetos estratégicos de desenvolvimento e validação de métodos robustos para quantificação de ativos em suplementos.

Estamos em busca de um bolsista para conduzir atividades de pesquisa aplicada com foco em técnicas cromatográficas e espectrofotométricas, atuando no desenvolvimento, otimização e validação de métodos analíticos que possam ser internalizados e replicados pela equipe. O projeto tem como objetivo reduzir a dependência de serviços terceirizados, aumentar a eficiência dos processos internos e ampliar o portfólio de serviços do laboratório, impactando diretamente indicadores como redução de custos, otimização do time-to-market e maior flexibilidade para novas formulações.

Se você busca uma oportunidade de aprendizado prático, quer se desenvolver em um ambiente de excelência técnica e contribuir com soluções de alto impacto para o setor de suplementos, essa oportunidade é para você!



Projeto:

Desenvolvimento e otimização de métodos analíticos para quantificação de ingredientes ativos em suplementos alimentares.



Formação Acadêmica:

Graduado em Química ou Farmácia ou áreas correlatas;


Idioma: Inglês para leitura técnica.


Principais Atividades:


  • Liderar o desenvolvimento e validação dos métodos;
  • Estruturando a documentação técnica;
  • Capacitando a equipe e reduzindo a dependência externa.



Conhecimentos e habilidades necessários:


  • Graduação em Química ou Farmácia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Desenvolvimento e validação de métodos analíticos;
  • Conhecimento em RDCs da ANVISA
  • Técnicas cromatográficas (HPLC, CG) e espectroscópicas.


Ferramentas/metodologias:


  • HPLC, UV/VIS;
  • Validação analítica segundo normas ISO/ANVISA;



Conhecimentos e habilidades desejáveis:


  • Design of Experiments (DoE);
  • Desejável mestrado na área;
  • Operação de GC;

Formato de trabalho : Presencial.

title: Técnico(a) de Manutenção Mecânica Sr
description:
No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.


Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.


Principais atividades:

  • Acompanhar e executar atividades de manutenção mecânica em paradas programadas/corretivas e orientar e acompanhar os serviços de manutenção das empresas prestadoras de serviços;
  • Anotar os reparos feitos em ordens de serviços e peças trocadas, para manutenção e emitir ordens de serviço para execução das mesmas;
  • Inspecionar novos materiais mecânicos para serem adicionados em estoque;
  • Participar do planejamento de programação de manutenção corretiva planejada, preventiva e preditiva, visando minimizar o tempo não produtivo dos equipamentos;
  • Preencher/executar as ordens de manutenção planejadas no SAP-PM corretamente, registrando informações pertinentes, como: dados de intervenção, especialidades envolvidas, HH, tempos e custos de manutenção, soluções aplicadas, recomendações futuras e observações importantes;
  • Acompanhar as manutenções emergenciais, programando sua imediata execução;
  • Realizar análise de falhas conforme os critérios padrões e se comprometer com os planos de ações bem como o bloqueio das falhas.


Requisitos:

  • Ensino Técnico Completo em Mecânica ou Eletromecânica;
  • Experiência com manutenção em ambiente industrial;
  • Desejável ensino superior cursando;
  • Desejável experiência na área de Madeiras ou Papel/Celulose;
  • Residir na região de Montenegro/RS.

title: Java UI Application Developer
description:
Java UI Application Developer

Brazil

Senior Software Engineer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Java UI Application developer to lead the design, development, and optimization of advanced software solutions for geophysical data processing, modeling, visualization and interpretation. In this role, you will collaborate closely with geoscientists to create innovative tools that enhance data-driven decision-making through powerful visualization and interpretation capabilities. You will also collaborate with global development teams across Europe, Canada, and the United States, contributing to a dynamic and international engineering environment.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Collaborate closely with a UX design team, product owners, and software engineers to translate UX requirements into robust GUI implementations with Eclipse RCP/SWT;
  • Present software designs and technical proposals to lead;
  • Ability to break down development tasks and lay out clear implementation roadmaps;
  • Implement and optimize computation algorithms;
  • Design and develop both thin and thick client applications that interact with cloud-based microservices;
  • Working with complex UI Java threading and concurrency;
  • Working with a large code base and multiple distributed development teams;
  • Ensure high code quality through unit testing, code reviews, security hardening and continuous integration with other domain tools;
  • Provide technical support and lead user troubleshooting sessions to resolve issues and ensure smooth operation of a complex RCP desktop application;
  • Mentor junior developers and actively contribute to architectural and implementation decisions;
  • Embrace Agile/Scrum methodologies, delivering and demonstrating working solutions at the end of each sprint;
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and trends in computing and software development.

Essential Skills

  • BS or MS degree in computer science, Geoscience, Applied Mathematics, or a related engineering discipline;
  • Ability to break down complex development tasks and define clear, actionable implementation of roadmaps;
  • Preferred strong Java experience;
  • GitLab/Github, Eclipse RCP/SWT, VS Code, CI/CD pipelines;
  • Performance tools: VisualVM, JMC/JFR, Async;
  • Operating systems: Windows and Linux;
  • Must be self-motivated and able to work well in a distributed team environment;
  • Experience developing commercial thick client desktop applications.

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Hands-on experience using Agentic AI to accelerate code implementation and enhance development productivity;
  • C++ knowledge and experience a benefit;
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms and distributed computing;
  • Restful API design and implementation;
  • AWS and Azure;
  • Tools for scalable data processing: Kubernetes, Spark;
  • Experience with Java 2D graphics or 3D OpenGL + CUDA programming;
  • Experience working with Cascading Style Sheets (CSS).

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Desenvolvedor de back end
description:
Quem Somos?

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.



O que esperar de nós?

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.


Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


Nosso Cliente

Esta posição atuará em apoio ao nosso cliente, uma multinacional líder no segmento de cruzeiros marítimos.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop scalable RESTful or GraphQL APIs consumed by Android and iOS clients
  • Build and maintain microservices using Java, Node.js, Python, or Go (per team stack)
  • Define and document API contracts and data schemas in collaboration with mobile developers
  • Manage database design, query optimization, and migrations (SQL and/or NoSQL)
  • Implement authentication, authorization, and security best practices (OAuth 2.0, JWT)
  • Develop and maintain backend test suites; collaborate with SDETs on integration testing
  • Maintain JIRA user stories and technical tasks for backend workstream
  • Monitor service health, diagnose production issues, and lead root cause analysis
  • Implement CI/CD pipelines for backend services
  • Participate in all Agile ceremonies and technical planning sessions

Required Qualifications

  • Advenced english is primordial, you'll work with an international team.
  • 7+ years of backend development experience
  • Proficiency in at least one backend language: Java, Node.js (TypeScript), Python, or Go
  • Strong experience designing and building RESTful APIs for mobile clients
  • Solid knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB, DynamoDB)
  • Experience with containerization (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes or ECS)
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms: AWS, GCP, or Azure
  • Familiarity with JIRA for backlog and sprint management
  • Understanding of security practices: OAuth, JWT, HTTPS, input validation
  • Experience with automated testing and integration with CI/CD pipelines
  • Strong commitment to Test Driven Development (TDD) practices for backend service quality
  • Experience building backends specifically optimized for mobile (bandwidth-efficient, low-latency APIs)
  • Familiarity with push notification infrastructure (FCM, APNs)
  • Knowledge of event-driven architectures (Kafka, SQS/SNS)
  • Exposure to GraphQL API design


Onde você vai trabalhar?

Regime 100% Home Office.


Tempo de Projeto:

Tempo indeterminado.

description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as AbbVie, Astrazeneca, Pfizer, Merck. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


Our Biopharma team is growing, and we are looking for an experienced Associate Account Executive to expand institutional sales of our scientific video journal and databases to biopharma companies in North America. If you are ambitious, results-driven, and can develop relationships with scientists and progress opportunities, this position could be an excellent opportunity for you.


Responsibilities:


  • Own the full sales cycle, from prospecting to closing business for assigned biopharma accounts.
  • Conduct active outreach to build and progress opportunities in the pipeline to meet or exceed sales goals.
  • Build and execute a persistent outbound sales strategy, including cold calls and emails, to generate interest and accelerate new business generation.
  • Establish and maintain strong and professional relationships with biopharma librarians, R&D leadership and stakeholders.
  • Work with the marketing and customer success teams to customize marketing activities & provide support for each account.


Requirements:


  • A bachelor's degree
  • 2+ years of direct selling experience to stakeholders in the pharmaceutical, biotech, device, or healthcare industry.
  • Demonstrated success in meeting and exceeding sales objectives.
  • Proven ability to influence decision-makers and manage a full sales cycle.
  • Highly effective verbal and written communication skills.
  • A disciplined approach to daily activity planning, setting goals, and achieving success.
  • Experience with Salesforce or relevant sales CRM, MS Office is required.


Why Join JoVE?


  • A competitive compensation package, including unlimited commissions.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and productivity.
  • Opportunity to work in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Desenvolvedor de back end
description:
Quem Somos?

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.



O que esperar de nós?

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.


Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


Nosso Cliente

Esta posição atuará em apoio ao nosso cliente, uma multinacional líder no segmento de cruzeiros marítimos.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop scalable RESTful or GraphQL APIs consumed by Android and iOS clients
  • Build and maintain microservices using Java, Node.js, Python, or Go (per team stack)
  • Define and document API contracts and data schemas in collaboration with mobile developers
  • Manage database design, query optimization, and migrations (SQL and/or NoSQL)
  • Implement authentication, authorization, and security best practices (OAuth 2.0, JWT)
  • Develop and maintain backend test suites; collaborate with SDETs on integration testing
  • Maintain JIRA user stories and technical tasks for backend workstream
  • Monitor service health, diagnose production issues, and lead root cause analysis
  • Implement CI/CD pipelines for backend services
  • Participate in all Agile ceremonies and technical planning sessions

Required Qualifications

  • Advenced english is primordial, you'll work with an international team.
  • 7+ years of backend development experience
  • Proficiency in at least one backend language: Java, Node.js (TypeScript), Python, or Go
  • Strong experience designing and building RESTful APIs for mobile clients
  • Solid knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB, DynamoDB)
  • Experience with containerization (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes or ECS)
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms: AWS, GCP, or Azure
  • Familiarity with JIRA for backlog and sprint management
  • Understanding of security practices: OAuth, JWT, HTTPS, input validation
  • Experience with automated testing and integration with CI/CD pipelines
  • Strong commitment to Test Driven Development (TDD) practices for backend service quality
  • Experience building backends specifically optimized for mobile (bandwidth-efficient, low-latency APIs)
  • Familiarity with push notification infrastructure (FCM, APNs)
  • Knowledge of event-driven architectures (Kafka, SQS/SNS)
  • Exposure to GraphQL API design


Onde você vai trabalhar?

Regime 100% Home Office.


Tempo de Projeto:

Tempo indeterminado.

title: Java UI Application Developer
description:
Java UI Application Developer

Brazil

Senior Software Engineer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Java UI Application developer to lead the design, development, and optimization of advanced software solutions for geophysical data processing, modeling, visualization and interpretation. In this role, you will collaborate closely with geoscientists to create innovative tools that enhance data-driven decision-making through powerful visualization and interpretation capabilities. You will also collaborate with global development teams across Europe, Canada, and the United States, contributing to a dynamic and international engineering environment.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Collaborate closely with a UX design team, product owners, and software engineers to translate UX requirements into robust GUI implementations with Eclipse RCP/SWT;
  • Present software designs and technical proposals to lead;
  • Ability to break down development tasks and lay out clear implementation roadmaps;
  • Implement and optimize computation algorithms;
  • Design and develop both thin and thick client applications that interact with cloud-based microservices;
  • Working with complex UI Java threading and concurrency;
  • Working with a large code base and multiple distributed development teams;
  • Ensure high code quality through unit testing, code reviews, security hardening and continuous integration with other domain tools;
  • Provide technical support and lead user troubleshooting sessions to resolve issues and ensure smooth operation of a complex RCP desktop application;
  • Mentor junior developers and actively contribute to architectural and implementation decisions;
  • Embrace Agile/Scrum methodologies, delivering and demonstrating working solutions at the end of each sprint;
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and trends in computing and software development.

Essential Skills

  • BS or MS degree in computer science, Geoscience, Applied Mathematics, or a related engineering discipline;
  • Ability to break down complex development tasks and define clear, actionable implementation of roadmaps;
  • Preferred strong Java experience;
  • GitLab/Github, Eclipse RCP/SWT, VS Code, CI/CD pipelines;
  • Performance tools: VisualVM, JMC/JFR, Async;
  • Operating systems: Windows and Linux;
  • Must be self-motivated and able to work well in a distributed team environment;
  • Experience developing commercial thick client desktop applications.

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Hands-on experience using Agentic AI to accelerate code implementation and enhance development productivity;
  • C++ knowledge and experience a benefit;
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms and distributed computing;
  • Restful API design and implementation;
  • AWS and Azure;
  • Tools for scalable data processing: Kubernetes, Spark;
  • Experience with Java 2D graphics or 3D OpenGL + CUDA programming;
  • Experience working with Cascading Style Sheets (CSS).

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Associate Account Executive - Biopharma
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as AbbVie, Astrazeneca, Pfizer, Merck. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


Our Biopharma team is growing, and we are looking for an experienced Associate Account Executive to expand institutional sales of our scientific video journal and databases to biopharma companies in North America. If you are ambitious, results-driven, and can develop relationships with scientists and progress opportunities, this position could be an excellent opportunity for you.


Responsibilities:


  • Own the full sales cycle, from prospecting to closing business for assigned biopharma accounts.
  • Conduct active outreach to build and progress opportunities in the pipeline to meet or exceed sales goals.
  • Build and execute a persistent outbound sales strategy, including cold calls and emails, to generate interest and accelerate new business generation.
  • Establish and maintain strong and professional relationships with biopharma librarians, R&D leadership and stakeholders.
  • Work with the marketing and customer success teams to customize marketing activities & provide support for each account.


Requirements:


  • A bachelor's degree
  • 2+ years of direct selling experience to stakeholders in the pharmaceutical, biotech, device, or healthcare industry.
  • Demonstrated success in meeting and exceeding sales objectives.
  • Proven ability to influence decision-makers and manage a full sales cycle.
  • Highly effective verbal and written communication skills.
  • A disciplined approach to daily activity planning, setting goals, and achieving success.
  • Experience with Salesforce or relevant sales CRM, MS Office is required.


Why Join JoVE?


  • A competitive compensation package, including unlimited commissions.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and productivity.
  • Opportunity to work in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Desenvolvedor de back end
description:
Quem Somos?

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.



O que esperar de nós?

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.


Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


Nosso Cliente

Esta posição atuará em apoio ao nosso cliente, uma multinacional líder no segmento de cruzeiros marítimos.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop scalable RESTful or GraphQL APIs consumed by Android and iOS clients
  • Build and maintain microservices using Java, Node.js, Python, or Go (per team stack)
  • Define and document API contracts and data schemas in collaboration with mobile developers
  • Manage database design, query optimization, and migrations (SQL and/or NoSQL)
  • Implement authentication, authorization, and security best practices (OAuth 2.0, JWT)
  • Develop and maintain backend test suites; collaborate with SDETs on integration testing
  • Maintain JIRA user stories and technical tasks for backend workstream
  • Monitor service health, diagnose production issues, and lead root cause analysis
  • Implement CI/CD pipelines for backend services
  • Participate in all Agile ceremonies and technical planning sessions

Required Qualifications

  • Advenced english is primordial, you'll work with an international team.
  • 7+ years of backend development experience
  • Proficiency in at least one backend language: Java, Node.js (TypeScript), Python, or Go
  • Strong experience designing and building RESTful APIs for mobile clients
  • Solid knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB, DynamoDB)
  • Experience with containerization (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes or ECS)
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms: AWS, GCP, or Azure
  • Familiarity with JIRA for backlog and sprint management
  • Understanding of security practices: OAuth, JWT, HTTPS, input validation
  • Experience with automated testing and integration with CI/CD pipelines
  • Strong commitment to Test Driven Development (TDD) practices for backend service quality
  • Experience building backends specifically optimized for mobile (bandwidth-efficient, low-latency APIs)
  • Familiarity with push notification infrastructure (FCM, APNs)
  • Knowledge of event-driven architectures (Kafka, SQS/SNS)
  • Exposure to GraphQL API design


Onde você vai trabalhar?

Regime 100% Home Office.


Tempo de Projeto:

Tempo indeterminado.

title: Java UI Application Developer
description:
Java UI Application Developer

Brazil

Senior Software Engineer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Java UI Application developer to lead the design, development, and optimization of advanced software solutions for geophysical data processing, modeling, visualization and interpretation. In this role, you will collaborate closely with geoscientists to create innovative tools that enhance data-driven decision-making through powerful visualization and interpretation capabilities. You will also collaborate with global development teams across Europe, Canada, and the United States, contributing to a dynamic and international engineering environment.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Collaborate closely with a UX design team, product owners, and software engineers to translate UX requirements into robust GUI implementations with Eclipse RCP/SWT;
  • Present software designs and technical proposals to lead;
  • Ability to break down development tasks and lay out clear implementation roadmaps;
  • Implement and optimize computation algorithms;
  • Design and develop both thin and thick client applications that interact with cloud-based microservices;
  • Working with complex UI Java threading and concurrency;
  • Working with a large code base and multiple distributed development teams;
  • Ensure high code quality through unit testing, code reviews, security hardening and continuous integration with other domain tools;
  • Provide technical support and lead user troubleshooting sessions to resolve issues and ensure smooth operation of a complex RCP desktop application;
  • Mentor junior developers and actively contribute to architectural and implementation decisions;
  • Embrace Agile/Scrum methodologies, delivering and demonstrating working solutions at the end of each sprint;
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and trends in computing and software development.

Essential Skills

  • BS or MS degree in computer science, Geoscience, Applied Mathematics, or a related engineering discipline;
  • Ability to break down complex development tasks and define clear, actionable implementation of roadmaps;
  • Preferred strong Java experience;
  • GitLab/Github, Eclipse RCP/SWT, VS Code, CI/CD pipelines;
  • Performance tools: VisualVM, JMC/JFR, Async;
  • Operating systems: Windows and Linux;
  • Must be self-motivated and able to work well in a distributed team environment;
  • Experience developing commercial thick client desktop applications.

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Hands-on experience using Agentic AI to accelerate code implementation and enhance development productivity;
  • C++ knowledge and experience a benefit;
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms and distributed computing;
  • Restful API design and implementation;
  • AWS and Azure;
  • Tools for scalable data processing: Kubernetes, Spark;
  • Experience with Java 2D graphics or 3D OpenGL + CUDA programming;
  • Experience working with Cascading Style Sheets (CSS).

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Java UI Application Developer
description:
Java UI Application Developer

Brazil

Senior Software Engineer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Java UI Application developer to lead the design, development, and optimization of advanced software solutions for geophysical data processing, modeling, visualization and interpretation. In this role, you will collaborate closely with geoscientists to create innovative tools that enhance data-driven decision-making through powerful visualization and interpretation capabilities. You will also collaborate with global development teams across Europe, Canada, and the United States, contributing to a dynamic and international engineering environment.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Collaborate closely with a UX design team, product owners, and software engineers to translate UX requirements into robust GUI implementations with Eclipse RCP/SWT;
  • Present software designs and technical proposals to lead;
  • Ability to break down development tasks and lay out clear implementation roadmaps;
  • Implement and optimize computation algorithms;
  • Design and develop both thin and thick client applications that interact with cloud-based microservices;
  • Working with complex UI Java threading and concurrency;
  • Working with a large code base and multiple distributed development teams;
  • Ensure high code quality through unit testing, code reviews, security hardening and continuous integration with other domain tools;
  • Provide technical support and lead user troubleshooting sessions to resolve issues and ensure smooth operation of a complex RCP desktop application;
  • Mentor junior developers and actively contribute to architectural and implementation decisions;
  • Embrace Agile/Scrum methodologies, delivering and demonstrating working solutions at the end of each sprint;
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and trends in computing and software development.

Essential Skills

  • BS or MS degree in computer science, Geoscience, Applied Mathematics, or a related engineering discipline;
  • Ability to break down complex development tasks and define clear, actionable implementation of roadmaps;
  • Preferred strong Java experience;
  • GitLab/Github, Eclipse RCP/SWT, VS Code, CI/CD pipelines;
  • Performance tools: VisualVM, JMC/JFR, Async;
  • Operating systems: Windows and Linux;
  • Must be self-motivated and able to work well in a distributed team environment;
  • Experience developing commercial thick client desktop applications.

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Hands-on experience using Agentic AI to accelerate code implementation and enhance development productivity;
  • C++ knowledge and experience a benefit;
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms and distributed computing;
  • Restful API design and implementation;
  • AWS and Azure;
  • Tools for scalable data processing: Kubernetes, Spark;
  • Experience with Java 2D graphics or 3D OpenGL + CUDA programming;
  • Experience working with Cascading Style Sheets (CSS).

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

A empresa de logística para o mundo! Conectando Pessoas. Melhorando Vidas. Principais Responsabilidades:


  • Executar planos e processos para operações de transporte, garantindo o envio, armazenamento e entrega de todas as mercadorias
  • Acompanhar a utilização do orçamento, calcular valores reais, reunir análises de desvios e comentários, e coordenar os orçamentos com outros departamentos da empresa

  • Garantir operações eficientes e transporte em redes inter-regionais

  • Participar do desenvolvimento e execução de atividades de projetos de transporte e tráfego, como análise de serviços de transporte e estudos de consolidação
  • Preparar e compartilhar análises de frete e sistemas de apoio à decisão para outras áreas funcionais
  • Desenvolver análises das práticas atuais de transporte e operações para identificar oportunidades de melhoria de processos e redução de custos
  • Determinar requisitos, analisar problemas e projetar soluções na área de operações e redes de transporte
  • Estudar e resolver questões nas operações logísticas do dia a dia, executando práticas com foco em aumento de eficácia e eficiência, além de controle de custos


Requisitos:



  • Formação Superior Completa em Administração, Relações Internacionais, Comércio Exterior ou cursos correlatos;
  • Inglês Avançado;
  • Espanhol será considerado um diferencial.


Local de Trabalho:


  • Híbrido – São Paulo - SP


Nós lhe propomos:


  • Fazer parte de uma empresa global, líder de mercado.
  • Faça parte de um time com expertise nestes segmentos que amam o que fazem!
  • Oportunidades e plano de desenvolvimento.
  • Um clima de trabalho onde você possa ser você mesmo
  • Compartilhe e aprenda em equipe, com troca de informações e conhecimentos.
  • Torne-se o seu melhor, dentro de uma cultura construída com base na abertura, confiança e respeito mútuo.
  • PLR, Previdência Privada, Day Off no Aniversário, Plano de Saúde (Sul América), Plano Odontológico, Vale Refeição e/ou Alimentação, Auxílio Creche, entre outros.


Venha fazer parte da máquina amarela! Uma multinacional que se destaca pelos seus compromissos e iniciativas globais de responsabilidade social e metas ambientais. Através do nosso Programa de Diversidade & Inclusão, ganhamos para promover uma cultura mais inclusiva, valorizando todos os profissionais e acreditando no potencial de cada um.

title: Sourcer Júnior Latam
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Sourcer Júnior para integrar o time de Talent Acquisition com foco em contratações LATAM da AI/R Company. Empresas como Avenue Code, Invillia e Compass UOL fazem parte do grupo.

Você irá apoiar o mapeamento de mercado, a identificação de talentos e a construção de pipelines, atuando em parceria com recrutadores para contribuir com processos mais assertivos e uma boa experiência para os candidatos.


Você será responsável por:

  • Apoiar na identificação, mapeamento e prospecção de talentos para posições técnicas (Desenvolvimento, QA, DevOps, Data, etc.);
  • Utilizar estratégias de sourcing com apoio do time;
  • Criar e manter listas e pipelines de talentos organizados;
  • Realizar primeiros contatos com candidatos, apresentando oportunidades;
  • Atualizar e manter informações em ferramentas como ATS e LinkedIn;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com recrutadores e lideranças para entender perfis e prioridades;
  • Apoiar na geração de relatórios simples de recrutamento;
  • Contribuir com ações de employer branding e engajamento de talentos.


O que você precisa ter:

  • Experiência com recrutamento, sourcing ou pesquisa de talentos;
  • Experiência trabalhando com SLA curto de entrega de candidatos;
  • Interesse por tecnologia e pelo mercado de talentos tech;
  • Familiaridade com LinkedIn ou outras plataformas de busca de perfis;
  • Organização, atenção aos detalhes e curiosidade por desafios;
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal;
  • Inglês avançado para conversação.



A Avenue Code reforça seu compromisso com a privacidade e com todos os princípios assegurados pelas legislações de proteção de dados mais rigorosas do mundo, como a GDPR, LGPD, CCPA e CPRA. Os dados dos(as) candidatos(as) compartilhados serão mantidos sob confidencialidade e utilizados exclusivamente para fins de recrutamento, podendo ser compartilhados com clientes e empresas do Grupo CompassUol envolvidas nos projetos.

title: Analista de Planejamento e Custos Jr | Orçamento Rápido
description:
Descrição da vaga

Muito mais do que uma incorporadora e construtora – realizamos sonhos e transformamos vidas!


Somos movidos por resultados e vivemos um momento de crescimento acelerado, com grandes lançamentos previstos e metas ainda mais ambiciosas para os próximos anos.


Se você busca desafios e quer liderar a transformação em uma empresa inovadora e em expansão, essa oportunidade é para você !


Responsabilidades e atribuições

O que você fará por aqui:

  • Elaborar custos de obra para estudos de viabilidade, utilizando metodologia paramétrica e análise de terrenos;
  • Execução de orçamento paramétrico para compra de terrenos e desenvolvimento de produtos, utilizando referências de custos;
  • Compor custos das principais partes do projeto, garantindo assertividade na análise;
  • Comparar custos de obras em estudo com projetos similares;
  • Apoio na análise de viabilidade técnica dos projetos;
  • Levantamento de informações em projeto dwg;
  • Definição de prazos de execução de obras;
  • Interface com os departamentos de Projetos, Novos Negócios, Viabilidade Arquitetônica, Viabilidade Financeira, Incorporação;
  • Contato com projetistas parceiros para estimativa de estrutura, fundações.


Requisitos e qualificações

O que esperamos que você tenha:

  • Formação Completa em Engenharia Civil e afins;
  • Conhecimento em AutoCAD, Excel e BIM;
  • Experiência nas atividades listadas acima;
  • Habilidade analítica e pensamento estratégico;
  • Organização e planejamento para gerenciar múltiplas demandas com eficiência.


Seria incrível se você tivesse experiência em:

  • Experiência na área de orçamentos e viabilidade de projetos, preferencialmente em Obras Residenciais MCMV.


Informações adicionais

Benefícios que refletem o nosso jeito de cuidar


Na Plano&Plano, acreditamos que cada conquista é construída junto.


Por isso, nossos benefícios foram pensados para apoiar você em todas as fases da jornada, no trabalho, em casa e na vida.


Essenciais para o dia a dia:


  • Vale-refeição no cartão Flash: liberdade total para escolher onde e como usar;
  • Vale-transporte ou fretado: com desconto de até 6%, garantindo mais mobilidade e praticidade;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR): porque o sucesso é coletivo e celebramos juntos cada conquista!.


Saúde e bem-estar em primeiro lugar:


  • Assistência Médica Bradesco Saúde: cobertura nacional para cuidar de você;
  • Assistência odontológica Bradesco (opcional): um sorriso saudável também faz parte da nossa rotina;
  • Seguro de Vida MetLife: tranquilidade e proteção para você;
  • Wellhub (Gympass): equilíbrio entre corpo e mente com acesso a academias, terapias e programas de bem-estar;
  • Cartão Natalidade: para celebrar esse momento tão especial com mais tranquilidade.


Qualidade de vida que inspira


  • Day Off de Aniversário: um dia de folga para você celebrar do seu jeito;
  • Emendas de feriados e recesso de fim de ano: tempo extra para descansar e recarregar as energias, sem desconto das férias.


Vantagens que vão além


  • Desconto especial na compra do seu apartamento Plano&Plano: o sonho da casa própria pode começar aqui!;


Outras informações


  • Local: escritório próximo ao metrô Butantã, em São Paulo;
  • Jornada: segunda a sexta-feira, presencial, porque acreditamos que conexões reais constroem grandes resultados.

title: Java UI Application Developer
description:
Java UI Application Developer

Brazil

Senior Software Engineer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Java UI Application developer to lead the design, development, and optimization of advanced software solutions for geophysical data processing, modeling, visualization and interpretation. In this role, you will collaborate closely with geoscientists to create innovative tools that enhance data-driven decision-making through powerful visualization and interpretation capabilities. You will also collaborate with global development teams across Europe, Canada, and the United States, contributing to a dynamic and international engineering environment.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Collaborate closely with a UX design team, product owners, and software engineers to translate UX requirements into robust GUI implementations with Eclipse RCP/SWT;
  • Present software designs and technical proposals to lead;
  • Ability to break down development tasks and lay out clear implementation roadmaps;
  • Implement and optimize computation algorithms;
  • Design and develop both thin and thick client applications that interact with cloud-based microservices;
  • Working with complex UI Java threading and concurrency;
  • Working with a large code base and multiple distributed development teams;
  • Ensure high code quality through unit testing, code reviews, security hardening and continuous integration with other domain tools;
  • Provide technical support and lead user troubleshooting sessions to resolve issues and ensure smooth operation of a complex RCP desktop application;
  • Mentor junior developers and actively contribute to architectural and implementation decisions;
  • Embrace Agile/Scrum methodologies, delivering and demonstrating working solutions at the end of each sprint;
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and trends in computing and software development.

Essential Skills

  • BS or MS degree in computer science, Geoscience, Applied Mathematics, or a related engineering discipline;
  • Ability to break down complex development tasks and define clear, actionable implementation of roadmaps;
  • Preferred strong Java experience;
  • GitLab/Github, Eclipse RCP/SWT, VS Code, CI/CD pipelines;
  • Performance tools: VisualVM, JMC/JFR, Async;
  • Operating systems: Windows and Linux;
  • Must be self-motivated and able to work well in a distributed team environment;
  • Experience developing commercial thick client desktop applications.

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Hands-on experience using Agentic AI to accelerate code implementation and enhance development productivity;
  • C++ knowledge and experience a benefit;
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms and distributed computing;
  • Restful API design and implementation;
  • AWS and Azure;
  • Tools for scalable data processing: Kubernetes, Spark;
  • Experience with Java 2D graphics or 3D OpenGL + CUDA programming;
  • Experience working with Cascading Style Sheets (CSS).

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Java UI Application Developer
description:
Java UI Application Developer

Brazil

Senior Software Engineer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Java UI Application developer to lead the design, development, and optimization of advanced software solutions for geophysical data processing, modeling, visualization and interpretation. In this role, you will collaborate closely with geoscientists to create innovative tools that enhance data-driven decision-making through powerful visualization and interpretation capabilities. You will also collaborate with global development teams across Europe, Canada, and the United States, contributing to a dynamic and international engineering environment.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Collaborate closely with a UX design team, product owners, and software engineers to translate UX requirements into robust GUI implementations with Eclipse RCP/SWT;
  • Present software designs and technical proposals to lead;
  • Ability to break down development tasks and lay out clear implementation roadmaps;
  • Implement and optimize computation algorithms;
  • Design and develop both thin and thick client applications that interact with cloud-based microservices;
  • Working with complex UI Java threading and concurrency;
  • Working with a large code base and multiple distributed development teams;
  • Ensure high code quality through unit testing, code reviews, security hardening and continuous integration with other domain tools;
  • Provide technical support and lead user troubleshooting sessions to resolve issues and ensure smooth operation of a complex RCP desktop application;
  • Mentor junior developers and actively contribute to architectural and implementation decisions;
  • Embrace Agile/Scrum methodologies, delivering and demonstrating working solutions at the end of each sprint;
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and trends in computing and software development.

Essential Skills

  • BS or MS degree in computer science, Geoscience, Applied Mathematics, or a related engineering discipline;
  • Ability to break down complex development tasks and define clear, actionable implementation of roadmaps;
  • Preferred strong Java experience;
  • GitLab/Github, Eclipse RCP/SWT, VS Code, CI/CD pipelines;
  • Performance tools: VisualVM, JMC/JFR, Async;
  • Operating systems: Windows and Linux;
  • Must be self-motivated and able to work well in a distributed team environment;
  • Experience developing commercial thick client desktop applications.

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Hands-on experience using Agentic AI to accelerate code implementation and enhance development productivity;
  • C++ knowledge and experience a benefit;
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms and distributed computing;
  • Restful API design and implementation;
  • AWS and Azure;
  • Tools for scalable data processing: Kubernetes, Spark;
  • Experience with Java 2D graphics or 3D OpenGL + CUDA programming;
  • Experience working with Cascading Style Sheets (CSS).

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Sourcer Júnior para integrar o time de Talent Acquisition com foco em contratações LATAM da AI/R Company. Empresas como Avenue Code, Invillia e Compass UOL fazem parte do grupo.

Você irá apoiar o mapeamento de mercado, a identificação de talentos e a construção de pipelines, atuando em parceria com recrutadores para contribuir com processos mais assertivos e uma boa experiência para os candidatos.


Você será responsável por:

  • Apoiar na identificação, mapeamento e prospecção de talentos para posições técnicas (Desenvolvimento, QA, DevOps, Data, etc.);
  • Utilizar estratégias de sourcing com apoio do time;
  • Criar e manter listas e pipelines de talentos organizados;
  • Realizar primeiros contatos com candidatos, apresentando oportunidades;
  • Atualizar e manter informações em ferramentas como ATS e LinkedIn;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com recrutadores e lideranças para entender perfis e prioridades;
  • Apoiar na geração de relatórios simples de recrutamento;
  • Contribuir com ações de employer branding e engajamento de talentos.


O que você precisa ter:

  • Experiência com recrutamento, sourcing ou pesquisa de talentos;
  • Experiência trabalhando com SLA curto de entrega de candidatos;
  • Interesse por tecnologia e pelo mercado de talentos tech;
  • Familiaridade com LinkedIn ou outras plataformas de busca de perfis;
  • Organização, atenção aos detalhes e curiosidade por desafios;
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal;
  • Inglês avançado para conversação.



A Avenue Code reforça seu compromisso com a privacidade e com todos os princípios assegurados pelas legislações de proteção de dados mais rigorosas do mundo, como a GDPR, LGPD, CCPA e CPRA. Os dados dos(as) candidatos(as) compartilhados serão mantidos sob confidencialidade e utilizados exclusivamente para fins de recrutamento, podendo ser compartilhados com clientes e empresas do Grupo CompassUol envolvidas nos projetos.

title: Analista de Service Desk Trilingue Sênior - Francês Canadense - Remoto
description:
Analista de Service Desk Trilingue Sênior, HCLTech



Brasil (Remoto) / Analista de Service Desk Trilingue Sênior / Integral


Somos a HCLTech, uma das maiores empresas de tecnologia e DSA que mais crescem no mundo, com mais de 219.000 profissionais espalhados em 54 países, impulsionando o progresso através de recursos líderes do segmento e centrados nas áreas de Digital, Engenharia e Nuvem.


A força motriz por trás desse trabalho, nosso pessoal, é um público diversificado, criativo e apaixonado, o que nos possibilita estar sempre elevando o padrão de excelência de nossos serviços. De nosso lado, trabalhamos para que cada um de nossos profissionais possa atingir seu melhor, ao mesmo tempo em que nos esforçamos para ajudá-los a encontrar sua inspiração diária e, assim, se tornar a melhor versão de si mesmos.


Estamos à procura de um Analista de Service Desk Trilingue Sênior altamente talentoso e automotivado para se juntar a nós em nossa jornada para avançar no mundo tecnológico por meio da inovação e criatividade.


Seu Papel & Responsabilidades:


• Fornecer diagnóstico / resolução de problemas de hardware / software / rede via telefone, chat e e-mail para os usuários finais do cliente.

• Resolver ou encaminhar incidentes e solicitações para as equipes apropriadas.

• Coordenar e gerenciar relacionamentos com fornecedores e equipes de suporte que fornecem resolução de problemas de hardware / software / rede.

• Administrar e fornecer controles de acesso e saída do usuário.

• Participar de treinamento prático e comercial projetado para aprimorar habilidades e recursos de suporte.

• Disposto a trabalhar em diferentes turnos e feriados nacionais, conforme exigido pelas Operações.

• Indicar procedimentos faltantes para a equipe de gestão a fim de melhorar a documentação.

• Atuar com excelência como ponto focal para problemas e solicitações do usuário final


Qualificações & Experiência


  • FRANCÊS CANADENSE nível AVANÇADO/FLUENTE (comunicação, escrita e leitura)
  • Português nível AVANÇADO/FLUENTE (comunicação, escrita e leitura)
  • Inglês nível AVANÇADO (comunicação, escrita e leitura)
  • Experiência com Suporte remoto.


Por que nos escolher?


  • Somos uma das maiores empresas de tecnologia que mais crescem no mundo, com escritórios em mais de 54 países e 219.000 colaboradores
  • Nossa empresa é extremamente diversificada com 165 nacionalidades representadas
  • Oferecemos a oportunidade de trabalhar com colegas espalhados ao redor do mundo
  • Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho virtual em primeiro lugar, promovendo uma boa integração entre seu trabalho e vida pessoal, em uma flexibilidade real
  • Estamos comprometidos com seu crescimento, oferecendo oportunidades de aprendizado e desenvolvimento de carreira em todos os níveis para ajudá-lo a encontrar seu brilho único.
  • Oferecemos benefícios abrangentes para todos os funcionários
  • Somos certificados como \"Great Place to Work\" e \"Top Employer\" em 17 países, e reconhecidos como “Top Employer” no Brasil especificamente, oferecendo um ambiente de trabalho positivo que valoriza o reconhecimento e o respeito dos funcionários


Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos


Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

Você irá apoiar o mapeamento de mercado, a identificação de talentos e a construção de pipelines, atuando em parceria com recrutadores para contribuir com processos mais assertivos e uma boa experiência para os candidatos.


Você será responsável por:

  • Apoiar na identificação, mapeamento e prospecção de talentos para posições técnicas (Desenvolvimento, QA, DevOps, Data, etc.);
  • Utilizar estratégias de sourcing com apoio do time;
  • Criar e manter listas e pipelines de talentos organizados;
  • Realizar primeiros contatos com candidatos, apresentando oportunidades;
  • Atualizar e manter informações em ferramentas como ATS e LinkedIn;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com recrutadores e lideranças para entender perfis e prioridades;
  • Apoiar na geração de relatórios simples de recrutamento;
  • Contribuir com ações de employer branding e engajamento de talentos.


O que você precisa ter:

  • Experiência com recrutamento, sourcing ou pesquisa de talentos;
  • Experiência trabalhando com SLA curto de entrega de candidatos;
  • Interesse por tecnologia e pelo mercado de talentos tech;
  • Familiaridade com LinkedIn ou outras plataformas de busca de perfis;
  • Organização, atenção aos detalhes e curiosidade por desafios;
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal;
  • Inglês avançado para conversação.



A Avenue Code reforça seu compromisso com a privacidade e com todos os princípios assegurados pelas legislações de proteção de dados mais rigorosas do mundo, como a GDPR, LGPD, CCPA e CPRA. Os dados dos(as) candidatos(as) compartilhados serão mantidos sob confidencialidade e utilizados exclusivamente para fins de recrutamento, podendo ser compartilhados com clientes e empresas do Grupo CompassUol envolvidas nos projetos.

title: Associate Account Executive - Biopharma
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as AbbVie, Astrazeneca, Pfizer, Merck. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


Our Biopharma team is growing, and we are looking for an experienced Associate Account Executive to expand institutional sales of our scientific video journal and databases to biopharma companies in North America. If you are ambitious, results-driven, and can develop relationships with scientists and progress opportunities, this position could be an excellent opportunity for you.


Responsibilities:


  • Own the full sales cycle, from prospecting to closing business for assigned biopharma accounts.
  • Conduct active outreach to build and progress opportunities in the pipeline to meet or exceed sales goals.
  • Build and execute a persistent outbound sales strategy, including cold calls and emails, to generate interest and accelerate new business generation.
  • Establish and maintain strong and professional relationships with biopharma librarians, R&D leadership and stakeholders.
  • Work with the marketing and customer success teams to customize marketing activities & provide support for each account.


Requirements:


  • A bachelor's degree
  • 2+ years of direct selling experience to stakeholders in the pharmaceutical, biotech, device, or healthcare industry.
  • Demonstrated success in meeting and exceeding sales objectives.
  • Proven ability to influence decision-makers and manage a full sales cycle.
  • Highly effective verbal and written communication skills.
  • A disciplined approach to daily activity planning, setting goals, and achieving success.
  • Experience with Salesforce or relevant sales CRM, MS Office is required.


Why Join JoVE?


  • A competitive compensation package, including unlimited commissions.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and productivity.
  • Opportunity to work in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
About

Flatiron is a global remote software development company with engineers located around the world. We unite experts from diverse backgrounds and experiences in a collaborative culture to deliver exceptional products and services for our clients. As a forward-thinking software engineering company, we provide industry-leading solutions to complex problems in both the US and the UK. Operating in a fast-paced, agile environment, we specialize in software consulting for our clients. We offer a stimulating and rewarding environment for our team members. We value innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone can thrive. Join us at Flatiron and be a part of a team that is shaping the future of software development.


Job Summary

This is a full-time fully remote working opportunity where you will be working as part of a Scrum team which requires working closely with other software engineers, stakeholders and contributors on the project. Working with respect to the US timezone is a requirement for the position. Attending meetings, being actively involved in the decision making process and collaborating with all of these stakeholders are essential parts of this position.


Responsibilities

  • Design and implement scalable, high-performance full stack applications with a strong emphasis on backend architecture.
  • Lead and contribute to the integration of AI/ML features into products, collaborating closely with data scientists and engineers.
  • Develop robust backend services and APIs using Python or Node.js (Express, NestJS) .
  • Contribute to frontend development using React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript practices.
  • Identify, prioritize, and execute tasks throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Debug, optimize, and maintain backend systems, APIs, and data workflows.
  • Ensure code quality through testing, code reviews, and best engineering practices.
  • Document development phases, monitor system performance, and improve reliability.
  • Participate in Scrum meetings and contribute to product and technical decision-making.


Qualifications

  • Higher education in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, ideally with a focus on Artificial Intelligence and/or Machine Learning
  • Advanced level of written and oral English proficiency.
  • 4+ years of professional software development experience, with strong backend expertise in Python and/or Node.js.
  • Proficiency with frontend technologies such as React, Next.js, and TypeScript .
  • Hands-on experience deploying ML/AI models into production environments.
  • Familiarity with database technologies such as MySQL, MongoDB, or PostgreSQL.
  • Strong understanding of Object-Oriented Programming, Agile development principles, and cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Interest in applied AI and automation-driven development.


Benefits

  • Yearly Office Allowance Budget
  • Macbook Purchase Support
  • Wellbeing Support


If you are a good fit for the position, please apply through LinkedIn.

We only accept CVs that are in English.


Flatiron has a zero tolerance to discrimination policy. In this regard, during the course of the evaluation of your job application and all your employment relation, if any, all discriminatory factors such as race, sex, sexual orientation, social gender definitions/roles, color, national or social background, ethnicity, religion, age, disablement, political opinion or any status that is protected under law shall be disregarded.

title: Golden Visa & Citizenship Advisor – Latin America
description:
Remote | Report to Athens HQ

Independent Contractor

Uncapped commission - top performers earn €100,000–€200,000+


Who We Are


We believe ambitious people should not be prisoners of their passport.


PassBeyond helps high-net-worth individuals secure European residency and citizenship through Greek property investment. Our clients invest €250,000–€800,000+ and receive residency or citizenship for themselves and their families - gaining Schengen access, euro-denominated assets, and long-term optionality.


Founded by Andreas Afeldt, who is based full-time in Athens and has spent over a decade working with high-net-worth clients across international markets. PassBeyond sits between global institutional scale and personal, founder-led trust — with deep local knowledge in Greece and cultural fluency across every market we serve.


We’re looking for a Relationship Manager to serve clients from India and South Asia.


The Role


This is not a traditional sales role. We’re looking for someone who already moves in the same circles as successful entrepreneurs, business owners, and senior professionals - and who can introduce them to an opportunity that provides real security and optionality for their families.


You will:


• Introduce PassBeyond to high-net-worth individuals in your network

• Help clients understand the real numbers, real timelines, and real risks - so they can make an informed decision

• Walk alongside clients from first conversation through to permit in hand

• Build trust through genuine conversation - not scripts or pressure tactics

• Work remotely with full support from our Athens headquarters


We’re not looking for cold-callers or lead-chasers. We’re looking for trusted connectors.


Who Our Clients Are


• Entrepreneurs, business owners, and investors with €250,000–€800,000+ to invest

• Self-made successes who built wealth through talent and persistence

• Often from environments where institutions have failed them - they’re sceptical for good reason

• Looking for optionality: security, Schengen access, European education, and peace of mind for their families

• They value relationships over transactions and won’t be rushed or pressured


Our clients need someone who understands their world, respects their scepticism, and guides with patience and honesty.


What We’re Looking For


Essential:


• Existing relationships with HNWIs in LATAM

• Cultural fluency - you genuinely understand the communities you’d serve

• Fluent English (written and verbal)

• Comfortable with commission-only compensation

• Integrity - you’d rather lose a deal than mislead someone


Highly Desirable:


• Experience in real estate, immigration, wealth management, or financial services

• Active LinkedIn presence


Backgrounds that often do well:


• Business owners and entrepreneurs

• Private bankers and wealth managers

• Lawyers and accountants serving affluent clients
