title: Senior/Principal .NET Developer
description:
Project Description:

We are looking for passionate and creative engineers who are eager to build innovative products and embrace new technologies at a leading hedge fund. You will be part of a small, agile, and highly skilled team of technologists building next‑generation platforms to optimize investment decisions.


Responsibilities:

As a Frameworks Developer, you will play a key role in building and evolving the firm’s core application framework used by development teams across the organization. This is a highly collaborative, hands‑on role with broad impact.


Key responsibilities:

- Plan, develop, and support the firm’s in‑house application framework

- Define and contribute to low‑level architecture and core design decisions

- Partner with development teams to help kickstart new projects and provide technical expertise

- Collaborate with developers and business users across the organization to deliver mission‑critical platforms and services

- Support investment professionals across equities, credit, and other major asset classes

- Work closely with the broader Technology team on cross‑functional initiatives


Mandatory Skills Description:

- At least 8 years of professional software development experience

Deep expertise in

- C#,

- ASP.NET,

- SQL Server

- Good working knowledge of Angular, JavaScript / TypeScript, HTML, CSS

- Full SDLC experience: requirements, implementation, testing, release, and support

- Strong focus on clean, high‑performance code (SOLID principles)

- Experience with multi‑threaded programming

- Proven ability to build scalable, high‑availability applications and support production systems

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, including technical discussions

- Strong team‑oriented, collaborative working style

- Independent, proactive mindset with a high level of ownership and collaboration


Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

- CI/CD systems (TeamCity, Octopus Deploy)

- Financial products (equities, derivatives, fixed income, etc. and related terminology)

- Order management systems (i.e., Charles River)

- Working with market data (i.e., Bloomberg Terminal, Bloomberg APIs)

- Workload automation and enterprise job scheduling software (i.e., ActiveBatch)

- Profiling and performance tuning techniques throughout the whole stack


Languages:

English: C1 Advanced

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Role Overview


Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company’s foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration.


Key Responsibilities


Business Process Engineering (Core Expectation)

  • Conduct needs assessments with department leads to identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes.
  • Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes.
  • Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations.
  • Manage change adoption by providing training, documentation, and ongoing support for newly implemented tools.

Automation, Integration & AI Implementation

  • Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our SaaS ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, JavaScript).
  • Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks.
  • Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software.

  • Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365).
  • Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access.
  • Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security.
  • Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate SaaS contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl.

Technical Experience:

  • Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment.
  • Strong understanding of cloud-based SaaS ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures.
  • High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting.

title: Workday Adaptive Planning Consultant
description:
Job Summary

Client is seeking a senior-level Workday Adaptive Planning Consultant to lead the architecture, design, and build of complex planning solutions. This individual will be a hands-on consultant responsible for developing scalable planning models, supporting integrations across Adaptive Planning and Oracle platforms, and partnering with Finance, RevOps, Data, and IT teams to deliver business-critical planning capabilities. The ideal candidate will bring deep Adaptive Planning expertise, strong financial planning knowledge, and the ability to translate business requirements into high-impact system solutions.


Key Responsibilities

  • Architect, design, and build scalable planning models in Workday Adaptive Planning
  • Develop and optimize complex models including dimensions, sheets, versions, assumptions, and driver-based logic
  • Design, support, and improve integrations and data workflows across Adaptive Planning and Oracle platforms
  • Partner with Finance, RevOps, Data, and IT teams to translate planning requirements into sustainable system solutions
  • Troubleshoot model and integration issues and improve overall system performance, scalability, and usability
  • Create clear documentation and provide knowledge transfer to support long-term ownership and adoption
  • Act as a senior consultant, owning delivery quality and supporting key stakeholder relationships


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of hands-on Workday Adaptive Planning experience
  • Proven experience architecting and building Adaptive Planning solutions, not just maintaining existing models
  • Deep expertise in:
  • Dimensions
  • Sheets
  • Versions
  • Assumptions
  • Driver-based planning logic
  • Complex calculations
  • Performance tuning and model optimization
  • Proven experience integrating Workday Adaptive Planning with Oracle EPM and/or Oracle ERP
  • Strong understanding of planning data structures, financial data flows, and integration best practices
  • Strong knowledge of financial planning and FP&A processes , including budgeting and forecasting

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Role Overview


Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company’s foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration.


Key Responsibilities


Business Process Engineering (Core Expectation)

  • Conduct needs assessments with department leads to identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes.
  • Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes.
  • Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations.
  • Manage change adoption by providing training, documentation, and ongoing support for newly implemented tools.

Automation, Integration & AI Implementation

  • Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our SaaS ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, JavaScript).
  • Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks.
  • Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software.

IT Administration & Security

  • Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365).
  • Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access.
  • Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security.
  • Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate SaaS contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl.


Required Qualifications & Skills


Technical Experience:

  • 5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration.
  • Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment.
  • Strong understanding of cloud-based SaaS ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures.
  • High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting.
  • Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows.
  • Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols.


Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies:

  • Communication: Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity.
  • Critical Thinking: Strong analytical approach to problem-solving; ability to identify the root causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms.
  • Decision-Making: Highly autonomous execution; capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions.


Benefits & Compensation

  • Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Role Overview


Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company’s foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration.


Key Responsibilities


Business Process Engineering (Core Expectation)

  • Conduct needs assessments with department leads to identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes.
  • Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes.
  • Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations.
  • Manage change adoption by providing training, documentation, and ongoing support for newly implemented tools.

Automation, Integration & AI Implementation

  • Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our SaaS ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, JavaScript).
  • Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks.
  • Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software.

IT Administration & Security

  • Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365).
  • Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access.
  • Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security.
  • Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate SaaS contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl.


Required Qualifications & Skills


Technical Experience:

  • 5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration.
  • Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment.
  • Strong understanding of cloud-based SaaS ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures.
  • High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting.
  • Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows.
  • Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols.


Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies:

  • Communication: Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity.
  • Critical Thinking: Strong analytical approach to problem-solving; ability to identify the root causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms.
  • Decision-Making: Highly autonomous execution; capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions.


Benefits & Compensation

  • Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Role Overview


Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company’s foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration.


Key Responsibilities


Business Process Engineering (Core Expectation)

  • Conduct needs assessments with department leads to identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes.
  • Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes.
  • Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations.
  • Manage change adoption by providing training, documentation, and ongoing support for newly implemented tools.

Automation, Integration & AI Implementation

  • Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our SaaS ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, JavaScript).
  • Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks.
  • Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software.

IT Administration & Security

  • Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365).
  • Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access.
  • Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security.
  • Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate SaaS contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl.


Required Qualifications & Skills


Technical Experience:

  • 5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration.
  • Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment.
  • Strong understanding of cloud-based SaaS ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures.
  • High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting.
  • Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows.
  • Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols.


Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies:

  • Communication: Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity.
  • Critical Thinking: Strong analytical approach to problem-solving; ability to identify the root causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms.
  • Decision-Making: Highly autonomous execution; capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions.


Benefits & Compensation

  • Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

title: Workday Adaptive Planning Consultant
description:
Job Summary

Client is seeking a senior-level Workday Adaptive Planning Consultant to lead the architecture, design, and build of complex planning solutions. This individual will be a hands-on consultant responsible for developing scalable planning models, supporting integrations across Adaptive Planning and Oracle platforms, and partnering with Finance, RevOps, Data, and IT teams to deliver business-critical planning capabilities. The ideal candidate will bring deep Adaptive Planning expertise, strong financial planning knowledge, and the ability to translate business requirements into high-impact system solutions.


Key Responsibilities

  • Architect, design, and build scalable planning models in Workday Adaptive Planning
  • Develop and optimize complex models including dimensions, sheets, versions, assumptions, and driver-based logic
  • Design, support, and improve integrations and data workflows across Adaptive Planning and Oracle platforms
  • Partner with Finance, RevOps, Data, and IT teams to translate planning requirements into sustainable system solutions
  • Troubleshoot model and integration issues and improve overall system performance, scalability, and usability
  • Create clear documentation and provide knowledge transfer to support long-term ownership and adoption
  • Act as a senior consultant, owning delivery quality and supporting key stakeholder relationships


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of hands-on Workday Adaptive Planning experience
  • Proven experience architecting and building Adaptive Planning solutions, not just maintaining existing models
  • Deep expertise in:
  • Dimensions
  • Sheets
  • Versions
  • Assumptions
  • Driver-based planning logic
  • Complex calculations
  • Performance tuning and model optimization
  • Proven experience integrating Workday Adaptive Planning with Oracle EPM and/or Oracle ERP
  • Strong understanding of planning data structures, financial data flows, and integration best practices
  • Strong knowledge of financial planning and FP&A processes , including budgeting and forecasting
  • Ability to connect technical configuration decisions to business and financial outcomes
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex models to non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Finance, RevOps, Data, and IT

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting SaaS or recurring revenue business models
  • Experience leading or influencing Adaptive Planning best practices and standards
  • Background in multi-entity or high-growth organizations
  • Prior consulting or advisory experience in complex planning environments

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • Senior, hands-on consultant comfortable owning solution delivery end to end
  • Strong technical builder with business-facing communication skills
  • Able to operate independently while partnering across multiple functional teams
  • Skilled at balancing architecture, execution, troubleshooting, and stakeholder management

description:
Role Overview


Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company’s foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration.


Key Responsibilities


Business Process Engineering (Core Expectation)

  • Conduct needs assessments with department leads to identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes.
  • Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes.
  • Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations.
  • Manage change adoption by providing training, documentation, and ongoing support for newly implemented tools.

Automation, Integration & AI Implementation

  • Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our SaaS ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, JavaScript).
  • Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks.
  • Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software.

IT Administration & Security

  • Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365).
  • Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access.
  • Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security.
  • Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate SaaS contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl.


Required Qualifications & Skills


Technical Experience:

  • 5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration.
  • Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment.
  • Strong understanding of cloud-based SaaS ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures.
  • High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting.
  • Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows.
  • Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols.


Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies:

  • Communication: Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity.
  • Critical Thinking: Strong analytical approach to problem-solving; ability to identify the root causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms.
  • Decision-Making: Highly autonomous execution; capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions.


Benefits & Compensation

  • Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

title: Senior Backend (Node.js) Engineer
description:
About Us

Founded in 2019 by two best friends, Jon and Eli, XILO set out to revolutionize the insurance industry by solving its biggest challenges. Eli, a brokerage owner, brought invaluable industry expertise, while Jon, an experienced software engineer, saw an opportunity to innovate using technology. Initially launched as a vertical SaaS solution addressing core quoting challenges, XILO has since evolved into a trailblazing Vertical AI company leveraging the latest AI technology to transform the industry. By layering cutting-edge AI solutions onto its SaaS platform, XILO is driving innovation far beyond its original vision. Having recently closed our Series A funding round, XILO is growing rapidly and seeking talented individuals who want to do career-defining work in a mission-driven startup that’s at the forefront of AI innovation.


About The Role

As a Senior Backend Engineer , you’ll be designing and architecting scalable solutions , creating robust APIs, and building new microservices from the ground up —while also improving and optimizing our existing systems. This isn’t just another engineering role. We’re solving real, painful inefficiencies in the insurance space – problems so frustrating that prospects have nearly teared up during sales calls, realizing how much time and effort we could save them. What we’re building isn’t just an upgrade – it’s a fundamental shift in how agencies operate .


What You’ll Do:

  • Architect and develop scalable TypeScript microservices powering XILO’s platform.
  • You’ll have the opportunity to work where your strengths shine and contribute to:
  • AI Agents – Automating complex decision-making and workflows
  • OCR & Document Processing – Extracting, structuring, and analyzing key insights from insurance documents
  • Intelligent Data Mapping – Aggregating and linking all relevant data into a centralized, dynamic user profile

description:

Founded in 2019 by two best friends, Jon and Eli, XILO set out to revolutionize the insurance industry by solving its biggest challenges. Eli, a brokerage owner, brought invaluable industry expertise, while Jon, an experienced software engineer, saw an opportunity to innovate using technology. Initially launched as a vertical SaaS solution addressing core quoting challenges, XILO has since evolved into a trailblazing Vertical AI company leveraging the latest AI technology to transform the industry. By layering cutting-edge AI solutions onto its SaaS platform, XILO is driving innovation far beyond its original vision. Having recently closed our Series A funding round, XILO is growing rapidly and seeking talented individuals who want to do career-defining work in a mission-driven startup that’s at the forefront of AI innovation.


About The Role

As a Senior Backend Engineer , you’ll be designing and architecting scalable solutions , creating robust APIs, and building new microservices from the ground up —while also improving and optimizing our existing systems. This isn’t just another engineering role. We’re solving real, painful inefficiencies in the insurance space – problems so frustrating that prospects have nearly teared up during sales calls, realizing how much time and effort we could save them. What we’re building isn’t just an upgrade – it’s a fundamental shift in how agencies operate .


What You’ll Do:

  • Architect and develop scalable TypeScript microservices powering XILO’s platform.
  • You’ll have the opportunity to work where your strengths shine and contribute to:
  • AI Agents – Automating complex decision-making and workflows
  • OCR & Document Processing – Extracting, structuring, and analyzing key insights from insurance documents
  • Intelligent Data Mapping – Aggregating and linking all relevant data into a centralized, dynamic user profile
  • Advanced Insurance Operations & CRM – The AI-powered backbone of agencies, seamlessly tracking, managing, and integrating customer data across tools and workflows while replacing outdated, manual processes
  • Forms Builder & Smart Data Entry – A Typeform-like system built for insurance, enabling error-proof, collaborative submissions – fill once, apply everywhere
  • Optimize system performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, frontend, data science) to deliver seamless integrations.
  • Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented team culture.
  • Implement best practices for API security, data privacy, and maintainability.


What we’re looking for

  • Strong experience with Node.js
  • Proven expertise in designing and developing software product features, with a focus on scalability, performance, and maintainability.

  • Collaborative and innovative work environment
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Budget for English lessons.

  • A great tech startup – Small, fast-moving, and driven by real impact
  • Endless career growth – Help shape the team, tech, and company as we scale
  • Strong leadership & backing – Work alongside experienced founders and tier 1 silicon-valley VCs

As a Senior Backend Engineer , you’ll be designing and architecting scalable solutions , creating robust APIs, and building new microservices from the ground up —while also improving and optimizing our existing systems. This isn’t just another engineering role. We’re solving real, painful inefficiencies in the insurance space – problems so frustrating that prospects have nearly teared up during sales calls, realizing how much time and effort we could save them. What we’re building isn’t just an upgrade – it’s a fundamental shift in how agencies operate .


What You’ll Do:

  • Architect and develop scalable TypeScript microservices powering XILO’s platform.
  • You’ll have the opportunity to work where your strengths shine and contribute to:
  • AI Agents – Automating complex decision-making and workflows
  • OCR & Document Processing – Extracting, structuring, and analyzing key insights from insurance documents
  • Intelligent Data Mapping – Aggregating and linking all relevant data into a centralized, dynamic user profile
  • Advanced Insurance Operations & CRM – The AI-powered backbone of agencies, seamlessly tracking, managing, and integrating customer data across tools and workflows while replacing outdated, manual processes
  • Forms Builder & Smart Data Entry – A Typeform-like system built for insurance, enabling error-proof, collaborative submissions – fill once, apply everywhere
  • Optimize system performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, frontend, data science) to deliver seamless integrations.
  • Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented team culture.
  • Implement best practices for API security, data privacy, and maintainability.


What we’re looking for

  • 7+ years of backend development experience, with a strong foundation in TypeScript and JavaScript.
  • Strong experience with Node.js
  • Proven expertise in designing and developing software product features, with a focus on scalability, performance, and maintainability.
  • Proven expertise in REST API design – including authentication, performance optimization, and security best practices.
  • Experience with XML and SOAP-based integrations, commonly used in the insurance industry.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Nest.js, leveraging its modular architecture for scalable backend services.
  • Familiarity with NX monorepos for structuring and maintaining large-scale applications.
  • Cloud deployment experience on Heroku and AWS, including CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure management.
  • Deep understanding of database management, ORM usage (e.g., TypeORM, Prisma, Sequelize), and zero-downtime migration strategies.
  • Experience designing and implementing microservices architectures, including inter-service communication, data consistency, and service decoupling.
  • Bonus: Full-stack experience with modern frontend frameworks like Angular.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).


What we offer

  • Collaborative and innovative work environment
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Budget for English lessons.


Why Join XILO?

  • A great tech startup – Small, fast-moving, and driven by real impact
  • Endless career growth – Help shape the team, tech, and company as we scale
  • Strong leadership & backing – Work alongside experienced founders and tier 1 silicon-valley VCs



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Senior Recruiter
description:
About the Role

We're looking for a seasoned, self-driven Senior Recruiter to join our team. You'll own the full recruitment lifecycle for key roles across business, operations, and tech functions — from first outreach to offer acceptance. This isn't a coordinator role — we need someone who can hunt, pitch, and close.


You'll be embedded in a fast-moving startup environment within a large company, so comfort with ambiguity, speed, and working with fast paced goals.



What You'll Do

  • Own full-cycle recruiting across multiple functions — from intake to offer, very independently.
  • Lead proactive sourcing through LinkedIn, Boolean search, talent mapping, referrals, and local networks in Brazil
  • Identify and engage passive candidates — you know how to get a response where others don't
  • Partner with hiring managers to define role requirements, set expectations, and move fast without sacrificing quality
  • Drive early-stage pipeline building for new market entry roles and hard-to-fill positions
  • Help shape recruiting processes and tooling as a founding team member in this market



What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, ideally in a high-growth tech, startup, or new market environment
  • Proven track record in proactive/passive sourcing.
  • Experience building pipelines from scratch in early-stage or greenfield markets
  • Strong English communication skills (written and verbal) — you'll work with regional and global stakeholders regularly.
  • High ownership mentality — you're comfortable owning a req end-to-end without a lot of process guardrails
  • Familiarity with ATS platforms (Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, etc.)
  • Experience working in cross-cultural or multinational teams is a strong plus

title: Data Annotator
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.


Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.


We’re excited to share that Innodata Inc. is expanding its AI and Machine Learning Talent Network , and we’re looking for passionate, detail-oriented professionals to join us as Data Annotators and Content Moderators (Review & Labeling) .

If you enjoy working with data, have a strong eye for detail, and wish to contribute to real-world AI innovation , this is a wonderful opportunity to become part of a forward-thinking global team .


Location: Brazil, Language: Portuguese


Key Responsibilities

  • Review, label, and moderate online content (may include sensitive material).
  • Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and overall quality.
  • Contribute to building AI training datasets for next-generation systems.
  • Provide feedback and insights to enhance ongoing processes.


Requirements

  • Minimum qualification: High School completed or pursuing Bachelors.
  • Strong command of English (written and verbal) .
  • Excellent analytical and communication skills .
  • Comfortable working with diverse content types.
  • Access to a private, secure workspace with stable internet .


If you’re detail-oriented, tech-curious , and eager to contribute to the future of AI , we’d love to have you in our growing network.

title: Especialista em Infraestrutura Azure
description:
A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.


O que Buscamos?



O Customer Success Architect (CSA) – Infraestrutura do Azure (Armazenamento, Arquivos, Rede) é responsável por orientar os clientes no desenho, na implantação, na operação e na otimização de soluções de Azure Storage, Azure Files e Azure Networking. Essa função atua como um(a) consultor(a) técnico(a) de confiança, garantindo que os clientes alcancem resultados de negócio e técnicos por meio de uma infraestrutura de nuvem segura, escalável, resiliente e bem governada, alinhada às melhores práticas da Microsoft e ao Cloud Adoption Framework.



✅ Competências e conhecimentos técnicos essenciais

Azure Storage – Fundamentos e arquitetura

• Arquitetura de contas do Azure Storage e considerações de design

• Serviços de armazenamento: Blob Storage, Azure Files, Azure Disks, Queue Storage e Table Storage

• Camadas de desempenho e opções de redundância (LRS, ZRS, GRS, GZRS)

• Planejamento de capacidade, escalabilidade e otimização de custos

• Gerenciamento do ciclo de vida dos dados e estratégias de tiering

Azure Files

• Arquitetura do Azure Files e protocolos suportados (SMB, NFS)

• Integração de identidade com Azure AD e Active Directory

• Camadas de desempenho de compartilhamentos de arquivos e casos de uso

• Cenários de migração a partir de servidores de arquivos on-premises

• Alta disponibilidade, snapshots e integração com backup

Azure Networking – Conceitos principais

title: Data Annotator
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.


Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.


We’re excited to share that Innodata Inc. is expanding its AI and Machine Learning Talent Network , and we’re looking for passionate, detail-oriented professionals to join us as Data Annotators and Content Moderators (Review & Labeling) .

If you enjoy working with data, have a strong eye for detail, and wish to contribute to real-world AI innovation , this is a wonderful opportunity to become part of a forward-thinking global team .


Location: Brazil, Language: Portuguese


Key Responsibilities

  • Review, label, and moderate online content (may include sensitive material).
  • Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and overall quality.
  • Contribute to building AI training datasets for next-generation systems.
  • Provide feedback and insights to enhance ongoing processes.


Requirements

  • Minimum qualification: High School completed or pursuing Bachelors.
  • Strong command of English (written and verbal) .
  • Excellent analytical and communication skills .
  • Comfortable working with diverse content types.
  • Access to a private, secure workspace with stable internet .


If you’re detail-oriented, tech-curious , and eager to contribute to the future of AI , we’d love to have you in our growing network.


If Interested, kindly send your resume at: .

title: Tech Lead Software Engineering  - TypeScript (Remote)
description:
A Brunel está apoiando uma empresa inovadora do segmento de georastreamento e rastreamento inteligente , que utiliza tecnologia para gerar insights estratégicos através de dados de localização em tempo real.

Buscamos um(a) Engineering Tech Lead com perfil hands-on , que combine excelência técnica com capacidade de liderança, atuando diretamente no desenvolvimento e na evolução de um produto altamente escalável e orientado a dados.


Sobre a posição:


Essa posição tem um equilíbrio entre desenvolvimento (50%) e liderança (50%) , sendo ideal para alguém que gosta de codar, tomar decisões técnicas e desenvolver pessoas ao mesmo tempo .

Você liderará um time ágil multidisciplinar, garantindo entregas de alta qualidade enquanto contribui ativamente com o código e a arquitetura das soluções.

A posição é 100% remota e o modelo de contrato é CLT. Inglês é essencial, pois a comunicação será com times internacionais .


Principais responsabilidades:


  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações escaláveis utilizando Node.js e TypeScript
  • Definir e evoluir arquitetura de sistemas (microserviços e integrações)
  • Garantir boas práticas de desenvolvimento, testes e deploy
  • Atuar na resolução de problemas técnicos complexos
  • Assegurar performance, confiabilidade e segurança das aplicações
  • Liderar, mentorar e desenvolver engenheiros
  • Conduzir cerimônias ágeis (Scrum)
  • Gerenciar backlog, priorização e definição de histórias
  • Garantir entregas dentro do prazo e com qualidade
  • Balancear evolução do produto com gestão de dívida técnica


O que esperamos desse profissional:


  • Perfil hands-on , com forte atuação em código
  • Capacidade de liderar pelo exemplo
  • Experiência em ambientes ágeis e de alta velocidade
  • Forte habilidade de comunicação com stakeholders técnicos e de negócio
  • Visão de produto aliada à execução técnica
  • Forte experiência com Node.js e TypeScript
  • Experiência com arquitetura de microserviços
  • Vivência com AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, etc.)
  • Experiência com Docker e Kubernetes
  • Conhecimento em CI/CD e práticas DevOps
  • Experiência com Scrum/Agile
  • Sólida base em system design e escalabilidade
  • Experiência prévia liderando ou mentorando times


Diferenciais:


  • Experiência com arquitetura orientada a eventos (Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc.)
  • Conhecimento em frontend moderno (React, Angular)
  • Experiência com Ruby on Rails
  • Vivência com ferramentas de observabilidade (Datadog, Grafana, etc.)
  • Experiência em ambientes de alto crescimento (startups/scale-ups)


Experiência:


  • +6 anos em engenharia de software
  • +2 anos em liderança técnica ou gestão de times
  • Experiência com APIs, cloud e sistemas distribuídos

title: Especialista em Infraestrutura Azure
description:
A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.


O que Buscamos?



O Customer Success Architect (CSA) – Infraestrutura do Azure (Armazenamento, Arquivos, Rede) é responsável por orientar os clientes no desenho, na implantação, na operação e na otimização de soluções de Azure Storage, Azure Files e Azure Networking. Essa função atua como um(a) consultor(a) técnico(a) de confiança, garantindo que os clientes alcancem resultados de negócio e técnicos por meio de uma infraestrutura de nuvem segura, escalável, resiliente e bem governada, alinhada às melhores práticas da Microsoft e ao Cloud Adoption Framework.



✅ Competências e conhecimentos técnicos essenciais

Azure Storage – Fundamentos e arquitetura

• Arquitetura de contas do Azure Storage e considerações de design

• Serviços de armazenamento: Blob Storage, Azure Files, Azure Disks, Queue Storage e Table Storage

• Camadas de desempenho e opções de redundância (LRS, ZRS, GRS, GZRS)

• Planejamento de capacidade, escalabilidade e otimização de custos

• Gerenciamento do ciclo de vida dos dados e estratégias de tiering

Azure Files

• Arquitetura do Azure Files e protocolos suportados (SMB, NFS)

• Integração de identidade com Azure AD e Active Directory

• Camadas de desempenho de compartilhamentos de arquivos e casos de uso

• Cenários de migração a partir de servidores de arquivos on-premises

• Alta disponibilidade, snapshots e integração com backup

Azure Networking – Conceitos principais

• Virtual Networks (VNets), sub-redes e endereçamento IP

• Segurança de rede com NSGs e Azure Firewall

• Padrões de conectividade: VPN Gateway, ExpressRoute

• Private Endpoints e service endpoints

• Conceitos de DNS e resolução de nomes no Azure

✅ Monitoramento, observabilidade e operações

• Monitoramento de componentes de Azure Storage, Azure Files e Azure Networking

• Integração com Azure Monitor e Azure Network Watcher

• Métricas de taxa de transferência, latência, disponibilidade e erros

• Monitoramento de contas de armazenamento, compartilhamentos de arquivos e recursos de rede

Logs e análises

• Integração com Log Analytics Workspace

• Análise de logs e métricas usando Kusto Query Language (KQL)

• Criação de Workbooks e dashboards para visibilidade da infraestrutura

• Monitoramento proativo e insights operacionais

✅ Backup, recuperação e resiliência

Proteção de dados e continuidade de negócios

• Conceitos de backup e recuperação para Azure Storage e Azure Files

• Integração com Azure Backup e Recovery Services Vault

• Estratégias de snapshot e validação de restauração

• Requisitos de retenção de dados e conformidade

Alta disponibilidade e recuperação de desastres

• Redundância de armazenamento e arquiteturas com consciência de zona (zone-aware)

• Resiliência de rede e redundância de conectividade

• Cenários de DR entre regiões (cross-region) e híbridos

• Monitoramento de desempenho, capacidade e saúde

✅ Segurança, governança e conformidade

• Melhores práticas de segurança para Azure Storage e Azure Networking

• Criptografia em repouso e em trânsito

• Identidade, controle de acesso e desenho de RBAC

• Governança com Azure Policy e estratégias de tags

• Proteção contra exfiltração de dados e configurações incorretas


Automação e integração (desejável):

• Automação usando PowerShell, Azure CLI ou ARM/Bicep

• Integração com Azure Automation e Logic Apps

• Práticas de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC)

• Runbooks operacionais padronizados

✅ Responsabilidades de Engajamento e Entrega ao Cliente

• Atuar como consultor de confiança para clientes corporativos e de missão crítica

• Projetar e validar arquiteturas de armazenamento e rede do Azure

• Liderar workshops técnicos e revisões de arquitetura

• Apoiar as fases de integração, adoção e otimização

• Solucionar problemas em cenários complexos de armazenamento e rede

• Colaborar com Gerentes de Contas do Cliente (CSAMs), equipes de entrega e parceiros

✅ Perfil de Experiência

• Experiência em projetar e operar soluções de infraestrutura do Azure

• Experiência prática com Azure Storage, Azure Files e Redes

• Experiência com cargas de trabalho de escala empresarial ou de missão crítica

• Familiaridade com ferramentas de governança e monitoramento do Azure

• Fortes habilidades de solução de problemas e relacionamento com o cliente



Contratação CLT

Trabalho Hibrido (Viagens esporádicas)



O que oferecemos?

  • Vale Refeição ou Alimentação;
  • Assistência Médica e Assistência Odontológica;
  • Auxílio creche;
  • Convênio com Farmácia;
  • Parcerias com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas;
  • Parceria de descontos com Seguro Auto e Residência;
  • Gympass;
  • Seguro de Vida;


Promovemos um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e acolhedor. Não fazemos distinção por raça, cor, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade. Todas as candidaturas serão consideradas. O seu interesse em participar deste processo seletivo, automaticamente consente, autoriza e concorda que a PSM COMPANY, no papel de CONTROLADORA, tome decisões referentes ao tratamento de seus dados pessoais para esta finalidade específica, em conformidade com a Lei nº 13.709 – Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD).

Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.


O que Buscamos?



O Customer Success Architect (CSA) – Infraestrutura do Azure (Armazenamento, Arquivos, Rede) é responsável por orientar os clientes no desenho, na implantação, na operação e na otimização de soluções de Azure Storage, Azure Files e Azure Networking. Essa função atua como um(a) consultor(a) técnico(a) de confiança, garantindo que os clientes alcancem resultados de negócio e técnicos por meio de uma infraestrutura de nuvem segura, escalável, resiliente e bem governada, alinhada às melhores práticas da Microsoft e ao Cloud Adoption Framework.



✅ Competências e conhecimentos técnicos essenciais

Azure Storage – Fundamentos e arquitetura

• Arquitetura de contas do Azure Storage e considerações de design

• Serviços de armazenamento: Blob Storage, Azure Files, Azure Disks, Queue Storage e Table Storage

• Camadas de desempenho e opções de redundância (LRS, ZRS, GRS, GZRS)

• Planejamento de capacidade, escalabilidade e otimização de custos

• Gerenciamento do ciclo de vida dos dados e estratégias de tiering

Azure Files

• Arquitetura do Azure Files e protocolos suportados (SMB, NFS)

• Integração de identidade com Azure AD e Active Directory

• Camadas de desempenho de compartilhamentos de arquivos e casos de uso

• Cenários de migração a partir de servidores de arquivos on-premises

• Alta disponibilidade, snapshots e integração com backup

Azure Networking – Conceitos principais

• Virtual Networks (VNets), sub-redes e endereçamento IP

• Segurança de rede com NSGs e Azure Firewall

• Padrões de conectividade: VPN Gateway, ExpressRoute

• Private Endpoints e service endpoints

• Conceitos de DNS e resolução de nomes no Azure

✅ Monitoramento, observabilidade e operações

• Monitoramento de componentes de Azure Storage, Azure Files e Azure Networking

• Integração com Azure Monitor e Azure Network Watcher

• Métricas de taxa de transferência, latência, disponibilidade e erros

• Monitoramento de contas de armazenamento, compartilhamentos de arquivos e recursos de rede

Logs e análises

• Integração com Log Analytics Workspace

• Análise de logs e métricas usando Kusto Query Language (KQL)

• Criação de Workbooks e dashboards para visibilidade da infraestrutura

• Monitoramento proativo e insights operacionais

✅ Backup, recuperação e resiliência

Proteção de dados e continuidade de negócios

• Conceitos de backup e recuperação para Azure Storage e Azure Files

• Integração com Azure Backup e Recovery Services Vault

• Estratégias de snapshot e validação de restauração

• Requisitos de retenção de dados e conformidade

Alta disponibilidade e recuperação de desastres

• Redundância de armazenamento e arquiteturas com consciência de zona (zone-aware)

• Resiliência de rede e redundância de conectividade

• Cenários de DR entre regiões (cross-region) e híbridos

• Monitoramento de desempenho, capacidade e saúde

✅ Segurança, governança e conformidade

• Melhores práticas de segurança para Azure Storage e Azure Networking

• Criptografia em repouso e em trânsito

• Identidade, controle de acesso e desenho de RBAC

• Governança com Azure Policy e estratégias de tags

• Proteção contra exfiltração de dados e configurações incorretas


Automação e integração (desejável):

• Automação usando PowerShell, Azure CLI ou ARM/Bicep

• Integração com Azure Automation e Logic Apps

• Práticas de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC)

• Runbooks operacionais padronizados

✅ Responsabilidades de Engajamento e Entrega ao Cliente

• Atuar como consultor de confiança para clientes corporativos e de missão crítica

• Projetar e validar arquiteturas de armazenamento e rede do Azure

• Liderar workshops técnicos e revisões de arquitetura

• Apoiar as fases de integração, adoção e otimização

• Solucionar problemas em cenários complexos de armazenamento e rede

• Colaborar com Gerentes de Contas do Cliente (CSAMs), equipes de entrega e parceiros

✅ Perfil de Experiência

• Experiência em projetar e operar soluções de infraestrutura do Azure

• Experiência prática com Azure Storage, Azure Files e Redes

• Experiência com cargas de trabalho de escala empresarial ou de missão crítica

• Familiaridade com ferramentas de governança e monitoramento do Azure

• Fortes habilidades de solução de problemas e relacionamento com o cliente



Contratação CLT

Trabalho Hibrido (Viagens esporádicas)



O que oferecemos?

  • Vale Refeição ou Alimentação;
  • Assistência Médica e Assistência Odontológica;
  • Auxílio creche;
  • Convênio com Farmácia;
  • Parcerias com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas;
  • Parceria de descontos com Seguro Auto e Residência;
  • Gympass;
  • Seguro de Vida;


Promovemos um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e acolhedor. Não fazemos distinção por raça, cor, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade. Todas as candidaturas serão consideradas. O seu interesse em participar deste processo seletivo, automaticamente consente, autoriza e concorda que a PSM COMPANY, no papel de CONTROLADORA, tome decisões referentes ao tratamento de seus dados pessoais para esta finalidade específica, em conformidade com a Lei nº 13.709 – Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD).

title: Data Annotator
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.


Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.


We’re excited to share that Innodata Inc. is expanding its AI and Machine Learning Talent Network , and we’re looking for passionate, detail-oriented professionals to join us as Data Annotators and Content Moderators (Review & Labeling) .

If you enjoy working with data, have a strong eye for detail, and wish to contribute to real-world AI innovation , this is a wonderful opportunity to become part of a forward-thinking global team .


Location: Brazil, Language: Portuguese


Key Responsibilities

  • Review, label, and moderate online content (may include sensitive material).
  • Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and overall quality.
  • Contribute to building AI training datasets for next-generation systems.
  • Provide feedback and insights to enhance ongoing processes.


Requirements

  • Minimum qualification: High School completed or pursuing Bachelors.
  • Strong command of English (written and verbal) .
  • Excellent analytical and communication skills .
  • Comfortable working with diverse content types.
  • Access to a private, secure workspace with stable internet .


If you’re detail-oriented, tech-curious , and eager to contribute to the future of AI , we’d love to have you in our growing network.


If Interested, kindly send your resume at: .

title: Senior Angular Developer (Angular and Electron)
description:
At Intellias , we're always on the lookout for exceptional talent to join our team in Colombia. Over 20 years of market experience, Intellias brings together technologists, creators and innovators in Europe, North and Latin America, and the Middle East. Join our international team and take the mission to solve the advanced tech challenges of tomorrow!


If you're enthusiastic about contributing your skills and experience to our organization, we invite you to submit your CV for this position.


What we offer you in Intellias

  • B2B Contract
  • Fixed hour-based salary. You should have a private entrepreneurs (PE) and open US dollar bank account.
  • Corporate courses (Udemy, LinkedIn Learning and O'Raily)
  • Technical equipment on request
  • 100% English environment


Requirements:


  • English B2/C1
  • 7+ years of professional experience in software development
  • Highly Proficient in Angular 20, TypeScript, JavaScript, ES8+, HTML5, CSS3.
  • Proficient in test-driven development, automated testing, and the use of testing frameworks
  • Experience with Less/Sass CSS Pre-processors
  • Experience in the area of modular and scalable software development
  • Experience maintaining a living and complex codebase with a modern stack
  • Designing and developing reusable, testable front end components
  • Desire to learn cutting edge technology to solve complex business problems
  • Experience with Electron, Webpack, NodeJS, Vue.js, NPM, SVG


Responsabilities


  • Develop and maintain modern web solutions as a Senior Engineer within the Web Team using Angular 18, JavaScript, TypeScript (ES8+), HTML5, and CSS3 .
  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable and reusable UI components for web and desktop platforms, including Web, Windows, and macOS applications.
  • Establish and uphold high‑quality, maintainable, and performant coding standards , ensuring consistency across multiple platforms.
  • Collaborate closely with backend engineers, QA teams, and UX designers to deliver new features and enhancements for next‑generation applications.
  • Contribute to architecture design, technical decisions, design patterns, and development best practices .
  • Mentor and support engineers through technical guidance, code reviews, and knowledge sharing .
  • Drive continuous improvement in frontend architecture, performance, and user experience .
  • Own features from concept and design through implementation and delivery , ensuring alignment with both business and technical goals .

title: Especialista em Infraestrutura Azure
description:
A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.


O que Buscamos?



O Customer Success Architect (CSA) – Infraestrutura do Azure (Armazenamento, Arquivos, Rede) é responsável por orientar os clientes no desenho, na implantação, na operação e na otimização de soluções de Azure Storage, Azure Files e Azure Networking. Essa função atua como um(a) consultor(a) técnico(a) de confiança, garantindo que os clientes alcancem resultados de negócio e técnicos por meio de uma infraestrutura de nuvem segura, escalável, resiliente e bem governada, alinhada às melhores práticas da Microsoft e ao Cloud Adoption Framework.



✅ Competências e conhecimentos técnicos essenciais

Azure Storage – Fundamentos e arquitetura

• Arquitetura de contas do Azure Storage e considerações de design

• Serviços de armazenamento: Blob Storage, Azure Files, Azure Disks, Queue Storage e Table Storage

• Camadas de desempenho e opções de redundância (LRS, ZRS, GRS, GZRS)

• Planejamento de capacidade, escalabilidade e otimização de custos

• Gerenciamento do ciclo de vida dos dados e estratégias de tiering

Azure Files

• Arquitetura do Azure Files e protocolos suportados (SMB, NFS)

• Integração de identidade com Azure AD e Active Directory

• Camadas de desempenho de compartilhamentos de arquivos e casos de uso

• Cenários de migração a partir de servidores de arquivos on-premises

• Alta disponibilidade, snapshots e integração com backup

Azure Networking – Conceitos principais

• Virtual Networks (VNets), sub-redes e endereçamento IP

• Segurança de rede com NSGs e Azure Firewall

• Padrões de conectividade: VPN Gateway, ExpressRoute

• Private Endpoints e service endpoints

• Conceitos de DNS e resolução de nomes no Azure

✅ Monitoramento, observabilidade e operações

• Monitoramento de componentes de Azure Storage, Azure Files e Azure Networking

• Integração com Azure Monitor e Azure Network Watcher

• Métricas de taxa de transferência, latência, disponibilidade e erros

• Monitoramento de contas de armazenamento, compartilhamentos de arquivos e recursos de rede

Logs e análises

• Integração com Log Analytics Workspace

• Análise de logs e métricas usando Kusto Query Language (KQL)

• Criação de Workbooks e dashboards para visibilidade da infraestrutura

• Monitoramento proativo e insights operacionais

✅ Backup, recuperação e resiliência

Proteção de dados e continuidade de negócios

• Conceitos de backup e recuperação para Azure Storage e Azure Files

• Integração com Azure Backup e Recovery Services Vault

• Estratégias de snapshot e validação de restauração

• Requisitos de retenção de dados e conformidade

Alta disponibilidade e recuperação de desastres

• Redundância de armazenamento e arquiteturas com consciência de zona (zone-aware)

• Resiliência de rede e redundância de conectividade

• Cenários de DR entre regiões (cross-region) e híbridos

• Monitoramento de desempenho, capacidade e saúde

✅ Segurança, governança e conformidade

• Melhores práticas de segurança para Azure Storage e Azure Networking

• Criptografia em repouso e em trânsito

• Identidade, controle de acesso e desenho de RBAC

• Governança com Azure Policy e estratégias de tags

• Proteção contra exfiltração de dados e configurações incorretas


Automação e integração (desejável):

• Automação usando PowerShell, Azure CLI ou ARM/Bicep

• Integração com Azure Automation e Logic Apps

• Práticas de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC)

• Runbooks operacionais padronizados

✅ Responsabilidades de Engajamento e Entrega ao Cliente

• Atuar como consultor de confiança para clientes corporativos e de missão crítica

• Projetar e validar arquiteturas de armazenamento e rede do Azure

• Liderar workshops técnicos e revisões de arquitetura

• Apoiar as fases de integração, adoção e otimização

• Solucionar problemas em cenários complexos de armazenamento e rede

• Colaborar com Gerentes de Contas do Cliente (CSAMs), equipes de entrega e parceiros

✅ Perfil de Experiência

• Experiência em projetar e operar soluções de infraestrutura do Azure

• Experiência prática com Azure Storage, Azure Files e Redes

• Experiência com cargas de trabalho de escala empresarial ou de missão crítica

• Familiaridade com ferramentas de governança e monitoramento do Azure

• Fortes habilidades de solução de problemas e relacionamento com o cliente



Contratação CLT

Trabalho Hibrido (Viagens esporádicas)



O que oferecemos?

  • Vale Refeição ou Alimentação;
  • Assistência Médica e Assistência Odontológica;
  • Auxílio creche;
  • Convênio com Farmácia;
  • Parcerias com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas;
  • Parceria de descontos com Seguro Auto e Residência;
  • Gympass;
  • Seguro de Vida;


Promovemos um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e acolhedor. Não fazemos distinção por raça, cor, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade. Todas as candidaturas serão consideradas. O seu interesse em participar deste processo seletivo, automaticamente consente, autoriza e concorda que a PSM COMPANY, no papel de CONTROLADORA, tome decisões referentes ao tratamento de seus dados pessoais para esta finalidade específica, em conformidade com a Lei nº 13.709 – Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD).

title: AI Agent Manager (Media)
description:
About the Product

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose

The AI Agent Manager serves as the key technical and strategic resource for the company’s AI applications, with a focus on designing, building, operating, and managing complex AI agents. This role translates high-level business requirements into functional AI agent architectures, manages the full agent lifecycle (including advanced prompting, tooling, maintenance, and performance optimization), and ensures robust, measurable business outcomes.

The Manager owns the agent-building roadmap, advanced prompt engineering, agent configuration and deployment, performance monitoring, and cross-functional coordination to drive successful AI adoption across the organization.


Duties and Responsibilities

  • Main Responsibilities
  • Design, build, and maintain AI-powered workflows and agents using low-code/no-code and prompt-based platforms (e.g., multi-step prompt systems, agent frameworks).
  • Translate business requirements into scalable AI-driven solutions, especially for internal process automation (e.g., media planning, operations, finance workflows).
  • Configure and optimize multi-step AI prompts (“blueprints”) to automate complex tasks across different tools and systems.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers and business stakeholders to understand use cases and define solution logic.
  • Act as a bridge between business teams and technical infrastructure, ensuring solutions are usable by non-technical users.
  • Test, iterate, and improve AI agents to ensure reliability, accuracy, and performance in real-world use cases.
  • Identify opportunities for automation across departments and proactively propose AI-driven improvements.
  • Document workflows, prompt logic, and system configurations for internal reuse and scalability.
  • Stay up to date with advancements in AI tools, LLM capabilities, and no-code/low-code ecosystems.


Core Requirements

  • 4–7+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, System Analyst, or similar role.
  • Strong ability to translate business processes into structured workflows and logic.
  • Hands-on experience with low-code/no-code tools (e.g., Zapier, Make, Airtable, Retool, or similar platforms).
  • Experience working with AI tools (LLMs, prompt engineering, or AI automation platforms).
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently and own end-to-end solution delivery.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)
  • Technical / AI-Related
  • Experience designing multi-step prompts or AI workflows (not just single prompts).
  • Understanding of how LLMs work and how to structure prompts for reliable outputs.
  • Familiarity with APIs, integrations, and automation tools is a plus.

Profissional de nível Arquitetura que atue com (Rede/AWS).

Profissional especializado em segurança para ambientes financeiros críticos, responsável por definir, especializado em conectividade híbrida e ambientes de baixa latência, responsável por projetar e validar arquitetura de rede entre AWS e ambientes on-premises, garantindo desempenho, resiliência e segurança para cargas de trabalho do PIX. Realização de comprovações (POCs) para migração de workloads PIX do mainframe para AWS.

  • Projetar arquitetura de conectividade híbrida (AWS e on-prem);
  • Definir estratégia de conectividade (Direct Connect, failover via VPN);
  • Planejar e validar testes de performance de rede (latência, jitter, perda de pacotes);
  • Projetar arquitetura VPC com sub-redes segmentadas;
  • Otimizar tráfego de rede para workloads críticos;
  • Definir estratégias multirregião e de recuperação de desastres;
  • Implementar mecanismos de alta disponibilidade e failover;
  • Integrar rede com plataformas de containers (EKS/ROSA);
  • Colaborar com equipes de segurança para proteção de rede

Requisitos :

  • Amazon VPC, AWS Transit Gateway, Route 53;
  • AWS Direct Connect e VPN;
  • Network Load Balancer (Camada 4);
  • VPC Flow Logs e observabilidade de rede;
  • BGP e roteamento avançado;
  • Arquitetura de alto desempenho e baixa latência;
  • Certificações: AWS Network Specialty.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com sistemas financeiros e de missão crítica;
  • Operação de ambientes com alto throughput (milhares de TPS);

title: AI Agent Manager (Media)
description:
About the Product

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose

The AI Agent Manager serves as the key technical and strategic resource for the company’s AI applications, with a focus on designing, building, operating, and managing complex AI agents. This role translates high-level business requirements into functional AI agent architectures, manages the full agent lifecycle (including advanced prompting, tooling, maintenance, and performance optimization), and ensures robust, measurable business outcomes.

The Manager owns the agent-building roadmap, advanced prompt engineering, agent configuration and deployment, performance monitoring, and cross-functional coordination to drive successful AI adoption across the organization.


Duties and Responsibilities

  • Main Responsibilities
  • Design, build, and maintain AI-powered workflows and agents using low-code/no-code and prompt-based platforms (e.g., multi-step prompt systems, agent frameworks).
  • Translate business requirements into scalable AI-driven solutions, especially for internal process automation (e.g., media planning, operations, finance workflows).
  • Configure and optimize multi-step AI prompts (“blueprints”) to automate complex tasks across different tools and systems.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers and business stakeholders to understand use cases and define solution logic.
  • Act as a bridge between business teams and technical infrastructure, ensuring solutions are usable by non-technical users.
  • Test, iterate, and improve AI agents to ensure reliability, accuracy, and performance in real-world use cases.
  • Identify opportunities for automation across departments and proactively propose AI-driven improvements.
  • Document workflows, prompt logic, and system configurations for internal reuse and scalability.
  • Stay up to date with advancements in AI tools, LLM capabilities, and no-code/low-code ecosystems.


Core Requirements

  • 4–7+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, System Analyst, or similar role.
  • Strong ability to translate business processes into structured workflows and logic.
  • Hands-on experience with low-code/no-code tools (e.g., Zapier, Make, Airtable, Retool, or similar platforms).
  • Experience working with AI tools (LLMs, prompt engineering, or AI automation platforms).
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently and own end-to-end solution delivery.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)
  • Technical / AI-Related
  • Experience designing multi-step prompts or AI workflows (not just single prompts).
  • Understanding of how LLMs work and how to structure prompts for reliable outputs.
  • Familiarity with APIs, integrations, and automation tools is a plus.
  • Basic programming knowledge is helpful but not required.
  • Soft Skills
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work with non-technical stakeholders.
  • Business-oriented mindset with a focus on practical outcomes.
  • Curiosity and willingness to experiment with new AI tools and approaches.
  • Ability to operate in an ambiguous, fast-evolving environment.
  • Domain Experience
  • Experience in digital media, advertising tech, or media planning.


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Proven ability to design, build, and operate sophisticated AI agents.
  • Expertise in advanced prompt engineering, including multi-step prompting, few-shot learning, and optimizing for specific model outputs.
  • Strong business analysis fundamentals: elicitation, documentation, process mapping, traceability, UAT.
  • Ability to produce and manage, work autonomously, and take initiative.
  • Exceptional relationship-building skills, cultural competency, and ability to communicate effectively with diverse groups of people and roles.
  • Dexterity to effectively deal with ambiguity, change, and continuous process improvements.


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule).
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.


As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

title: Customer Success Analyst
description:
About us:

Closir is a UK-based investor relations (IR) support services provider. For over a decade we have been entrusted by blue chip companies around the world to help them achieve their IR objectives due to our intimate knowledge of the global buy-side, our technological expertise, and our close, long-term partnership approach.

The Closir platform is an all-in-one, web-based solution which makes companies much smarter and more effective, by helping them to achieve their IR objectives intelligently and proactively.

Closir combines all elements of IR, from high-level strategy (“Who’s investing in my peers?”) to daily workflow (“What topics came up most in my meetings with investors this quarter?”) into one intelligent, user-friendly platform which includes the most comprehensive and up-to-date database of buy-side contacts on the market; proactive outreach tools; share & peer holder tracking; customisable reports; and professional-level support.


Role Overview:

We are looking for a customer-centric, self-driven individual to join our Customer Success team.


You will manage relationships with IR teams at public companies, guiding them from onboarding through to long-term adoption. You’ll help clients integrate their data, extract insights, and embed Closir into their day-to-day workflows.


You will work closely with Research and Product teams to ensure high-quality data integration, surface client feedback, and improve the experience on Closir.com.


Responsibilities:


  • Partner with clients to understand their Investor Relations needs and drive adoption of the Closir platform.
  • Act as a trusted advisor, providing strategic insights and support to senior IR teams.
  • Deliver tailored onboarding, training, and consulting sessions.
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to champion client feedback and influence product direction.
  • Build long-lasting relationships that foster retention, growth, and client advocacy.



Qualifications:


  • Background in Investor Relations (in-house or advisory) – you understand the workflows, challenges, and priorities of IR professionals.
  • Experience in consulting, customer success, or client-facing roles where you’ve advised senior stakeholders.
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex needs into actionable solutions.
  • Passion for SaaS, fintech, and improving how companies engage with investors.
  • Fluent in English and Spanish



Why Join Us?


  • Work at the intersection of SaaS, finance, and strategy with a fast-growing, global team.
  • Shape the future of investor relations technology.
  • Opportunity to take ownership and make a measurable impact with clients.
  • Collaborative, ambitious, and supportive culture.



If you’re excited about helping Investor Relations teams thrive with cutting-edge SaaS solutions, we’d love to hear from you.


This job vacancy is open for candidates based out of Latin America.
