title: Analista Financeiro Sênior
description:
No Iberostar Group, estamos à procura de um(a) Analista Financeiro(a) Sênior para se juntar à nossa equipe de Contabilidade no Grand Amazon Expedition , nosso cruzeiro imersivo pelo Amazonas brasileiro. Mas, antes de conhecer mais sobre a posição, acreditamos que é importante que você saiba um pouco mais sobre o Iberostar Group:


  • Somos uma empresa 100% familiar com 70 anos de experiência no setor do turismo. Hoje acolhemos milhões de viajantes com a promessa de criar férias felizes e experiências memoráveis, com uma proposta de valor baseada na qualidade e na experiência do cliente e do colaborador.
  • Operamos mais de 100 estabelecimentos distribuídos por 35 destinos em 13 países em todo o mundo, localizados em zonas privilegiadas junto ao mar.
  • Fazemos parte de uma família com mais de 35.000 pessoas de 95 nacionalidades, que partilham os mesmos valores: Responsabilidade, Transparência, Humildade, Paixão e Criatividade.
  • Trabalhamos para criar um lugar onde prosperar: cuidamos das pessoas que fazem parte da família Iberostar, promovendo o seu crescimento, garantindo o seu bem-estar e incentivando a equidade como base das nossas decisões.
  • O nosso movimento Iberostar Wave of Change é o nosso roteiro para impulsionar o nosso propósito de liderar um modelo de turismo responsável.


Missão do Cargo


Responsável pela análise contábil dos documentos processados pela empresa (notas fiscais, faturas, pagamentos, recebimentos, tributos, entre outros), garantindo o correto preenchimento conforme a legislação vigente e diretrizes internas.


Realiza a classificação contábil de acordo com o plano de contas e apoia na elaboração de relatórios e demonstrativos periódicos de desempenho.


Atua nos processos das áreas contábil, contas a receber (faturamento) e contas a pagar do Iberostar, participando também das rotinas fiscais e tributárias.


Executa atividades de controle interno com foco na identificação de riscos, além da elaboração de papéis de trabalho e relatórios de auditoria.


Principais Responsabilidades:


  • Conciliações contábeis, orientando lançamentos e efetuando ajustes, quando necessário, visando a observância da alocação das despesas.
  • Reporte e contato direito com pessoal do escritório da Bahia.
  • Acompanha fiscalizações, visitas, auditorias internas e externas, apresentando documentos e outros registros e controles, prestando esclarecimentos, recebendo e assinando notificações, tomando providências negociadas, envolvendo gestores, a fim de dirimir possíveis questões legais e judiciais.
  • Recebe fiscais da Receita Federal, da Prefeitura e peritos da justiça, identificando propósitos das visitas, verificando credenciais, a fim de providenciar o atendimento das solicitações.
  • Assessora os auditores internos e externos, fornecendo informações contábeis da empresa e documentações conforme as normas da empresa, visando à transparência da gestão e atendimento as exigências legais e fiscais.
  • Controla fluxo de pagamentos, através de planilha e relatórios gerados, indicando oportunidades de melhores ganhos financeiros, a fim de identificar distorções e oportunidades de melhoria para o desempenho econômico-financeiro da empresa.
  • Analisa o cadastro de fornecedores através de consulta ao Órgão de Restrição ao Crédito, Mercado Interno e Mercado Externo e análise sistêmica do Patrimônio do Cadastrado, a fim de apurar o risco financeiro de crédito e fornecimento.
  • Analisa a carteira de contas a pagar identificando anomalias e propondo oportunidades de melhorias nos números apresentados, a fim de buscar adimplência junto aos fornecedores.
  • Analisa e monitora processos de contas a pagar tais como, pagamento e baixa de títulos, controle de saldo e fundo fixo, transferências, conciliação, lançamentos, emissão de extratos e boletos, compensação de títulos e processos de custódia, a fim de cumprir com os procedimentos da área.
  • Apoiar na execução do plano de auditorias conforme metodologia interna da companhia.
  • Avaliação de riscos e cumprimento dos procedimentos internos a fim de assegurar a conformidade das políticas e diretrizes.
  • Identificar não conformidades e desenvolver planos de ação corretiva em conjunto com as equipes responsáveis.
  • Avaliação dos controles internos, riscos identificados, recomendações de melhoria e considerações das outras áreas.

  • Trabalhar em conjunto com outras áreas da empresa para identificar necessidades e propor soluções.

title: AI Agent Manager (Media)
description:
About the Product

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose

The AI Agent Manager serves as the key technical and strategic resource for the company’s AI applications, with a focus on designing, building, operating, and managing complex AI agents. This role translates high-level business requirements into functional AI agent architectures, manages the full agent lifecycle (including advanced prompting, tooling, maintenance, and performance optimization), and ensures robust, measurable business outcomes.

The Manager owns the agent-building roadmap, advanced prompt engineering, agent configuration and deployment, performance monitoring, and cross-functional coordination to drive successful AI adoption across the organization.


Duties and Responsibilities

  • Main Responsibilities
  • Design, build, and maintain AI-powered workflows and agents using low-code/no-code and prompt-based platforms (e.g., multi-step prompt systems, agent frameworks).
  • Translate business requirements into scalable AI-driven solutions, especially for internal process automation (e.g., media planning, operations, finance workflows).
  • Configure and optimize multi-step AI prompts (“blueprints”) to automate complex tasks across different tools and systems.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers and business stakeholders to understand use cases and define solution logic.
  • Act as a bridge between business teams and technical infrastructure, ensuring solutions are usable by non-technical users.
  • Test, iterate, and improve AI agents to ensure reliability, accuracy, and performance in real-world use cases.
  • Identify opportunities for automation across departments and proactively propose AI-driven improvements.
  • Document workflows, prompt logic, and system configurations for internal reuse and scalability.
  • Stay up to date with advancements in AI tools, LLM capabilities, and no-code/low-code ecosystems.


Core Requirements

  • 4–7+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, System Analyst, or similar role.
  • Strong ability to translate business processes into structured workflows and logic.
  • Hands-on experience with low-code/no-code tools (e.g., Zapier, Make, Airtable, Retool, or similar platforms).
  • Experience working with AI tools (LLMs, prompt engineering, or AI automation platforms).
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently and own end-to-end solution delivery.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)
  • Technical / AI-Related
  • Experience designing multi-step prompts or AI workflows (not just single prompts).
  • Understanding of how LLMs work and how to structure prompts for reliable outputs.
  • Familiarity with APIs, integrations, and automation tools is a plus.
  • Basic programming knowledge is helpful but not required.
  • Soft Skills
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work with non-technical stakeholders.
  • Business-oriented mindset with a focus on practical outcomes.
  • Curiosity and willingness to experiment with new AI tools and approaches.
  • Ability to operate in an ambiguous, fast-evolving environment.
  • Domain Experience
  • Experience in digital media, advertising tech, or media planning.


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Proven ability to design, build, and operate sophisticated AI agents.
  • Expertise in advanced prompt engineering, including multi-step prompting, few-shot learning, and optimizing for specific model outputs.
  • Strong business analysis fundamentals: elicitation, documentation, process mapping, traceability, UAT.
  • Ability to produce and manage, work autonomously, and take initiative.
  • Exceptional relationship-building skills, cultural competency, and ability to communicate effectively with diverse groups of people and roles.
  • Dexterity to effectively deal with ambiguity, change, and continuous process improvements.


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule).
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.


As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

title: Customer Success Analyst
description:
About us:

Closir is a UK-based investor relations (IR) support services provider. For over a decade we have been entrusted by blue chip companies around the world to help them achieve their IR objectives due to our intimate knowledge of the global buy-side, our technological expertise, and our close, long-term partnership approach.

The Closir platform is an all-in-one, web-based solution which makes companies much smarter and more effective, by helping them to achieve their IR objectives intelligently and proactively.

Closir combines all elements of IR, from high-level strategy (“Who’s investing in my peers?”) to daily workflow (“What topics came up most in my meetings with investors this quarter?”) into one intelligent, user-friendly platform which includes the most comprehensive and up-to-date database of buy-side contacts on the market; proactive outreach tools; share & peer holder tracking; customisable reports; and professional-level support.


Role Overview:

We are looking for a customer-centric, self-driven individual to join our Customer Success team.


You will manage relationships with IR teams at public companies, guiding them from onboarding through to long-term adoption. You’ll help clients integrate their data, extract insights, and embed Closir into their day-to-day workflows.


You will work closely with Research and Product teams to ensure high-quality data integration, surface client feedback, and improve the experience on Closir.com.


Responsibilities:


  • Partner with clients to understand their Investor Relations needs and drive adoption of the Closir platform.
  • Act as a trusted advisor, providing strategic insights and support to senior IR teams.
  • Deliver tailored onboarding, training, and consulting sessions.
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to champion client feedback and influence product direction.
  • Build long-lasting relationships that foster retention, growth, and client advocacy.



Qualifications:


  • Background in Investor Relations (in-house or advisory) – you understand the workflows, challenges, and priorities of IR professionals.
  • Experience in consulting, customer success, or client-facing roles where you’ve advised senior stakeholders.
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex needs into actionable solutions.
  • Passion for SaaS, fintech, and improving how companies engage with investors.
  • Fluent in English and Spanish



Why Join Us?


  • Work at the intersection of SaaS, finance, and strategy with a fast-growing, global team.
  • Shape the future of investor relations technology.
  • Opportunity to take ownership and make a measurable impact with clients.
  • Collaborative, ambitious, and supportive culture.



If you’re excited about helping Investor Relations teams thrive with cutting-edge SaaS solutions, we’d love to hear from you.


This job vacancy is open for candidates based out of Latin America.

title: Arquitetura de Rede AWS - 132142
description:
O que buscamos:

Profissional de nível Arquitetura que atue com (Rede/AWS).

Responsabilidades:

Profissional especializado em segurança para ambientes financeiros críticos, responsável por definir, especializado em conectividade híbrida e ambientes de baixa latência, responsável por projetar e validar arquitetura de rede entre AWS e ambientes on-premises, garantindo desempenho, resiliência e segurança para cargas de trabalho do PIX. Realização de comprovações (POCs) para migração de workloads PIX do mainframe para AWS.

  • Projetar arquitetura de conectividade híbrida (AWS e on-prem);
  • Definir estratégia de conectividade (Direct Connect, failover via VPN);
  • Planejar e validar testes de performance de rede (latência, jitter, perda de pacotes);
  • Projetar arquitetura VPC com sub-redes segmentadas;
  • Otimizar tráfego de rede para workloads críticos;
  • Definir estratégias multirregião e de recuperação de desastres;
  • Implementar mecanismos de alta disponibilidade e failover;
  • Integrar rede com plataformas de containers (EKS/ROSA);
  • Colaborar com equipes de segurança para proteção de rede

Requisitos :

  • Amazon VPC, AWS Transit Gateway, Route 53;
  • AWS Direct Connect e VPN;
  • Network Load Balancer (Camada 4);
  • VPC Flow Logs e observabilidade de rede;
  • BGP e roteamento avançado;
  • Arquitetura de alto desempenho e baixa latência;
  • Certificações: AWS Network Specialty.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com sistemas financeiros e de missão crítica;
  • Operação de ambientes com alto throughput (milhares de TPS);
  • Estratégias de failover ativo-ativo;
  • Considerações de rede para integração com HSM.

Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.

Big enough to deliver – small enough to care.

title: Customer Success Analyst
description:
About us:

Closir is a UK-based investor relations (IR) support services provider. For over a decade we have been entrusted by blue chip companies around the world to help them achieve their IR objectives due to our intimate knowledge of the global buy-side, our technological expertise, and our close, long-term partnership approach.

The Closir platform is an all-in-one, web-based solution which makes companies much smarter and more effective, by helping them to achieve their IR objectives intelligently and proactively.

Closir combines all elements of IR, from high-level strategy (“Who’s investing in my peers?”) to daily workflow (“What topics came up most in my meetings with investors this quarter?”) into one intelligent, user-friendly platform which includes the most comprehensive and up-to-date database of buy-side contacts on the market; proactive outreach tools; share & peer holder tracking; customisable reports; and professional-level support.


Role Overview:

We are looking for a customer-centric, self-driven individual to join our Customer Success team.


You will manage relationships with IR teams at public companies, guiding them from onboarding through to long-term adoption. You’ll help clients integrate their data, extract insights, and embed Closir into their day-to-day workflows.


You will work closely with Research and Product teams to ensure high-quality data integration, surface client feedback, and improve the experience on Closir.com.


Responsibilities:


  • Partner with clients to understand their Investor Relations needs and drive adoption of the Closir platform.
  • Act as a trusted advisor, providing strategic insights and support to senior IR teams.
  • Deliver tailored onboarding, training, and consulting sessions.
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to champion client feedback and influence product direction.
  • Build long-lasting relationships that foster retention, growth, and client advocacy.



Qualifications:


  • Background in Investor Relations (in-house or advisory) – you understand the workflows, challenges, and priorities of IR professionals.
  • Experience in consulting, customer success, or client-facing roles where you’ve advised senior stakeholders.
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex needs into actionable solutions.
  • Passion for SaaS, fintech, and improving how companies engage with investors.
  • Fluent in English and Spanish



Why Join Us?


  • Work at the intersection of SaaS, finance, and strategy with a fast-growing, global team.
  • Shape the future of investor relations technology.
  • Opportunity to take ownership and make a measurable impact with clients.
  • Collaborative, ambitious, and supportive culture.



If you’re excited about helping Investor Relations teams thrive with cutting-edge SaaS solutions, we’d love to hear from you.


This job vacancy is open for candidates based out of Latin America.

title: Content Safety Operations Specialist
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Content Safety Operations Specialist to support the Brazil market, ensuring high standards of content quality and safety across the platform. In this role, you will monitor content trends, identify risks, and collaborate closely with global teams to improve policies and enforcement strategies.


You will act as a key local point of contact, bringing insights about Brazilian culture, user behavior, and regulatory developments to support the continuous evolution of content safety operations.


Responsibilities

  • Continuously review and assess content quality and appropriateness within the Brazil market, identifying risks, anomalies, and emerging trends.
  • Produce regular reports on content quality, trending topics, and potential safety risks.
  • Act as the local point of contact for safety operations, maintaining close communication with global teams.
  • Share insights on local culture, user behavior, and policy updates to support decision-making.
  • Support the development and optimization of content safety strategies and moderation guidelines tailored to the Brazil market.
  • Monitor regulatory developments related to online content in Brazil and support the handling of escalations and compliance requirements.


Requirements

  • Fluent Portuguese and Chinese (Mandarin) to support communication with global stakeholders.
  • 2+ years of experience in content safety, content moderation, Trust & Safety, or related fields.
  • Strong understanding of Brazilian culture, social trends, and online behavior, with the ability to identify sensitive content.
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working in distributed or international teams.


Nice to Have

  • Knowledge of English (written and spoken), with the ability to collaborate with global teams.
  • Experience working with policy development, moderation guidelines, or regulatory compliance.

title: Customer Success Analyst
description:
About us:

Closir is a UK-based investor relations (IR) support services provider. For over a decade we have been entrusted by blue chip companies around the world to help them achieve their IR objectives due to our intimate knowledge of the global buy-side, our technological expertise, and our close, long-term partnership approach.

The Closir platform is an all-in-one, web-based solution which makes companies much smarter and more effective, by helping them to achieve their IR objectives intelligently and proactively.

Closir combines all elements of IR, from high-level strategy (“Who’s investing in my peers?”) to daily workflow (“What topics came up most in my meetings with investors this quarter?”) into one intelligent, user-friendly platform which includes the most comprehensive and up-to-date database of buy-side contacts on the market; proactive outreach tools; share & peer holder tracking; customisable reports; and professional-level support.


Role Overview:

We are looking for a customer-centric, self-driven individual to join our Customer Success team.


You will manage relationships with IR teams at public companies, guiding them from onboarding through to long-term adoption. You’ll help clients integrate their data, extract insights, and embed Closir into their day-to-day workflows.


You will work closely with Research and Product teams to ensure high-quality data integration, surface client feedback, and improve the experience on Closir.com.


Responsibilities:


  • Partner with clients to understand their Investor Relations needs and drive adoption of the Closir platform.
  • Act as a trusted advisor, providing strategic insights and support to senior IR teams.
  • Deliver tailored onboarding, training, and consulting sessions.
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to champion client feedback and influence product direction.
  • Build long-lasting relationships that foster retention, growth, and client advocacy.



Qualifications:


  • Background in Investor Relations (in-house or advisory) – you understand the workflows, challenges, and priorities of IR professionals.
  • Experience in consulting, customer success, or client-facing roles where you’ve advised senior stakeholders.
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex needs into actionable solutions.
  • Passion for SaaS, fintech, and improving how companies engage with investors.
  • Fluent in English and Spanish



Why Join Us?


  • Work at the intersection of SaaS, finance, and strategy with a fast-growing, global team.
  • Shape the future of investor relations technology.
  • Opportunity to take ownership and make a measurable impact with clients.
  • Collaborative, ambitious, and supportive culture.



If you’re excited about helping Investor Relations teams thrive with cutting-edge SaaS solutions, we’d love to hear from you.


This job vacancy is open for candidates based out of Latin America.

title: Senior Cloud Engineer (AWS and Azure)
description:
About the Company


Sycomp is a global IT services and logistics provider with extensive expertise in cloud, data center, endpoint management and security solutions. Sycomp’s diverse team of consultants and engineers deliver on the company’s mission to tackle challenging global IT projects through its state-of-the-art integration and warehouse centers and global technology partnerships. Headquartered in the heart of Silicon Valley, California, Sycomp has successfully shipped, deployed and managed complex IT projects and supporting assets in more than 150 countries helping its Fortune 500 customers and global partners realize a world without boundaries.



Position Overview:


We are seeking a motivated and results-oriented Senior Cloud Engineer with experience in two or more cloud technologies (AWS or Azure) to join our growing team in a support, engineering, and consulting role. In this role, you will work closely with our senior architects, engineers and consultants to assist clients in designing, implementing, and optimizing cloud-based solutions. This role offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in cloud architecture, develop technical expertise, and contribute to the success of our clients.


What You'll Do:


  • Manage and respond to customer-facing support tickets, ensuring timely resolution of technical issues and maintaining high customer satisfaction.
  • Collaborate with senior architects and consultants to understand client requirements and develop and support scalable cloud-based solutions.
  • Apply best practice framework principles to evaluate and improve client architecture.
  • Apply FinOps best practices to monitor, analyze, and optimize cloud costs, including cost allocation, budget tracking, and implementing cost-saving strategies.
  • Support and assist clients with AI/ML workloads and implementations using cloud provider services such as Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Studio, Azure ML, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, and other AI tools.
  • Assist in designing, implementing, and maintaining cloud infrastructure components such as virtual compute instances (VMs & containers), storage services, databases, and virtual networks (VNet & VPC).
  • Provide technical support to clients, including troubleshooting issues, optimizing performance, and ensuring security best practices.
  • Configure and manage cloud resources, including virtual compute instances, storage services, databases, virtual networks, and more.
  • Develop and document infrastructure as code (IaC) using tools like Amazon CloudFormation & CDK, Azure ARM, Azure Bicap, Google Cloud Deployment Manager, or Terraform.
  • Contribute to DevOps workflows using tools such as Azure DevOps, Google Cloud Deployment and Amazon CodePipeline.
  • Maintain awareness and proficiency on cloud services, features, and best practices to provide expert guidance and support to clients.
  • Contribute to the development of documentation, training materials, and best practices guides for internal and external use.
  • Actively participate in professional development activities to enhance technical skills and knowledge of cloud technologies.


What We're Looking For:


  • Bachelor's or Technology degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field.
  • At least three years working in an AWS, Azure or Google Cloud environment.
  • At least one professional-level cloud certification such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer Professional, Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert, Google Professional Cloud Architect, or Google Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer.
  • Strong understanding of core cloud provider services, including compute, networking, storage, database, and security.
  • Understanding of AWS, and Azure framework principles and practices.
  • Understanding of FinOps principles and cloud cost optimization best practices.
  • Basic understanding of AI/ML concepts and familiarity with AI tools and services.
  • Experience with ticketing systems and customer support workflows.
  • Basic knowledge of networking principles and protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP).
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Fluency in English, both written and verbal.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code (IaC) tools.
  • Strong written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.


Bonus Points For:


  • Certifications in more than one cloud provider
  • FinOps Certified Practitioner or experience with cloud cost management tools.
  • Experience with cloud provider AI/ML services.
  • Experience conducting Well-Architected best-practice reviews.
  • Knowledge of DevOps principles and practices.
  • Experience in a technology consulting environment.
  • Experience with multiple cloud platforms.


What We Offer:


  • Collaborative and inclusive work culture with opportunities for growth and advancement.
  • Exciting projects with leading-edge cloud technologies.
  • Continuous learning and professional development opportunities including training and certification programs.


Join our team and embark on a rewarding career journey as a Cloud Engineer, where you will play a vital role in helping our clients succeed in the cloud. Apply now to become part of our innovative and dynamic team!


Sycomp is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, age, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

Sycomp will provide reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities as needed. If you need assistance or an accommodation in applying, please contact our Human Resources Department at .

As such, our organization may use automated tools including artificial intelligence, to support certain aspects of the recruitment process, such as reviewing applications or identifying relevant experience and education. These tools assist our teams, and all final hiring decisions are made following human review. If you have questions or concerns about our process, please contact us at .

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

Requisitos obrigatórios


  • Experiência com Angular 15+ e Java
  • Experiência com Module Federation e WebView.
  • Testes unitários com Jest/Jasmine.
  • Git/GitHub

  • Conhecimento de IDS / Design System.
  • Docker.

Diferenciais


  • Conhecimento em Kotlin.
  • Conhecimento em Python.

Modelo de atuação

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

title: Senior Cloud Engineer (AWS and Azure)
description:
About the Company


Sycomp is a global IT services and logistics provider with extensive expertise in cloud, data center, endpoint management and security solutions. Sycomp’s diverse team of consultants and engineers deliver on the company’s mission to tackle challenging global IT projects through its state-of-the-art integration and warehouse centers and global technology partnerships. Headquartered in the heart of Silicon Valley, California, Sycomp has successfully shipped, deployed and managed complex IT projects and supporting assets in more than 150 countries helping its Fortune 500 customers and global partners realize a world without boundaries.



Position Overview:


We are seeking a motivated and results-oriented Senior Cloud Engineer with experience in two or more cloud technologies (AWS or Azure) to join our growing team in a support, engineering, and consulting role. In this role, you will work closely with our senior architects, engineers and consultants to assist clients in designing, implementing, and optimizing cloud-based solutions. This role offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in cloud architecture, develop technical expertise, and contribute to the success of our clients.


What You'll Do:


  • Manage and respond to customer-facing support tickets, ensuring timely resolution of technical issues and maintaining high customer satisfaction.
  • Collaborate with senior architects and consultants to understand client requirements and develop and support scalable cloud-based solutions.
  • Apply best practice framework principles to evaluate and improve client architecture.
  • Apply FinOps best practices to monitor, analyze, and optimize cloud costs, including cost allocation, budget tracking, and implementing cost-saving strategies.
  • Support and assist clients with AI/ML workloads and implementations using cloud provider services such as Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Studio, Azure ML, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, and other AI tools.
  • Assist in designing, implementing, and maintaining cloud infrastructure components such as virtual compute instances (VMs & containers), storage services, databases, and virtual networks (VNet & VPC).
  • Provide technical support to clients, including troubleshooting issues, optimizing performance, and ensuring security best practices.
  • Configure and manage cloud resources, including virtual compute instances, storage services, databases, virtual networks, and more.
  • Develop and document infrastructure as code (IaC) using tools like Amazon CloudFormation & CDK, Azure ARM, Azure Bicap, Google Cloud Deployment Manager, or Terraform.
  • Contribute to DevOps workflows using tools such as Azure DevOps, Google Cloud Deployment and Amazon CodePipeline.
  • Maintain awareness and proficiency on cloud services, features, and best practices to provide expert guidance and support to clients.
  • Contribute to the development of documentation, training materials, and best practices guides for internal and external use.
  • Actively participate in professional development activities to enhance technical skills and knowledge of cloud technologies.


What We're Looking For:


  • Bachelor's or Technology degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field.
  • At least three years working in an AWS, Azure or Google Cloud environment.
  • At least one professional-level cloud certification such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer Professional, Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert, Google Professional Cloud Architect, or Google Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer.
  • Strong understanding of core cloud provider services, including compute, networking, storage, database, and security.
  • Understanding of AWS, and Azure framework principles and practices.
  • Understanding of FinOps principles and cloud cost optimization best practices.
  • Basic understanding of AI/ML concepts and familiarity with AI tools and services.
  • Experience with ticketing systems and customer support workflows.
  • Basic knowledge of networking principles and protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP).
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Fluency in English, both written and verbal.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code (IaC) tools.
  • Strong written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.


Bonus Points For:


  • Certifications in more than one cloud provider
  • FinOps Certified Practitioner or experience with cloud cost management tools.
  • Experience with cloud provider AI/ML services.
  • Experience conducting Well-Architected best-practice reviews.
  • Knowledge of DevOps principles and practices.
  • Experience in a technology consulting environment.
  • Experience with multiple cloud platforms.


What We Offer:


  • Collaborative and inclusive work culture with opportunities for growth and advancement.
  • Exciting projects with leading-edge cloud technologies.
  • Continuous learning and professional development opportunities including training and certification programs.


Join our team and embark on a rewarding career journey as a Cloud Engineer, where you will play a vital role in helping our clients succeed in the cloud. Apply now to become part of our innovative and dynamic team!


Sycomp is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, age, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

Sycomp will provide reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities as needed. If you need assistance or an accommodation in applying, please contact our Human Resources Department at .


Sycomp complies with applicable AI regulations worldwide and adheres to the most rigorous standards. As such, our organization may use automated tools including artificial intelligence, to support certain aspects of the recruitment process, such as reviewing applications or identifying relevant experience and education. These tools assist our teams, and all final hiring decisions are made following human review. If you have questions or concerns about our process, please contact us at .

title: Full Stack Engineer (Laravel, Redux, and TypeScript)
description:
DomainTools is seeking a Software Engineer to join our Internal Team. This position is perfect for someone interested in building powerful cybersecurity products and features for our enterprise customers. Our solutions help fuel mission critical efforts for customers including gathering threat intelligence, doing threat hunting, and performing online fraud investigation, and more.


At DomainTools, you will work as part of a collaborative team of smart and engaged engineers. Expect to spend most of your time developing modern JavaScript single page applications powered by PHR middleware APIs. You will work in an environment where productivity is fostered. You will spend very little time in meetings, and you won’t be distracted by processes that get in the way of high-quality results.


Have you worked with modern PHP OOP frameworks such as Laravel of Symfony? Are you well versed in using CSS and UX to make beautiful and streamlined designs? Have you built successful end to end testing solutions? If you answered yes to any of these questions we would like to chat with you. However, it is required that you are very comfortable with JavaScript.


Job Responsibilities

  • Produce well designed, testable, efficient code using software development best practices.
  • Integrate with and utilize data from backend services and databases.
  • Build web applications using PHP on the backend and JavaScript (ES7+), HTML5, and CSS3 on the frontend.
  • Contribute to new product ideation and implementation as well as to feature development of existing products.
  • Collaborate with teammates by actively participating in code reviews, contributing to technical documentation, and offering constructive design feedback.
  • Become a subject matter expert on DomainTools’ customer facing products and services.


Key Applicant Qualifications

  • Work experience: 3+ years of modern web application development.
  • Experience with modern PHP frameworks (Laravel, Symfony).
  • Solid knowledge of the following:
  • Object oriented PHP 7+ programming
  • JavaScript (ES7+)
  • TypeScript
  • HTML5 and CSS3
  • Deep understanding of React 18+ and Redux.
  • Experience with unit and integration testing (PHPUnit, Jest).
  • Demonstrable experience building and consuming APIs.
  • Proficiency with version control systems, particularly Git.
  • Experience with container technologies, particularly Docker.


Pluses

  • Familiarity with configuring Babel, Webpack, and ESLint.
  • Experience with orchestration platforms, particularly Kubernetes.
  • Experience with user acceptance/E2E testing (TestCafe, Playwright).
  • Familiarity interacting with relational databases (MySQL).
  • Experience with UX design and related concepts.
  • Experience using agile principles and methodologies.
  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science or a related field.


More Details:

  • 100% remote in Brazil
  • Salary: up to $53,000per annum

title: Desenvolvedor SAP ABAP
description:
Desenvolvedor SAP ABAP (CPI / CDS) – Sênior

Modelo de atuação: Remoto

Tipo de contratação: PJ ou Cooperado


Descrição da vaga:

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) SAP ABAP Sênior com sólida experiência em integrações e modelagem de dados no ecossistema SAP. O profissional atuará no desenvolvimento e manutenção de soluções utilizando ABAP moderno, com foco em integração via CPI e construção de views CDS, garantindo performance, escalabilidade e aderência às melhores práticas do SAP S/4HANA.


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver soluções utilizando ABAP (clássico e moderno) em ambientes SAP S/4HANA
  • Criar e manter integrações utilizando SAP CPI (Cloud Platform Integration)
  • Desenvolver e otimizar CDS Views para modelagem e exposição de dados
  • Participar da definição de arquiteturas técnicas e boas práticas de desenvolvimento
  • Atuar na análise e resolução de incidentes e melhorias evolutivas
  • Garantir qualidade de código, performance e aderência a padrões SAP


Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Experiência sólida com desenvolvimento ABAP
  • Experiência com SAP CPI (integrações)
  • Experiência com CDS Views
  • Vivência em projetos SAP S/4HANA
  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento orientado a objetos (ABAP OO)
  • Experiência com consumo e exposição de APIs/serviços (OData, REST)


Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em Clean Core
  • Experiência com ABAP Cloud
  • Vivência com Fiori/UI5
  • Experiência com BTP (Business Technology Platform)

title: Full Stack Engineer (Laravel, Redux, and TypeScript)
description:
DomainTools is seeking a Software Engineer to join our Internal Team. This position is perfect for someone interested in building powerful cybersecurity products and features for our enterprise customers. Our solutions help fuel mission critical efforts for customers including gathering threat intelligence, doing threat hunting, and performing online fraud investigation, and more.


At DomainTools, you will work as part of a collaborative team of smart and engaged engineers. Expect to spend most of your time developing modern JavaScript single page applications powered by PHR middleware APIs. You will work in an environment where productivity is fostered. You will spend very little time in meetings, and you won’t be distracted by processes that get in the way of high-quality results.


Have you worked with modern PHP OOP frameworks such as Laravel of Symfony? Are you well versed in using CSS and UX to make beautiful and streamlined designs? Have you built successful end to end testing solutions? If you answered yes to any of these questions we would like to chat with you. However, it is required that you are very comfortable with JavaScript.


Job Responsibilities

  • Produce well designed, testable, efficient code using software development best practices.
  • Integrate with and utilize data from backend services and databases.
  • Build web applications using PHP on the backend and JavaScript (ES7+), HTML5, and CSS3 on the frontend.
  • Contribute to new product ideation and implementation as well as to feature development of existing products.
  • Collaborate with teammates by actively participating in code reviews, contributing to technical documentation, and offering constructive design feedback.
  • Become a subject matter expert on DomainTools’ customer facing products and services.


Key Applicant Qualifications

  • Work experience: 3+ years of modern web application development.
  • Experience with modern PHP frameworks (Laravel, Symfony).
  • Solid knowledge of the following:
  • Object oriented PHP 7+ programming
  • JavaScript (ES7+)
  • TypeScript
  • HTML5 and CSS3
  • Deep understanding of React 18+ and Redux.
  • Experience with unit and integration testing (PHPUnit, Jest).
  • Demonstrable experience building and consuming APIs.
  • Proficiency with version control systems, particularly Git.
  • Experience with container technologies, particularly Docker.


Pluses

  • Familiarity with configuring Babel, Webpack, and ESLint.
  • Experience with orchestration platforms, particularly Kubernetes.
  • Experience with user acceptance/E2E testing (TestCafe, Playwright).
  • Familiarity interacting with relational databases (MySQL).
  • Experience with UX design and related concepts.
  • Experience using agile principles and methodologies.
  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science or a related field.


More Details:

  • 100% remote in Brazil
  • Salary: up to $53,000per annum
